Fault_Diagnosis_Decision_Trees:

  identity:
    name: 医院机电系统故障诊断决策树
    description: 基于症状的故障诊断逻辑，支持运维人员快速定位问题
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  # ========================================
  # 决策树结构定义
  # ========================================
  tree_structure:
    
    node_types:
      symptom: 故障现象/入口
      question: 诊断问题
      check: 检查步骤
      diagnosis: 故障诊断结果
      action: 处理措施
      
    severity_levels:
      - CRITICAL: 紧急故障，需立即处理
      - HIGH: 重要故障，2小时内处理
      - MEDIUM: 一般故障，当日处理
      - LOW: 轻微故障，可计划处理

  # ========================================
  # HVAC-CHP 冷水机组故障诊断树
  # ========================================
  HVAC_CHP_Chiller_Diagnostics:
    
    tree_id: DT_CHP_CHILLER
    tree_name: 冷水机组故障诊断
    system: HVAC-CHP
    equipment: 冷水机组
    
    entry_symptoms:
      
      # ====== 症状1：冷机无法启动 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_CH_NO_START
        symptom_name: 冷机无法启动
        severity: CRITICAL
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 冷机控制面板有无显示？
            options:
              - answer: 无显示
                next: Q1_1
              - answer: 有显示
                next: Q1_2
                
          Q1_1:
            type: question
            question: 检查冷机供电
            checks:
              - 检查配电柜冷机回路开关
              - 检查冷机本体开关
              - 检查控制变压器保险
            options:
              - answer: 供电正常
                next: D1_1_1
              - answer: 供电异常
                next: D1_1_2
                
          D1_1_1:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 控制器故障
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查控制器电源
              - 检查控制器保险
              - 更换控制器（联系厂家）
              
          D1_1_2:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 供电故障
            confidence: 95%
            actions:
              - 合上断路器
              - 检查保险丝
              - 检查电缆连接
              - 联系电气人员检修
              
          Q1_2:
            type: question
            question: 面板显示什么故障代码？
            options:
              - answer: 低油压
                next: D1_2_1
              - answer: 低制冷剂
                next: D1_2_2
              - answer: 电机过载
                next: D1_2_3
              - answer: 冷冻水流量低
                next: D1_2_4
              - answer: 冷却水流量低
                next: D1_2_5
              - answer: 紧急停机
                next: D1_2_6
              - answer: 无故障显示
                next: Q1_3
                
          D1_2_1:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 润滑油压力不足
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 检查油位（视镜）
              - 检查油压传感器
              - 检查油泵运行
              - 必要时加油
              - 检查油过滤器
              
          D1_2_2:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 制冷剂不足
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查制冷剂压力
              - 检漏（检查蒸发器、冷凝器、管路）
              - 补充制冷剂
              - 严重泄漏需停机检修
              
          D1_2_3:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 压缩机电机过载
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查电机电流
              - 检查电源电压
              - 检查冷却水温度（过高导致负荷大）
              - 检查制冷剂充注量
              - 限制冷机负荷后重启
              
          D1_2_4:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷冻水流量不足
            confidence: 90%
            follow_up:
              tree: DT_CHP_CHWFLOW
              
          D1_2_5:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷却水流量不足
            confidence: 90%
            follow_up:
              tree: DT_CHP_CWFLOW
              
          D1_2_6:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 紧急停机（手动）
            confidence: 100%
            actions:
              - 确认现场无紧急情况
              - 检查急停按钮
              - 复位急停按钮
              - 重启冷机
              
          Q1_3:
            type: question
            question: 检查冷机联锁条件
            checks:
              - 冷冻水泵运行？
              - 冷却水泵运行？
              - 冷却塔运行？
              - 冷冻水流量开关？
              - 冷却水流量开关？
            options:
              - answer: 联锁条件不满足
                next: D1_3_1
              - answer: 联锁条件满足
                next: D1_3_2
                
          D1_3_1:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 联锁条件未满足
            confidence: 95%
            actions:
              - 检查并启动冷冻水泵
              - 检查并启动冷却水泵
              - 检查并启动冷却塔
              - 检查流量开关接线
              - 满足联锁后重启冷机
              
          D1_3_2:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 控制逻辑问题或软故障
            confidence: 70%
            actions:
              - 检查BMS控制信号
              - 检查冷机启停时间间隔（防频繁启动）
              - 检查定时器设置
              - 复位控制器
              - 联系厂家技术支持

      # ====== 症状2：冷冻水温度过高 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_CH_HIGH_CHWT
        symptom_name: 冷冻水供水温度过高
        severity: HIGH
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 所有冷机都在运行吗？
            options:
              - answer: 部分冷机未运行
                next: D2_1
              - answer: 所有冷机都在运行
                next: Q2_1
                
          D2_1:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷机台数不足
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 启动更多冷机
              - 检查未运行冷机的故障原因
              - 调整群控策略
              
          Q2_1:
            type: question
            question: 冷机负荷率是多少？
            options:
              - answer: "<80%"
                next: Q2_2
              - answer: "≥80%"
                next: D2_2
                
          D2_2:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷负荷超过冷机容量
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 启动备用冷机
              - 提高冷冻水设定温度（临时）
              - 减少非关键区域负荷
              - 检查是否有设备异常增加负荷
              
          Q2_2:
            type: question
            question: 冷冻水温差是多少？
            checks:
              - 正常温差：4-6℃
              - 检查供回水温度
            options:
              - answer: "温差<3℃"
                next: D2_3
              - answer: "温差正常(3-6℃)"
                next: Q2_3
              - answer: "温差>7℃"
                next: D2_4
                
          D2_3:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷冻水流量过大或阀门泄漏
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查冷冻水泵频率
              - 降低泵频率
              - 检查末端阀门是否全开
              - 检查旁通阀是否异常开启
              
          D2_4:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷冻水流量过小
            confidence: 80%
            follow_up:
              tree: DT_CHP_CHWFLOW
              
          Q2_3:
            type: question
            question: 冷却水温度正常吗？
            checks:
              - 正常冷却水进水温度：<32℃
              - 检查冷却塔出水温度
            options:
              - answer: "冷却水>32℃"
                next: D2_5
              - answer: "冷却水正常"
                next: Q2_4
                
          D2_5:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷却水温度过高
            confidence: 85%
            follow_up:
              tree: DT_CHP_CT
              
          Q2_4:
            type: question
            question: 检查冷机蒸发/冷凝压力
            checks:
              - 蒸发压力是否正常
              - 冷凝压力是否正常
              - 压缩比是否在正常范围
            options:
              - answer: 蒸发压力低
                next: D2_6
              - answer: 冷凝压力高
                next: D2_7
              - answer: 压力正常
                next: D2_8
                
          D2_6:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 蒸发器换热不良或制冷剂不足
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查蒸发器是否结垢
              - 检查制冷剂充注量
              - 清洗蒸发器
              - 补充制冷剂
              
          D2_7:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷凝器换热不良
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查冷凝器是否结垢
              - 检查冷却水流量
              - 清洗冷凝器
              
          D2_8:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 控制系统问题
            confidence: 60%
            actions:
              - 检查冷冻水温度传感器
              - 校准传感器
              - 检查控制器设定

      # ====== 症状3：冷机频繁启停 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_CH_CYCLING
        symptom_name: 冷机频繁启停
        severity: MEDIUM
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 冷机每小时启停几次？
            options:
              - answer: ">4次/小时"
                next: Q3_1
              - answer: "2-4次/小时"
                next: Q3_2
                
          Q3_1:
            type: question
            question: 冷机运行时负荷率多少？
            options:
              - answer: "<30%"
                next: D3_1
              - answer: "30-50%"
                next: D3_2
              - answer: ">50%"
                next: Q3_3
                
          D3_1:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷负荷过小，冷机容量过大
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 停止该冷机，使用更小容量机组
              - 调整群控台数策略
              - 增加冷机最小运行时间设置
              - 考虑安装变频冷机
              
          D3_2:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 控制死区过小
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 增大温度控制死区（±1℃）
              - 调整冷机卸载/加载时间
              - 检查群控逻辑
              
          Q3_3:
            type: question
            question: 是否有故障停机？
            options:
              - answer: 有故障停机
                next: D3_3
              - answer: 无故障，自动停机
                next: D3_4
                
          D3_3:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷机存在间歇性故障
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 查看故障记录
              - 检查相关传感器
              - 检查联锁条件稳定性
              - 联系厂家检修
              
          D3_4:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 群控逻辑问题
            confidence: 70%
            actions:
              - 检查群控策略
              - 调整启停延时
              - 增加运行时间锁定

  # ========================================
  # HVAC-CHP 冷冻水流量诊断树
  # ========================================
  HVAC_CHP_CHW_Flow_Diagnostics:
    
    tree_id: DT_CHP_CHWFLOW
    tree_name: 冷冻水流量故障诊断
    system: HVAC-CHP
    equipment: 冷冻水系统
    
    entry_symptoms:
      
      - symptom_id: SYM_CHWFLOW_LOW
        symptom_name: 冷冻水流量不足
        severity: HIGH
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 冷冻水泵运行正常吗？
            checks:
              - 检查泵运行状态
              - 检查泵电流
              - 检查泵频率
            options:
              - answer: 泵未运行
                next: D_PUMP_NOT_RUN
              - answer: 泵运行正常
                next: Q_PUMP_FREQ
                
          D_PUMP_NOT_RUN:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷冻水泵停止
            confidence: 100%
            actions:
              - 检查泵控制信号
              - 检查泵故障状态
              - 启动泵
              - 如有故障，检修泵
              
          Q_PUMP_FREQ:
            type: question
            question: 泵运行频率多少？
            options:
              - answer: "<30Hz"
                next: D_PUMP_FREQ_LOW
              - answer: "30-45Hz"
                next: Q_PRESSURE
              - answer: ">45Hz"
                next: Q_PRESSURE_HIGH
                
          D_PUMP_FREQ_LOW:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 泵频率过低
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查变频器设定
              - 检查压差传感器
              - 检查压差设定点
              - 手动增加频率测试
              
          Q_PRESSURE:
            type: question
            question: 供回水压差是否正常？
            checks:
              - 正常压差：60-100kPa
            options:
              - answer: "压差<50kPa"
                next: D_BLOCKAGE
              - answer: "压差正常"
                next: Q_VALVE
              - answer: "压差>120kPa"
                next: D_VALVE_CLOSED
                
          D_BLOCKAGE:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 管路阻塞或泵能力不足
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查过滤器是否堵塞
              - 清洗Y型过滤器
              - 检查管路阀门是否全开
              - 检查泵叶轮是否磨损
              
          D_VALVE_CLOSED:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 末端阀门关闭过多
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查末端阀门开度
              - 部分负荷时正常
              - 检查旁通阀是否开启
              
          Q_VALVE:
            type: question
            question: 检查分水器各支路阀门
            options:
              - answer: 有阀门关闭
                next: D_BRANCH_CLOSED
              - answer: 阀门都开启
                next: D_SENSOR_ERROR
                
          D_BRANCH_CLOSED:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 支路阀门关闭
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 开启关闭的阀门
              - 检查电动阀控制信号
              - 检查电动阀执行器
              
          D_SENSOR_ERROR:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 流量传感器故障
            confidence: 70%
            actions:
              - 检查流量计显示
              - 校准流量计
              - 检查流量计供电和信号

  # ========================================
  # HVAC-FCU 风机盘管故障诊断树
  # ========================================
  HVAC_FCU_Diagnostics:
    
    tree_id: DT_FCU
    tree_name: 风机盘管故障诊断
    system: HVAC-FCU
    equipment: 风机盘管
    
    entry_symptoms:
      
      # ====== 症状1：房间温度过高 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_FCU_HOT
        symptom_name: 房间温度过高（制冷季节）
        severity: MEDIUM
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: FCU风机在运行吗？
            checks:
              - 听是否有风机声音
              - 检查出风口是否有风
            options:
              - answer: 风机未运行
                next: Q_FAN_NOT_RUN
              - answer: 风机运行
                next: Q_AIR_COLD
                
          Q_FAN_NOT_RUN:
            type: question
            question: 检查FCU电源和控制
            checks:
              - 检查温控器设置
              - 检查电源开关
              - 检查保险丝
            options:
              - answer: 电源故障
                next: D_FCU_POWER
              - answer: 温控器设置问题
                next: D_FCU_THERMOSTAT
              - answer: 风机电机故障
                next: D_FCU_MOTOR
                
          D_FCU_POWER:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: FCU供电故障
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 检查配电箱FCU回路
              - 检查FCU开关
              - 更换保险丝
              
          D_FCU_THERMOSTAT:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 温控器设置或故障
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 调低温度设定
              - 切换到制冷模式
              - 检查温控器电池
              - 更换温控器
              
          D_FCU_MOTOR:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 风机电机故障
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查电机电阻
              - 检查电容
              - 更换风机电机
              
          Q_AIR_COLD:
            type: question
            question: 出风温度冷吗？
            checks:
              - 用手感受出风温度
              - 正常出风温度：14-18℃
            options:
              - answer: 出风不冷
                next: Q_WATER_COLD
              - answer: 出风较冷
                next: Q_AIR_VOLUME
                
          Q_WATER_COLD:
            type: question
            question: 冷冻水供水管温度如何？
            checks:
              - 用手触摸供水管
              - 正常应该冰凉
            options:
              - answer: 供水管不冷
                next: D_CHW_SUPPLY
              - answer: 供水管冷
                next: Q_VALVE_OPEN
                
          D_CHW_SUPPLY:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷冻水未供应到该区域
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查楼层分水器阀门
              - 检查主冷冻水系统运行
              - 检查该区域管路阀门
              
          Q_VALVE_OPEN:
            type: question
            question: 电动阀开启了吗？
            checks:
              - 检查电动阀开度
              - 听阀门动作声音
            options:
              - answer: 阀门关闭
                next: D_VALVE_CLOSED
              - answer: 阀门开启
                next: D_COIL_BLOCKAGE
                
          D_VALVE_CLOSED:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷水阀未开启
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 检查温控器控制信号
              - 检查阀门执行器
              - 手动开启阀门测试
              - 更换执行器
              
          D_COIL_BLOCKAGE:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 盘管堵塞或结垢
            confidence: 70%
            actions:
              - 检查盘管外部积灰
              - 清洗盘管翅片
              - 检查水流量
              - 冲洗盘管水侧
              
          Q_AIR_VOLUME:
            type: question
            question: 送风量正常吗？
            checks:
              - 各出风口风量
              - 与正常时比较
            options:
              - answer: 风量小
                next: D_FILTER_DIRTY
              - answer: 风量正常
                next: D_LOAD_HIGH
                
          D_FILTER_DIRTY:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 过滤网脏堵
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 清洗或更换过滤网
              - 清洗回风格栅
              - 建立定期清洗制度
              
          D_LOAD_HIGH:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 房间热负荷过大
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查门窗是否关好
              - 检查是否有额外热源
              - 减少室内热源
              - 调高风速档位
              - 考虑增加FCU容量

      # ====== 症状2：FCU漏水 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_FCU_LEAK
        symptom_name: FCU漏水
        severity: HIGH
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 漏水位置在哪里？
            options:
              - answer: 冷凝水盘/接水盘下方
                next: Q_CONDENSATE
              - answer: 冷冻水管接头处
                next: D_PIPE_LEAK
              - answer: FCU机体结露
                next: D_SWEATING
                
          Q_CONDENSATE:
            type: question
            question: 冷凝水管排水通畅吗？
            checks:
              - 检查冷凝水管
              - 检查存水弯
            options:
              - answer: 排水不畅/堵塞
                next: D_DRAIN_BLOCK
              - answer: 排水正常
                next: D_PAN_OVERFLOW
                
          D_DRAIN_BLOCK:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷凝水管堵塞
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 疏通冷凝水管
              - 清洗存水弯
              - 检查管路坡度
              - 建立定期清洗制度
              
          D_PAN_OVERFLOW:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 接水盘溢出
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查接水盘是否变形
              - 检查接水盘安装水平
              - 检查排水口位置
              - 更换接水盘
              
          D_PIPE_LEAK:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷冻水管泄漏
            confidence: 95%
            actions:
              - 关闭该FCU供回水阀
              - 维修管道接头
              - 更换密封件
              - 检查管道保温
              
          D_SWEATING:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 保温层破损导致结露
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查保温层完整性
              - 修补保温层
              - 加强保温

  # ========================================
  # MGAS-O2 医用氧气故障诊断树
  # ========================================
  MGAS_O2_Diagnostics:
    
    tree_id: DT_MGAS_O2
    tree_name: 医用氧气系统故障诊断
    system: MGAS-O2
    equipment: 医用氧气系统
    
    entry_symptoms:
      
      # ====== 症状1：区域氧气压力低 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_O2_LOW_PRESS
        symptom_name: 区域氧气压力低报警
        severity: CRITICAL
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 是单个区域还是多个区域报警？
            options:
              - answer: 单个区域
                next: Q_ZONE_VALVE
              - answer: 多个区域/全院
                next: Q_MAIN_SUPPLY
                
          Q_ZONE_VALVE:
            type: question
            question: 检查该区域区域阀
            options:
              - answer: 区域阀关闭
                next: D_ZONE_VALVE_CLOSED
              - answer: 区域阀开启
                next: Q_ZONE_USAGE
                
          D_ZONE_VALVE_CLOSED:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 区域阀被关闭
            confidence: 95%
            severity: CRITICAL
            actions:
              - 立即开启区域阀
              - 确认用气点恢复供气
              - 调查关闭原因
              - 加强阀门管理
              
          Q_ZONE_USAGE:
            type: question
            question: 该区域用气量是否异常增加？
            checks:
              - 检查病房数量
              - 检查氧气流量
            options:
              - answer: 用气量正常
                next: D_ZONE_LEAK
              - answer: 用气量大增
                next: D_HIGH_DEMAND
                
          D_ZONE_LEAK:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 该区域管路泄漏
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检漏（肥皂水/检漏仪）
              - 检查接头、阀门
              - 维修泄漏点
              
          D_HIGH_DEMAND:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 用气需求超过供气能力
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查主供气系统
              - 调整区域调压阀
              - 增加供气压力（在安全范围内）
              
          Q_MAIN_SUPPLY:
            type: question
            question: 检查主供气系统
            checks:
              - 液氧罐液位
              - 汇流排压力
              - 主管压力
            options:
              - answer: 液氧罐液位低
                next: D_LOX_LOW
              - answer: 汇流排压力低
                next: D_MANIFOLD_LOW
              - answer: 主管压力低
                next: Q_MAIN_VALVE
                
          D_LOX_LOW:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 液氧储量不足
            confidence: 95%
            severity: CRITICAL
            actions:
              - 紧急联系液氧供应商
              - 切换至汇流排备用气源
              - 限制非关键区域用气
              - 通知临床科室
              
          D_MANIFOLD_LOW:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 汇流排气瓶压力低
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 检查气瓶余量
              - 更换气瓶
              - 检查自动切换是否正常
              - 确认备用组充足
              
          Q_MAIN_VALVE:
            type: question
            question: 主管阀门状态如何？
            options:
              - answer: 有阀门关闭
                next: D_MAIN_VALVE_CLOSED
              - answer: 阀门正常
                next: D_MAIN_REGULATOR
                
          D_MAIN_VALVE_CLOSED:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 主管阀门被关闭
            confidence: 95%
            severity: CRITICAL
            actions:
              - 立即开启阀门
              - 确认全院恢复供气
              - 调查关闭原因
              - 加强阀门管理
              
          D_MAIN_REGULATOR:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 主调压阀故障
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查调压阀设定
              - 调整调压阀
              - 必要时更换调压阀
              - 使用备用调压阀

      # ====== 症状2：氧气纯度异常 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_O2_PURITY
        symptom_name: 氧气纯度异常
        severity: CRITICAL
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 纯度测量值是多少？
            checks:
              - 医用氧气纯度要求≥99.5%
            options:
              - answer: "<95%"
                next: D_PURITY_CRITICAL
              - answer: "95-99%"
                next: Q_PURITY_SOURCE
              - answer: "99-99.5%"
                next: D_PURITY_BORDERLINE
                
          D_PURITY_CRITICAL:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 氧气纯度严重不足
            confidence: 95%
            severity: CRITICAL
            actions:
              - 立即切换气源
              - 停止使用当前气源
              - 紧急联系供应商
              - 通知临床科室
              - 检查气源质量报告
              
          Q_PURITY_SOURCE:
            type: question
            question: 当前使用的气源是？
            options:
              - answer: 液氧
                next: D_LOX_QUALITY
              - answer: 汇流排
                next: D_CYLINDER_QUALITY
              - answer: 制氧机
                next: D_GENERATOR_ISSUE
                
          D_LOX_QUALITY:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 液氧质量问题
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查液氧供应商质量报告
              - 取样检测
              - 联系供应商
              - 考虑更换供应商
              
          D_CYLINDER_QUALITY:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 气瓶氧气质量问题
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查气瓶批次
              - 更换气瓶
              - 联系供应商
              
          D_GENERATOR_ISSUE:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 制氧机性能下降
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查分子筛
              - 检查压缩机
              - 更换分子筛
              - 维护制氧机
              
          D_PURITY_BORDERLINE:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 纯度临界，需关注
            confidence: 70%
            actions:
              - 增加纯度监测频率
              - 检查分析仪校准
              - 联系供应商确认

  # ========================================
  # ELEC-EPS 应急电源故障诊断树
  # ========================================
  ELEC_EPS_Diagnostics:
    
    tree_id: DT_ELEC_EPS
    tree_name: 应急电源系统故障诊断
    system: ELEC-EPS
    equipment: 发电机组/ATS
    
    entry_symptoms:
      
      # ====== 症状1：发电机未启动 ======
      - symptom_id: SYM_GEN_NO_START
        symptom_name: 市电中断后发电机未启动
        severity: CRITICAL
        
        diagnostic_tree:
          root:
            type: question
            question: 发电机控制器显示什么状态？
            options:
              - answer: 无显示
                next: D_GEN_POWER
              - answer: 显示故障代码
                next: Q_GEN_FAULT_CODE
              - answer: 显示正常/待机
                next: Q_GEN_MODE
                
          D_GEN_POWER:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 控制器供电故障
            confidence: 90%
            actions:
              - 检查控制电源
              - 检查蓄电池
              - 检查保险丝
              
          Q_GEN_FAULT_CODE:
            type: question
            question: 故障代码是什么？
            options:
              - answer: 低油压
                next: D_LOW_OIL_PRESS
              - answer: 高水温
                next: D_HIGH_WATER_TEMP
              - answer: 过速/欠速
                next: D_SPEED_FAULT
              - answer: 启动失败
                next: Q_START_FAIL
              - answer: 紧急停机
                next: D_EMERGENCY_STOP
                
          D_LOW_OIL_PRESS:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 机油压力低
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查机油液位
              - 添加机油
              - 检查机油滤芯
              - 检查机油泵
              - 复位后重试
              
          D_HIGH_WATER_TEMP:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 冷却水温度高
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查冷却水液位
              - 检查散热器
              - 检查风扇皮带
              - 检查恒温器
              
          D_SPEED_FAULT:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 转速异常
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查调速器
              - 检查转速传感器
              - 检查燃油供应
              
          Q_START_FAIL:
            type: question
            question: 发动机是否有转动？
            options:
              - answer: 启动马达不转
                next: D_STARTER_FAIL
              - answer: 转动但不着火
                next: D_FUEL_ISSUE
                
          D_STARTER_FAIL:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 启动系统故障
            confidence: 85%
            actions:
              - 检查启动电池
              - 检查电池连接
              - 检查启动马达
              - 更换电池/启动马达
              
          D_FUEL_ISSUE:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 燃油供应问题
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查燃油液位
              - 检查燃油滤芯
              - 排除燃油管空气
              - 检查燃油泵
              
          D_EMERGENCY_STOP:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 急停按钮触发
            confidence: 95%
            actions:
              - 确认无紧急情况
              - 复位急停按钮
              - 重启发电机
              
          Q_GEN_MODE:
            type: question
            question: 发电机设置为什么模式？
            options:
              - answer: 手动模式
                next: D_MANUAL_MODE
              - answer: 自动模式
                next: Q_ATS_STATUS
                
          D_MANUAL_MODE:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 发电机设为手动模式
            confidence: 100%
            actions:
              - 切换为自动模式
              - 确认自启动功能正常
              - 测试启动
              
          Q_ATS_STATUS:
            type: question
            question: ATS是否发出启动信号？
            checks:
              - 检查ATS状态
              - 检查启动信号线
            options:
              - answer: 未发出启动信号
                next: D_ATS_FAULT
              - answer: 已发出启动信号
                next: D_SIGNAL_BREAK
                
          D_ATS_FAULT:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: ATS故障
            confidence: 80%
            actions:
              - 检查ATS电源
              - 检查市电检测
              - 检查ATS控制器
              - 手动操作ATS
              
          D_SIGNAL_BREAK:
            type: diagnosis
            diagnosis: 启动信号线路问题
            confidence: 75%
            actions:
              - 检查信号线连接
              - 检查接线端子
              - 修复线路

  # ========================================
  # 通用故障诊断流程
  # ========================================
  General_Diagnostic_Process:
    
    process_id: GDP_STANDARD
    process_name: 标准故障诊断流程
    
    steps:
      - step: 1
        name: 故障接报
        actions:
          - 记录故障时间
          - 记录报警内容
          - 记录报警来源
          - 初步判断严重程度
          
      - step: 2
        name: 初步评估
        actions:
          - 确认故障现象
          - 评估影响范围
          - 判断紧急程度
          - 决定响应级别
          
      - step: 3
        name: 现场检查
        actions:
          - 到达故障现场
          - 观察设备状态
          - 查看报警信息
          - 初步判断原因
          
      - step: 4
        name: 故障诊断
        actions:
          - 使用决策树分析
          - 逐步排除可能原因
          - 确定故障根因
          
      - step: 5
        name: 故障处理
        actions:
          - 制定处理方案
          - 实施修复措施
          - 验证修复效果
          - 恢复正常运行
          
      - step: 6
        name: 记录归档
        actions:
          - 填写故障报告
          - 记录处理过程
          - 总结经验教训
          - 更新知识库
          
    response_time_targets:
      CRITICAL: 15分钟到场
      HIGH: 30分钟到场
      MEDIUM: 2小时内处理
      LOW: 当日处理

  # ========================================
  # 故障诊断知识库
  # ========================================
  Diagnostic_Knowledge_Base:
    
    common_issues:
      
      HVAC:
        - issue: 温度控制不稳
          possible_causes:
            - PID参数不当
            - 传感器位置不佳
            - 控制死区过小
            - 阀门行程不够
            
        - issue: 噪音异常
          possible_causes:
            - 轴承磨损
            - 皮带松动
            - 叶轮不平衡
            - 管道气锤
            
        - issue: 振动过大
          possible_causes:
            - 基础松动
            - 对中不良
            - 轴承损坏
            - 叶轮积垢
            
      ELECTRICAL:
        - issue: 跳闸
          possible_causes:
            - 过载
            - 短路
            - 接地故障
            - 断路器老化
            
        - issue: 接触不良
          possible_causes:
            - 端子松动
            - 氧化腐蚀
            - 导线断股
            - 接线错误
            
      PLUMBING:
        - issue: 压力不稳
          possible_causes:
            - 气囊失压
            - 调节阀故障
            - 泵故障
            - 管网泄漏
            
        - issue: 水质异常
          possible_causes:
            - 水箱污染
            - 管道锈蚀
            - 消毒不足
            - 死水区

DDC_Programming_Framework:

  identity:
    name: 医院BMS系统DDC编程框架
    description: DDC控制器程序结构和编程规范
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024
    applicable_controllers:
      - 西门子 PXC系列
      - 霍尼韦尔 WEB-8000系列
      - 江森自控 FX系列
      - 施耐德 SmartX系列
      
  # ========================================
  # 程序结构框架
  # ========================================
  program_structure:
    
    overview: |
      DDC程序采用模块化结构，分为以下层次：
      1. 硬件层 - I/O映射和通讯
      2. 基础层 - 通用功能块
      3. 设备层 - 设备控制程序
      4. 系统层 - 系统联动逻辑
      5. 接口层 - 上位机通讯
      
    layers:
      
      hardware_layer:
        name: 硬件层
        description: I/O配置和通讯设置
        components:
          - IO_Mapping: 输入输出点映射
          - Comm_Config: 通讯参数配置
          - Network_Setup: 网络设置
          
      foundation_layer:
        name: 基础层
        description: 通用功能模块
        components:
          - PID_Control: PID控制模块
          - Sequence_Control: 顺序控制模块
          - Timer_Counter: 定时计数模块
          - Math_Functions: 数学运算模块
          - Alarm_Handler: 报警处理模块
          
      equipment_layer:
        name: 设备层
        description: 单设备控制程序
        components:
          - Pump_Control: 水泵控制
          - Fan_Control: 风机控制
          - Valve_Control: 阀门控制
          - Chiller_Control: 冷机控制
          - AHU_Control: 空调机组控制
          - FCU_Control: 风机盘管控制
          
      system_layer:
        name: 系统层
        description: 系统级联动控制
        components:
          - CHP_System: 冷热源群控
          - AHU_System: 空调系统控制
          - Fire_Interlock: 消防联动
          - Energy_Management: 能源管理
          
      interface_layer:
        name: 接口层
        description: 上位机通讯接口
        components:
          - BACnet_Interface: BACnet通讯
          - Modbus_Interface: Modbus通讯
          - Data_Logging: 数据记录
          - Alarm_Reporting: 报警上报

  # ========================================
  # 基础功能块定义
  # ========================================
  function_blocks:
    
    # ------ PID控制器 ------
    FB_PID_Controller:
      name: PID控制器功能块
      description: 通用PID控制算法
      
      inputs:
        - name: PV
          type: REAL
          description: 过程变量（测量值）
          
        - name: SP
          type: REAL
          description: 设定值
          
        - name: Enable
          type: BOOL
          description: 使能
          
        - name: Manual
          type: BOOL
          description: 手动模式
          
        - name: ManualOutput
          type: REAL
          description: 手动输出值
          range: [0, 100]
          
        - name: Kp
          type: REAL
          description: 比例系数
          default: 1.0
          
        - name: Ti
          type: REAL
          description: 积分时间(秒)
          default: 300
          
        - name: Td
          type: REAL
          description: 微分时间(秒)
          default: 0
          
        - name: OutputMin
          type: REAL
          description: 输出下限
          default: 0
          
        - name: OutputMax
          type: REAL
          description: 输出上限
          default: 100
          
        - name: Deadband
          type: REAL
          description: 死区
          default: 0.5
          
      outputs:
        - name: Output
          type: REAL
          description: 控制输出
          range: [0, 100]
          
        - name: Error
          type: REAL
          description: 偏差
          
        - name: AtSetpoint
          type: BOOL
          description: 到达设定点
          
      internal_variables:
        - name: Integral
          type: REAL
          description: 积分累计
          
        - name: LastError
          type: REAL
          description: 上次偏差
          
        - name: LastPV
          type: REAL
          description: 上次测量值
          
      algorithm: |
        // PID增量式算法
        IF Enable THEN
          IF NOT Manual THEN
            Error := SP - PV;
            
            // 死区判断
            IF ABS(Error) < Deadband THEN
              AtSetpoint := TRUE;
            ELSE
              AtSetpoint := FALSE;
              
              // 比例项
              P := Kp * Error;
              
              // 积分项（抗积分饱和）
              IF Output > OutputMin AND Output < OutputMax THEN
                Integral := Integral + (Kp * Error * ScanTime) / Ti;
              END_IF;
              
              // 微分项（对PV微分，避免设定点突变）
              D := Kp * Td * (LastPV - PV) / ScanTime;
              
              // 计算输出
              Output := P + Integral + D;
              
              // 输出限幅
              Output := LIMIT(OutputMin, Output, OutputMax);
            END_IF;
            
            LastError := Error;
            LastPV := PV;
          ELSE
            Output := ManualOutput;
            Integral := ManualOutput - Kp * Error; // 无扰切换
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          Output := 0;
          Integral := 0;
        END_IF;

    # ------ 水泵控制 ------
    FB_Pump_Control:
      name: 水泵控制功能块
      description: 单台水泵启停和监控
      
      inputs:
        - name: StartCmd
          type: BOOL
          description: 启动命令
          
        - name: StopCmd
          type: BOOL
          description: 停止命令
          
        - name: AutoMode
          type: BOOL
          description: 自动模式
          
        - name: AutoStart
          type: BOOL
          description: 自动启动信号
          
        - name: RunFeedback
          type: BOOL
          description: 运行反馈
          
        - name: FaultSignal
          type: BOOL
          description: 故障信号
          
        - name: Current
          type: REAL
          description: 运行电流
          unit: A
          
        - name: RatedCurrent
          type: REAL
          description: 额定电流
          unit: A
          
        - name: FrequencyCmd
          type: REAL
          description: 频率命令（变频泵）
          range: [0, 50]
          
        - name: FrequencyFB
          type: REAL
          description: 频率反馈
          
      outputs:
        - name: StartDO
          type: BOOL
          description: 启动DO输出
          
        - name: FrequencyAO
          type: REAL
          description: 频率AO输出
          
        - name: Running
          type: BOOL
          description: 运行状态
          
        - name: Fault
          type: BOOL
          description: 故障状态
          
        - name: RunHours
          type: REAL
          description: 累计运行小时
          
      internal_variables:
        - name: StartTimer
          type: TON
          description: 启动延时
          
        - name: FaultTimer
          type: TON
          description: 故障确认延时
          
        - name: StartAttempts
          type: INT
          description: 启动尝试次数
          
      parameters:
        - name: StartDelay
          value: 5
          unit: s
          description: 启动延时
          
        - name: FaultDelay
          value: 10
          unit: s
          description: 故障确认延时
          
        - name: MaxStartAttempts
          value: 3
          description: 最大启动尝试次数
          
        - name: OverloadThreshold
          value: 110
          unit: "%"
          description: 过载阈值（额定电流百分比）
          
      algorithm: |
        // 故障检测
        IF FaultSignal THEN
          FaultTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#10S);
          IF FaultTimer.Q THEN
            Fault := TRUE;
            StartDO := FALSE;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          FaultTimer(IN:=FALSE);
        END_IF;
        
        // 过载检测
        IF Current > RatedCurrent * OverloadThreshold / 100 THEN
          Fault := TRUE;
          StartDO := FALSE;
        END_IF;
        
        // 运行反馈检测
        IF StartDO AND NOT RunFeedback THEN
          StartTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#30S);
          IF StartTimer.Q THEN
            StartAttempts := StartAttempts + 1;
            IF StartAttempts >= MaxStartAttempts THEN
              Fault := TRUE;
              StartDO := FALSE;
            ELSE
              StartDO := FALSE; // 重试
              // 等待后重试
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          StartTimer(IN:=FALSE);
          StartAttempts := 0;
        END_IF;
        
        // 启停控制
        IF NOT Fault THEN
          IF AutoMode THEN
            StartDO := AutoStart;
          ELSE
            IF StartCmd AND NOT StopCmd THEN
              StartDO := TRUE;
            ELSIF StopCmd THEN
              StartDO := FALSE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        END_IF;
        
        // 状态输出
        Running := StartDO AND RunFeedback;
        
        // 运行小时累计
        IF Running THEN
          RunHours := RunHours + ScanTime / 3600;
        END_IF;
        
        // 频率输出（变频泵）
        IF Running THEN
          FrequencyAO := FrequencyCmd;
        ELSE
          FrequencyAO := 0;
        END_IF;

    # ------ 阀门控制 ------
    FB_Valve_Control:
      name: 阀门控制功能块
      description: 电动阀门控制
      
      inputs:
        - name: PositionCmd
          type: REAL
          description: 位置命令
          range: [0, 100]
          
        - name: PositionFB
          type: REAL
          description: 位置反馈
          range: [0, 100]
          
        - name: OpenLimit
          type: BOOL
          description: 全开限位
          
        - name: CloseLimit
          type: BOOL
          description: 全关限位
          
        - name: ManualMode
          type: BOOL
          description: 手动模式
          
        - name: ManualPosition
          type: REAL
          description: 手动位置
          
      outputs:
        - name: PositionAO
          type: REAL
          description: 位置输出
          range: [0, 100]
          
        - name: OpenDO
          type: BOOL
          description: 开阀DO
          
        - name: CloseDO
          type: BOOL
          description: 关阀DO
          
        - name: Fault
          type: BOOL
          description: 故障状态
          
      algorithm: |
        // 模式选择
        IF ManualMode THEN
          TargetPosition := ManualPosition;
        ELSE
          TargetPosition := PositionCmd;
        END_IF;
        
        // 模拟量输出阀门
        PositionAO := TargetPosition;
        
        // 开关量输出阀门（如有）
        IF PositionFB < TargetPosition - 5 THEN
          OpenDO := TRUE;
          CloseDO := FALSE;
        ELSIF PositionFB > TargetPosition + 5 THEN
          OpenDO := FALSE;
          CloseDO := TRUE;
        ELSE
          OpenDO := FALSE;
          CloseDO := FALSE;
        END_IF;
        
        // 故障检测（阀门卡死）
        IF ABS(PositionFB - TargetPosition) > 10 THEN
          FaultTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#60S);
          IF FaultTimer.Q THEN
            Fault := TRUE;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          FaultTimer(IN:=FALSE);
        END_IF;

    # ------ 风机控制 ------
    FB_Fan_Control:
      name: 风机控制功能块
      description: 风机启停和变频控制
      
      inputs:
        - name: StartCmd
          type: BOOL
          description: 启动命令
          
        - name: StopCmd
          type: BOOL
          description: 停止命令
          
        - name: AutoMode
          type: BOOL
          description: 自动模式
          
        - name: AutoStart
          type: BOOL
          description: 自动启动信号
          
        - name: FrequencyCmd
          type: REAL
          description: 频率命令
          range: [0, 50]
          
        - name: RunFeedback
          type: BOOL
          description: 运行反馈
          
        - name: FaultSignal
          type: BOOL
          description: 故障信号
          
        - name: FilterDP
          type: REAL
          description: 过滤器压差
          unit: Pa
          
        - name: FilterDPAlarm
          type: REAL
          description: 过滤器报警阈值
          unit: Pa
          
      outputs:
        - name: StartDO
          type: BOOL
          description: 启动DO输出
          
        - name: FrequencyAO
          type: REAL
          description: 频率AO输出
          
        - name: Running
          type: BOOL
          description: 运行状态
          
        - name: Fault
          type: BOOL
          description: 故障状态
          
        - name: FilterAlarm
          type: BOOL
          description: 过滤器报警
          
        - name: RunHours
          type: REAL
          description: 累计运行小时
          
      algorithm: |
        // 过滤器报警
        FilterAlarm := FilterDP > FilterDPAlarm;
        
        // 故障检测
        Fault := FaultSignal;
        
        // 启停控制（同水泵）
        IF NOT Fault THEN
          IF AutoMode THEN
            StartDO := AutoStart;
          ELSE
            IF StartCmd AND NOT StopCmd THEN
              StartDO := TRUE;
            ELSIF StopCmd THEN
              StartDO := FALSE;
            END_IF;
          END_IF;
        ELSE
          StartDO := FALSE;
        END_IF;
        
        // 状态输出
        Running := StartDO AND RunFeedback;
        
        // 频率输出
        IF Running THEN
          FrequencyAO := FrequencyCmd;
        ELSE
          FrequencyAO := 0;
        END_IF;
        
        // 运行小时累计
        IF Running THEN
          RunHours := RunHours + ScanTime / 3600;
        END_IF;

  # ========================================
  # 冷热源群控程序
  # ========================================
  CHP_Group_Control:
    
    program_id: PRG_CHP_GROUP
    program_name: 冷热源群控程序
    description: 冷机群控和优化运行
    
    modules:
      
      # ------ 冷机群控 ------
      Chiller_Sequencing:
        name: 冷机台数控制
        description: 根据负荷确定运行台数
        
        inputs:
          - name: TotalCoolingLoad
            type: REAL
            description: 总冷负荷(kW)
            
          - name: ChillerCapacity
            type: ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL
            description: 各冷机容量(kW)
            
          - name: ChillerAvailable
            type: ARRAY[1..4] OF BOOL
            description: 各冷机可用状态
            
          - name: ChillerRunning
            type: ARRAY[1..4] OF BOOL
            description: 各冷机运行状态
            
          - name: ChillerLoadPercent
            type: ARRAY[1..4] OF REAL
            description: 各冷机负荷率(%)
            
          - name: CHWST
            type: REAL
            description: 冷冻水供水温度
            
          - name: CHWST_SP
            type: REAL
            description: 冷冻水温度设定
            
        outputs:
          - name: ChillerStartCmd
            type: ARRAY[1..4] OF BOOL
            description: 各冷机启动命令
            
          - name: ActiveChillers
            type: INT
            description: 运行冷机台数
            
        parameters:
          - name: LoadOnThreshold
            value: 85
            unit: "%"
            description: 加机阈值
            
          - name: LoadOffThreshold
            value: 40
            unit: "%"
            description: 减机阈值
            
          - name: MinRunTime
            value: 15
            unit: min
            description: 最小运行时间
            
          - name: StartDelay
            value: 5
            unit: min
            description: 加机延时
            
          - name: StopDelay
            value: 10
            unit: min
            description: 减机延时
            
          - name: RotationEnabled
            value: true
            description: 启用轮换
            
          - name: RotationInterval
            value: 500
            unit: h
            description: 轮换间隔
            
        algorithm: |
          // 计算总可用容量
          TotalCapacity := 0;
          FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            IF ChillerAvailable[i] THEN
              TotalCapacity := TotalCapacity + ChillerCapacity[i];
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
          
          // 计算当前负荷率
          RunningCapacity := 0;
          FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
            IF ChillerRunning[i] THEN
              RunningCapacity := RunningCapacity + ChillerCapacity[i];
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
          
          IF RunningCapacity > 0 THEN
            AvgLoadPercent := TotalCoolingLoad / RunningCapacity * 100;
          ELSE
            AvgLoadPercent := 0;
          END_IF;
          
          // 加机逻辑
          IF CHWST > CHWST_SP + 1.0 OR AvgLoadPercent > LoadOnThreshold THEN
            AddChillerTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#5M);
            IF AddChillerTimer.Q THEN
              // 选择下一台冷机（按优先级或运行时间）
              NextChiller := SelectNextChiller();
              IF NextChiller > 0 THEN
                ChillerStartCmd[NextChiller] := TRUE;
              END_IF;
              AddChillerTimer(IN:=FALSE);
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            AddChillerTimer(IN:=FALSE);
          END_IF;
          
          // 减机逻辑
          IF CHWST < CHWST_SP - 0.5 AND AvgLoadPercent < LoadOffThreshold THEN
            RemoveChillerTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#10M);
            IF RemoveChillerTimer.Q THEN
              // 选择要停止的冷机
              StopChiller := SelectChillerToStop();
              IF StopChiller > 0 THEN
                ChillerStartCmd[StopChiller] := FALSE;
              END_IF;
              RemoveChillerTimer(IN:=FALSE);
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            RemoveChillerTimer(IN:=FALSE);
          END_IF;
          
          // 轮换逻辑
          IF RotationEnabled THEN
            FOR i := 1 TO 4 DO
              IF ChillerRunHours[i] >= RotationInterval THEN
                RotateChillers(i);
              END_IF;
            END_FOR;
          END_IF;
          
      # ------ 冷冻水泵变频控制 ------
      CHWP_VFD_Control:
        name: 冷冻水泵变频控制
        description: 压差控制泵速
        
        control_strategy: |
          采用供回水压差控制：
          1. 测量最不利点压差或主环压差
          2. PID调节泵频率维持压差设定
          3. 最小频率保护
          4. 多泵群控和轮换
          
        inputs:
          - name: DP_Measured
            type: REAL
            description: 实测压差(kPa)
            
          - name: DP_Setpoint
            type: REAL
            description: 压差设定(kPa)
            
          - name: PumpAvailable
            type: ARRAY[1..5] OF BOOL
            description: 泵可用状态
            
          - name: PumpRunning
            type: ARRAY[1..5] OF BOOL
            description: 泵运行状态
            
        outputs:
          - name: PumpStartCmd
            type: ARRAY[1..5] OF BOOL
            description: 泵启动命令
            
          - name: PumpFrequency
            type: REAL
            description: 泵频率设定(Hz)
            
        algorithm: |
          // PID压差控制
          PID_DP.SP := DP_Setpoint;
          PID_DP.PV := DP_Measured;
          PID_DP();
          PumpFrequency := PID_DP.Output * 0.5 + 25; // 25-50Hz
          
          // 多泵控制
          IF PumpFrequency > 48 THEN
            // 加泵
            AddPumpTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#5M);
            IF AddPumpTimer.Q THEN
              StartNextPump();
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            AddPumpTimer(IN:=FALSE);
          END_IF;
          
          IF PumpFrequency < 30 AND RunningPumps > 1 THEN
            // 减泵
            RemovePumpTimer(IN:=TRUE, PT:=T#10M);
            IF RemovePumpTimer.Q THEN
              StopOnePump();
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            RemovePumpTimer(IN:=FALSE);
          END_IF;

      # ------ 冷却塔控制 ------
      Cooling_Tower_Control:
        name: 冷却塔控制
        description: 冷却塔风机变频控制
        
        control_strategy: |
          根据冷却水回水温度控制冷却塔风机：
          1. PID控制维持冷却水温度
          2. 多塔群控
          3. 节能运行（室外湿球温度补偿）
          
        algorithm: |
          // 计算冷却水温度设定（节能优化）
          // 设定值 = 室外湿球温度 + 逼近度(3-5℃)
          CWRT_SP := WetBulbTemp + 4.0;
          CWRT_SP := LIMIT(25.0, CWRT_SP, 32.0);
          
          // PID控制
          PID_CT.SP := CWRT_SP;
          PID_CT.PV := CWRT_Measured;
          PID_CT();
          CTFanFrequency := PID_CT.Output * 0.5 + 25;
          
          // 冬季防冻
          IF OutdoorTemp < 5 THEN
            CTFanFrequency := LIMIT(0, CTFanFrequency, 25);
          END_IF;

  # ========================================
  # AHU控制程序
  # ========================================
  AHU_Control_Program:
    
    program_id: PRG_AHU_CONTROL
    program_name: 空调机组控制程序
    description: 单台AHU完整控制逻辑
    
    modules:
      
      # ------ 启停控制 ------
      AHU_Start_Stop:
        name: AHU启停控制
        description: 机组启停顺序控制
        
        start_sequence:
          - step: 1
            action: 开启新风阀至最小新风位置
            duration: 30s
            
          - step: 2
            action: 开启回风阀
            duration: 10s
            
          - step: 3
            action: 启动送风机
            duration: 10s
            
          - step: 4
            action: 确认送风机运行
            timeout: 30s
            fault_action: 报警并停止
            
          - step: 5
            action: 启动回风机（如有）
            duration: 10s
            
          - step: 6
            action: 投入温度控制
            
        stop_sequence:
          - step: 1
            action: 关闭冷热水阀
            
          - step: 2
            action: 停止回风机
            duration: 5s
            
          - step: 3
            action: 延时停止送风机
            delay: 30s
            
          - step: 4
            action: 关闭新风阀和回风阀
            
      # ------ 温度控制 ------
      AHU_Temp_Control:
        name: 送风温度控制
        description: 级联控制送风温度
        
        control_modes:
          cooling_mode:
            condition: 室外温度>切换点 OR 制冷季节
            control:
              - 热水阀关闭
              - 新风阀参与节能
              - 冷水阀PID控制送风温度
              
          heating_mode:
            condition: 室外温度<切换点 OR 供暖季节
            control:
              - 冷水阀关闭
              - 新风阀最小开度
              - 热水阀PID控制送风温度
              
          economizer_mode:
            condition: 室外温度适宜
            control:
              - 冷热水阀关闭
              - 新风阀PID控制（100%新风可能）
              
        algorithm: |
          // 送风温度设定（可复位）
          IF ResetEnabled THEN
            // 根据回风温度或室外温度复位
            SAT_SP := SAT_Base + (RAT - RAT_Base) * ResetRatio;
            SAT_SP := LIMIT(SAT_Min, SAT_SP, SAT_Max);
          ELSE
            SAT_SP := SAT_Fixed;
          END_IF;
          
          // PID控制
          PID_SAT.SP := SAT_SP;
          PID_SAT.PV := SAT;
          PID_SAT();
          
          // 模式判断
          IF CoolingMode THEN
            HWV_Cmd := 0;
            IF EconomizerMode THEN
              // 先用新风冷却
              OAD_Cmd := PID_SAT.Output;
              IF OAD_Cmd >= 95 THEN
                // 新风不够，使用冷水
                CHW_Cmd := (PID_SAT.Output - 95) * 20;
              ELSE
                CHW_Cmd := 0;
              END_IF;
            ELSE
              OAD_Cmd := MinOA;
              CHW_Cmd := PID_SAT.Output;
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            // 供暖模式
            CHW_Cmd := 0;
            OAD_Cmd := MinOA;
            HWV_Cmd := PID_SAT.Output;
          END_IF;
          
      # ------ 湿度控制 ------
      AHU_Humidity_Control:
        name: 湿度控制
        description: 加湿/除湿控制
        
        algorithm: |
          // 湿度PID
          PID_Humidity.SP := Humidity_SP;
          PID_Humidity.PV := SAH;
          PID_Humidity();
          
          IF SAH < Humidity_SP - DeadBand THEN
            // 需要加湿
            Humidifier_Cmd := PID_Humidity.Output;
          ELSIF SAH > Humidity_SP + DeadBand THEN
            // 需要除湿（通过降低冷水阀开度或专用除湿）
            IF HasDesiccant THEN
              Desiccant_Cmd := PID_Humidity.Output;
            ELSE
              // 再热除湿
              // 降低送风温度增加除湿，再加热回设定温度
            END_IF;
          ELSE
            Humidifier_Cmd := 0;
          END_IF;
          
      # ------ 压力控制 ------
      AHU_Pressure_Control:
        name: 静压控制
        description: 风管静压控制
        
        algorithm: |
          // 送风静压PID控制送风机频率
          PID_DuctSP.SP := DuctSP_Setpoint;
          PID_DuctSP.PV := DuctSP_Measured;
          PID_DuctSP();
          SF_Frequency := PID_DuctSP.Output * 0.5 + 25;
          
          // 静压复位（节能）
          IF SPResetEnabled THEN
            // 根据末端阀门开度复位静压设定
            MaxValvePos := MAX(VAV_Positions);
            IF MaxValvePos > 95 THEN
              DuctSP_Setpoint := DuctSP_Setpoint + 5; // 增加静压
            ELSIF MaxValvePos < 80 THEN
              DuctSP_Setpoint := DuctSP_Setpoint - 5; // 降低静压
            END_IF;
            DuctSP_Setpoint := LIMIT(MinSP, DuctSP_Setpoint, MaxSP);
          END_IF;

  # ========================================
  # 消防联动程序
  # ========================================
  Fire_Interlock_Program:
    
    program_id: PRG_FIRE_INTERLOCK
    program_name: 消防联动程序
    description: 火灾时HVAC系统响应
    
    inputs:
      - name: FireAlarm
        type: BOOL
        description: 火灾确认信号
        from: FIRE-FAS
        
      - name: FireFloor
        type: INT
        description: 着火楼层
        from: FIRE-FAS
        
      - name: SmokeExhaustStart
        type: BOOL
        description: 排烟系统启动
        from: FIRE-EXH
        
    actions:
      
      - action_id: FA_AHU_STOP
        name: 关闭AHU
        description: 着火区域AHU停止
        trigger: FireAlarm = TRUE
        logic: |
          FOR i := 1 TO AHU_Count DO
            IF AHU_Location[i] = FireFloor THEN
              AHU_Enable[i] := FALSE;
              AHU_OAD[i] := 0; // 关闭新风阀
              AHU_CHW[i] := 0;
              AHU_HW[i] := 0;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
          
      - action_id: FA_FCU_STOP
        name: 关闭FCU
        description: 着火楼层FCU停止
        trigger: FireAlarm = TRUE
        logic: |
          FOR i := 1 TO FloorHeader_Count DO
            IF FloorHeader_Location[i] = FireFloor THEN
              FloorHeader_Valve[i] := 0; // 关闭楼层供水阀
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
          
      - action_id: FA_FIRE_DAMPER
        name: 防火阀联动
        description: 关闭穿越防火分区的防火阀
        trigger: FireAlarm = TRUE
        logic: |
          // 防火阀由FAS直接控制
          // DDC监控状态
          FOR i := 1 TO FireDamper_Count DO
            FireDamper_Status[i]; // 读取状态
            IF FireDamper_Zone[i] = FireFloor THEN
              IF FireDamper_Status[i] = OPEN THEN
                // 报警：防火阀未关闭
                Alarm_FireDamperNotClosed[i] := TRUE;
              END_IF;
            END_IF;
          END_FOR;
          
      - action_id: FA_BACKUP_COOLING
        name: 启动备用冷源
        description: 关键区域切换备用冷源
        trigger: FireAlarm = TRUE
        logic: |
          IF CriticalAreaAffected THEN
            // 启动备用风冷冷水机
            BackupChiller_Enable := TRUE;
            // 切换关键区域至备用冷源
            CriticalArea_Valve_Main := 0;
            CriticalArea_Valve_Backup := 100;
          END_IF;
          
    recovery:
      trigger: FireAlarm = FALSE (手动复位)
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          action: 确认火灾已扑灭
          
        - step: 2
          action: 检查设备状态
          
        - step: 3
          action: 逐步恢复着火楼层HVAC
          delay: 按操作员确认
          
        - step: 4
          action: 关键区域切回主冷源
          condition: 主冷源正常
          
        - step: 5
          action: 全部恢复正常运行

  # ========================================
  # 编程规范
  # ========================================
  programming_standards:
    
    naming_convention:
      variables:
        - pattern: "{Type}_{System}_{Equipment}_{Function}"
        - examples:
            - "AI_CHP_CH01_CHWST"
            - "DO_AHU_01_SF_START"
            - "PID_CHP_DP"
            
      function_blocks:
        - pattern: "FB_{Function}"
        - examples:
            - "FB_PID_Controller"
            - "FB_Pump_Control"
            
      programs:
        - pattern: "PRG_{System}_{Function}"
        - examples:
            - "PRG_CHP_GROUP"
            - "PRG_AHU_CONTROL"
            
    documentation:
      requirements:
        - 程序头部注释（作者、日期、版本、描述）
        - 变量注释（功能、单位、范围）
        - 关键逻辑注释
        - 修改记录
        
      template: |
        //==============================================
        // 程序名称：{Program Name}
        // 功能描述：{Description}
        // 作者：{Author}
        // 创建日期：{Date}
        // 版本：{Version}
        // 修改记录：
        //   {Date} - {Author} - {Changes}
        //==============================================
        
    error_handling:
      - 所有输入进行范围检查
      - 传感器故障检测和替代值
      - 通讯中断处理
      - 异常状态报警
      
    testing:
      - 单元测试各功能块
      - 集成测试系统联动
      - 模拟故障测试
      - 消防联动测试

BMS_Network_Architecture:

  identity:
    name: 医院BMS系统网络架构
    description: 楼宇自动化系统网络拓扑和通讯协议
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  # ========================================
  # 网络层级结构
  # ========================================
  network_hierarchy:
    
    overview: |
      采用三层网络架构：
      - 管理层：服务器、工作站、与其他系统集成
      - 自动化层：DDC控制器互联
      - 现场层：I/O设备和传感器
      
    layers:
      
      management_layer:
        name: 管理层网络
        description: IT级网络，承载管理系统
        
        network_type: Ethernet TCP/IP
        speed: 1Gbps
        topology: 星型
        
        devices:
          ba_server:
            name: BA服务器
            type: 工业服务器
            redundancy: 主备冗余
            ip_address: 10.1.1.10/11
            os: Windows Server 2019
            software: BMS管理软件
            
          workstations:
            name: 操作工作站
            type: 工业PC
            quantity: 5
            ip_range: 10.1.1.20-24
            locations:
              - 中控室（2台）
              - 冷冻机房（1台）
              - 配电室（1台）
              - 锅炉房（1台）
              
          web_server:
            name: Web服务器
            type: 应用服务器
            ip_address: 10.1.1.15
            function: 远程访问、移动端
            
          historian:
            name: 历史数据库服务器
            type: 数据库服务器
            ip_address: 10.1.1.16
            database: SQL Server/InfluxDB
            storage: 100TB
            retention: 5年
            
        integration_points:
          - name: FIRE-FAS集成
            protocol: BACnet/IP
            address: 10.1.1.50
            direction: 双向
            
          - name: HIS系统集成
            protocol: OPC UA
            address: 10.1.1.60
            direction: 读取
            
          - name: 能源管理系统
            protocol: Modbus TCP
            address: 10.1.1.70
            direction: 双向
            
      automation_layer:
        name: 自动化层网络
        description: 控制器互联网络
        
        network_type: BACnet/IP over Ethernet
        speed: 100Mbps
        topology: 星型/环形
        redundancy: 环网冗余（可选）
        
        backbone_switch:
          name: 自动化层核心交换机
          type: 工业以太网交换机
          model: Hirschmann RSP/MOXA
          ports: 24口千兆+2口光纤
          features:
            - 工业级设计
            - 冗余电源
            - 环网支持
            - VLAN划分
          ip_address: 10.1.2.1
          
        floor_switches:
          name: 楼层交换机
          type: 工业以太网交换机
          quantity: 每层1台
          ports: 8-16口百兆
          ip_range: 10.1.2.10-30
          
        ddc_controllers:
          naming: DDC-{System}-{Number}
          ip_range: 10.1.2.100-200
          
          instances:
            - name: DDC-CHP-01
              ip: 10.1.2.100
              location: 冷冻机房
              points: 300
              
            - name: DDC-CHP-02
              ip: 10.1.2.101
              location: 冷冻机房
              points: 300
              
            - name: DDC-AHU-01
              ip: 10.1.2.110
              location: 1F空调机房
              points: 200
              
            - name: DDC-AHU-02
              ip: 10.1.2.111
              location: 2F空调机房
              points: 200
              
            # ... 更多控制器
            
      field_layer:
        name: 现场层网络
        description: I/O设备和传感器连接
        
        bus_types:
          bacnet_mstp:
            name: BACnet MS/TP
            description: 楼层末端控制器
            medium: RS-485
            speed: 76800 bps
            max_devices: 127
            max_length: 1200m
            termination: 两端120Ω终端电阻
            application:
              - 风机盘管控制器
              - VAV控制器
              - 房间温控器
              
          modbus_rtu:
            name: Modbus RTU
            description: 第三方设备集成
            medium: RS-485
            speed: 9600/19200 bps
            max_devices: 247
            application:
              - 电表
              - 变频器
              - 部分冷机
              
          lonworks:
            name: LonWorks
            description: 照明和部分设备
            medium: TP/FT-10
            speed: 78kbps
            application:
              - 智能照明
              - 部分FCU
              
          knx:
            name: KNX
            description: 智能照明
            medium: TP1
            speed: 9600bps
            application:
              - 智能照明系统
              - 窗帘控制
              
          io_link:
            name: IO-Link
            description: 传感器直连
            application:
              - 智能传感器
              - 执行器

  # ========================================
  # 网络拓扑图
  # ========================================
  network_topology:
    
    diagram: |
      ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
      │                        管理层网络 (10.1.1.0/24)                   │
      │  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐        │
