  # ========================================
  # 通讯协议配置
  # ========================================
  communication_protocols:
    
    bacnet_ip:
      name: BACnet/IP
      description: 主控制器间通讯
      
      configuration:
        port: 47808 (0xBAC0)
        bbmd: 10.1.2.1
        foreign_device: 支持
        
      object_types:
        - Analog Input (AI)
        - Analog Output (AO)
        - Analog Value (AV)
        - Binary Input (BI)
        - Binary Output (BO)
        - Binary Value (BV)
        - Multi-State Input (MSI)
        - Multi-State Output (MSO)
        - Schedule
        - Calendar
        - Trend Log
        - Notification Class
        
      services:
        - ReadProperty
        - WriteProperty
        - SubscribeCOV
        - ConfirmedEventNotification
        - WhoIs/IAm
        - ReadPropertyMultiple
        - WritePropertyMultiple
        
    bacnet_mstp:
      name: BACnet MS/TP
      description: 末端控制器通讯
      
      configuration:
        baud_rate: 76800
        max_master: 127
        token_timeout: 50ms
        max_info_frames: 1
        
      wiring:
        cable: 屏蔽双绞线 (RVSP 2×0.75)
        termination: 120Ω at both ends
        max_length: 1200m
        stub_length: <1.5m
        
    modbus_tcp:
      name: Modbus TCP
      description: 电表和第三方设备
      
      configuration:
        port: 502
        unit_id: 1-247
        timeout: 1000ms
        retries: 3
        
      function_codes:
        - 01: 读线圈
        - 02: 读离散输入
        - 03: 读保持寄存器
        - 04: 读输入寄存器
        - 05: 写单个线圈
        - 06: 写单个寄存器
        - 15: 写多个线圈
        - 16: 写多个寄存器
        
    opc_ua:
      name: OPC UA
      description: 与IT系统集成
      
      configuration:
        endpoint: opc.tcp://10.1.1.10:4840
        security_mode: SignAndEncrypt
        security_policy: Basic256Sha256
        authentication: Username/Password
        
      features:
        - 发现服务
        - 订阅/发布
        - 历史数据访问
        - 报警和事件
        
  # ========================================
  # 网络安全
  # ========================================
  network_security:
    
    segmentation:
      - 管理层与自动化层VLAN隔离
      - 防火墙规则限制访问
      - 只允许必要端口通讯
      
    access_control:
      - 用户认证和授权
      - 角色权限管理
      - 操作审计日志
      
    encryption:
      - BACnet/SC安全扩展（可选）
      - OPC UA加密通讯
      - VPN远程访问
      
    monitoring:
      - 网络流量监控
      - 异常行为检测
      - 入侵检测系统
      
  # ========================================
  # 冗余设计
  # ========================================
  redundancy_design:
    
    server_redundancy:
      type: 主备热备
      failover_time: <30s
      data_sync: 实时同步
      
    network_redundancy:
      type: 环网冗余（可选）
      protocol: RSTP/MRP
      recovery_time: <50ms
      
    controller_redundancy:
      critical_systems:
        - 冷冻机房DDC：双机热备
        - 手术室DDC：双机热备
      failover_time: <10s
      
    power_redundancy:
      ups: 所有网络设备UPS供电
      duration: >30min

Annual_Maintenance_Plan:

  identity:
    name: 医院机电系统年度维护保养计划
    description: 全年维护保养计划和检查项目
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024
    
  # ========================================
  # 维护分类
  # ========================================
  maintenance_categories:
    
    preventive:
      name: 预防性维护
      description: 定期计划维护，防止故障发生
      frequency: 日/周/月/季/年
      
    predictive:
      name: 预测性维护
      description: 基于状态监测的维护
      methods:
        - 振动分析
        - 热成像
        - 油液分析
        - 电气测试
        
    corrective:
      name: 纠正性维护
      description: 故障后修复
      response_time: 根据故障等级
      
  # ========================================
  # HVAC系统维护计划
  # ========================================
  HVAC_Maintenance:
    
    # ------ 冷水机组 ------
    Chiller:
      equipment: 冷水机组
      
      daily:
        - item: 运行参数记录
          action: 记录供回水温度、压力、电流、功率
          responsible: 值班人员
          
        - item: 异常声音检查
          action: 巡检听诊异常噪音
          
        - item: 泄漏检查
          action: 目视检查制冷剂和油泄漏
          
      weekly:
        - item: 机组外观清洁
          action: 清洁机组外壳和控制柜
          
        - item: 冷冻水/冷却水压差检查
          action: 检查压差是否在正常范围
          
      monthly:
        - item: 蒸发器/冷凝器压差
          action: 记录压差，判断是否需要清洗
          threshold: 压差增加>30%需清洗
          
        - item: 机油液位检查
          action: 检查油镜液位
          
        - item: 控制柜检查
          action: 检查接线、指示灯、报警记录
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 制冷剂压力检测
          action: 检测高低压压力
          
        - item: 机组效率测试
          action: 计算COP，与额定值比较
          
        - item: 安全装置测试
          action: 测试高低压保护、流量开关
          
      semi_annual:
        - item: 蒸发器清洗
          action: 根据压差判断，必要时化学清洗
          
        - item: 冷凝器清洗
          action: 高压水枪或化学清洗
          
        - item: 机油分析
          action: 取样分析油品质量
          
        - item: 振动测量
          action: 测量压缩机振动
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 检查压缩机
            - 检查电机绝缘
            - 更换机油
            - 更换滤芯
            - 校准传感器
            - 检查制冷剂充注量
          responsible: 厂家或专业公司
          duration: 2-3天/台
          
    # ------ 冷却塔 ------
    Cooling_Tower:
      equipment: 冷却塔
      
      daily:
        - item: 水位检查
          action: 检查补水正常
          
        - item: 风机运行检查
          action: 检查风机声音和振动
          
      weekly:
        - item: 布水器检查
          action: 检查布水均匀性
          
        - item: 水质检查
          action: 检查浊度、pH、电导率
          
      monthly:
        - item: 填料检查
          action: 检查填料是否堵塞或损坏
          
        - item: 水处理药剂检查
          action: 检查药剂余量和投加效果
          
        - item: 皮带检查
          action: 检查传动皮带张紧度
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 冷却塔效率测试
          action: 测试逼近温度
          
        - item: 集水盘清洗
          action: 排空清洗集水盘
          
      semi_annual:
        - item: 填料清洗
          action: 高压水枪清洗填料
          
        - item: 防腐检查
          action: 检查并补刷防腐涂料
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 更换轴承（必要时）
            - 检查减速器
            - 更换皮带
            - 检查风机叶片
            - 防腐处理
            
      winterization:
        season: 冬季停用前
        actions:
          - 排空集水盘和管道
          - 加防冻液或伴热
          - 覆盖防护
          
    # ------ AHU ------
    AHU:
      equipment: 空调机组
      
      daily:
        - item: 运行状态检查
          action: 检查温湿度、压差显示
          
        - item: 异常声音检查
          action: 巡检听诊异常噪音
          
      weekly:
        - item: 过滤器压差检查
          action: 检查初效/中效压差
          
        - item: 皮带检查
          action: 检查皮带张紧度和磨损
          
        - item: 冷凝水排放检查
          action: 检查排水是否通畅
          
      monthly:
        - item: 初效过滤器清洗/更换
          action: 清洗或更换初效过滤器
          frequency: 每月1次（污染大时更频繁）
          
        - item: 阀门动作测试
          action: 测试电动阀开关动作
          
        - item: 加湿器检查
          action: 检查加湿器运行和清洁
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 中效过滤器更换
          action: 更换中效过滤器
          
        - item: 盘管清洗
          action: 清洗盘管翅片
          
        - item: 风机轴承润滑
          action: 添加润滑脂
          
        - item: 皮带更换
          action: 必要时更换皮带
          
      semi_annual:
        - item: 高效过滤器检查
          action: 检查高效过滤器（手术室等）
          
        - item: 风机振动测量
          action: 测量振动值
          
        - item: 电机绝缘测试
          action: 测试电机绝缘电阻
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 更换所有过滤器
            - 清洗机组内部
            - 检查保温层
            - 校准传感器
            - 检查控制器程序
            
    # ------ FCU ------
    FCU:
      equipment: 风机盘管
      
      quarterly:
        - item: 过滤网清洗
          action: 取出清洗回风过滤网
          
        - item: 冷凝水盘检查
          action: 检查排水是否通畅
          
        - item: 风机运行检查
          action: 检查风机声音和风量
          
      semi_annual:
        - item: 盘管清洗
          action: 清洗盘管翅片
          method: 压缩空气或水冲洗
          
        - item: 电动阀检查
          action: 检查阀门动作
          
      annual:
        - item: 风机电机检查
          action: 检查电机和电容
          
        - item: 保温层检查
          action: 检查管道保温完整性
          
  # ========================================
  # 电气系统维护计划
  # ========================================
  Electrical_Maintenance:
    
    # ------ 变压器 ------
    Transformer:
      equipment: 干式变压器
      
      monthly:
        - item: 外观检查
          action: 检查绕组、引线、绝缘
          
        - item: 温度检查
          action: 记录各相绕组温度
          
        - item: 通风检查
          action: 检查通风散热情况
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 绝缘电阻测量
          action: 测量绝缘电阻
          standard: ">100MΩ"
          
        - item: 接线端子检查
          action: 检查端子紧固和温升
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 吸尘清洁绕组
            - 检查紧固件
            - 测量绝缘电阻
            - 检查散热风机
            - 红外热成像扫描
            
    # ------ 发电机 ------
    Generator:
      equipment: 柴油发电机组
      
      weekly:
        - item: 无负荷启动测试
          action: 启动运行15分钟
          
        - item: 液位检查
          action: 检查机油、冷却水、燃油液位
          
        - item: 电池检查
          action: 检查蓄电池电压
          
      monthly:
        - item: 带负荷测试
          action: 模拟市电中断测试
          load: "≥30%额定负荷"
          duration: 30分钟
          
        - item: 冷却系统检查
          action: 检查散热器和风扇
          
        - item: 空气滤清器检查
          action: 清洁或更换
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 机油更换
          action: 更换机油和机油滤芯
          
        - item: 燃油滤芯更换
          action: 更换燃油滤芯
          
        - item: 全负荷测试
          action: 100%负荷测试
          duration: 2小时
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 更换所有滤芯
            - 检查喷油器
            - 检查涡轮增压器
            - 测试安全保护
            - 检查ATS联动
            - 厂家维保服务
          responsible: 发电机厂家
          
    # ------ UPS ------
    UPS:
      equipment: 不间断电源
      
      monthly:
        - item: 运行参数记录
          action: 记录输入输出电压、负载率、电池电压
          
        - item: 告警检查
          action: 检查告警记录
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 电池内阻测试
          action: 测量各电池内阻
          
        - item: 蓄电池放电测试
          action: 人工放电测试
          depth: 30%容量
          
      semi_annual:
        - item: 深度放电测试
          action: 放电测试
          depth: 80%容量
          
        - item: 电池均衡充电
          action: 进行均衡充电
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 清洁滤网
            - 检查电容器
            - 检查风扇
            - 校准保护参数
            - 更换老化电池
            
    # ------ 低压配电 ------
    LV_Distribution:
      equipment: 低压配电柜
      
      monthly:
        - item: 温度检查
          action: 检查各接线端子温度
          method: 红外测温仪
          
        - item: 电流记录
          action: 记录各回路电流
          
        - item: 外观检查
          action: 检查柜体、指示灯、仪表
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 断路器动作测试
          action: 测试断路器分合闸
          
        - item: 接地电阻测量
          action: 测量接地电阻
          standard: "<4Ω"
          
      semi_annual:
        - item: 红外热成像
          action: 全面热成像扫描
          
        - item: 紧固检查
          action: 检查所有紧固件
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 断电清洁
            - 检查母排
            - 测量绝缘电阻
            - 紧固所有接线
            - 标识更新
          schedule: 配合年度停电
          
  # ========================================
  # 给排水系统维护计划
  # ========================================
  Plumbing_Maintenance:
    
    # ------ 水泵 ------
    Pump:
      equipment: 各类水泵
      
      weekly:
        - item: 运行检查
          action: 检查压力、电流、噪音、振动
          
        - item: 盘根/机封检查
          action: 检查密封泄漏情况
          
      monthly:
        - item: 轴承温度检查
          action: 测量轴承温度
          threshold: "<70℃"
          
        - item: 过滤器清洗
          action: 清洗进口Y型过滤器
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 振动测量
          action: 测量泵振动值
          
        - item: 轴承润滑
          action: 添加或更换润滑脂
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 检查叶轮
            - 更换密封件
            - 检查轴承
            - 检查联轴器对中
            - 更换必要备件
            
    # ------ 水箱 ------
    Water_Tank:
      equipment: 水箱/水池
      
      monthly:
        - item: 水位检查
          action: 检查液位开关和显示
          
        - item: 水质检测
          action: 检测余氯、浊度
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 浮球阀检查
          action: 检查进水阀动作
          
        - item: 溢流管检查
          action: 检查溢流管通畅
          
      annual:
        - item: 清洗消毒
          action: |
            - 排空水箱
            - 人工清洗内壁
            - 消毒处理
            - 冲洗后恢复使用
          frequency: 每年2次
          responsible: 专业清洗公司
          
  # ========================================
  # 医用气体系统维护计划
  # ========================================
  Medical_Gas_Maintenance:
    
    # ------ 氧气系统 ------
    Oxygen_System:
      equipment: 医用氧气系统
      
      daily:
        - item: 压力检查
          action: 检查液氧罐和各区域压力
          
        - item: 液位检查
          action: 检查液氧液位
          
        - item: 报警检查
          action: 检查报警盘状态
          
      weekly:
        - item: 汇流排检查
          action: 检查气瓶压力和切换
          
        - item: 泄漏检查
          action: 检查管路接头泄漏
          
      monthly:
        - item: 安全阀检查
          action: 检查安全阀状态
          
        - item: 调压阀检查
          action: 检查调压阀压力
          
        - item: 区域阀检查
          action: 检查区域阀标识和动作
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 纯度检测
          action: 检测氧气纯度
          standard: "≥99.5%"
          
        - item: 露点检测
          action: 检测气体露点
          standard: "<-40℃"
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 检查液氧罐
            - 检查汽化器
            - 更换滤芯
            - 校准压力表
            - 检查报警系统
            - 管道压力试验
          responsible: 医用气体专业公司
          
    # ------ 负压系统 ------
    Vacuum_System:
      equipment: 医用负压系统
      
      daily:
        - item: 真空度检查
          action: 检查真空度显示
          
        - item: 真空泵运行检查
          action: 检查泵运行状态
          
      weekly:
        - item: 细菌过滤器检查
          action: 检查过滤器压差
          
        - item: 排放检查
          action: 检查废气排放正常
          
      monthly:
        - item: 真空泵机油检查
          action: 检查油位和油品质量
          
        - item: 真空罐排水
          action: 排放真空罐积水
          
      quarterly:
        - item: 更换机油
          action: 更换真空泵机油
          
        - item: 过滤器更换
          action: 更换细菌过滤器
          
      annual:
        - item: 全面检修
          action: |
            - 检查真空泵
            - 更换密封件
            - 检查止回阀
            - 清洗真空罐
            - 检查报警系统
            - 管道气密性试验

  # ========================================
  # 维护计划表格式
  # ========================================
  plan_format:
    
    monthly_plan:
      columns:
        - 序号
        - 系统
        - 设备名称
        - 设备编号
        - 位置
        - 维护项目
        - 维护内容
        - 计划日期
        - 实际日期
        - 执行人
        - 结果
        - 备注
        
    annual_summary:
      columns:
        - 设备类型
        - 数量
        - 日检项目
        - 周检项目
        - 月检项目
        - 季检项目
        - 半年检项目
        - 年检项目
        - 预算费用

System_Interfaces_Batch3:

  # 给排水系统链路
  - interface_id: IF_DWS_TO_HWS
    upstream_system: PLUMB-DWS
    downstream_system: PLUMB-HWS
    interface_medium: WATER-DW
    description: 生活给水供应热水系统
    
  - interface_id: IF_DWS_TO_PWS
    upstream_system: PLUMB-DWS
    downstream_system: PLUMB-PWS
    interface_medium: WATER-DW
    description: 生活给水供应纯水系统原水
    
  - interface_id: IF_DWS_TO_FIRE
    upstream_system: PLUMB-DWS
    downstream_system: FIRE-HYDRANT
    interface_medium: WATER-DW
    description: 消防水池补水
    
  # 消防系统链路
  - interface_id: IF_FA_TO_HYDRANT
    upstream_system: FIRE-ALARM
    downstream_system: FIRE-HYDRANT
    interface_medium: SIGNAL-FA
    description: 火灾报警联动消火栓泵
    
  - interface_id: IF_FA_TO_SPRINKLER
    upstream_system: FIRE-ALARM
    downstream_system: FIRE-SPRINKLER
    interface_medium: SIGNAL-FA
    description: 火灾报警联动喷淋泵
    
  - interface_id: IF_FA_TO_SMOKE
    upstream_system: FIRE-ALARM
    downstream_system: FIRE-SMOKE
    interface_medium: SIGNAL-FA
    description: 火灾报警联动防排烟
    
  - interface_id: IF_FA_TO_ELEC
    upstream_system: FIRE-ALARM
    downstream_system: ELEC-LV-MAIN
    interface_medium: SIGNAL-FA
    description: 火灾报警切断非消防电源
    
  # 智能化系统链路
  - interface_id: IF_BA_TO_HVAC
    upstream_system: INT-BA
    downstream_system: HVAC-*
    interface_medium: SIGNAL-BA
    description: 楼宇自控监控暖通设备
    
  - interface_id: IF_BA_TO_PLUMB
    upstream_system: INT-BA
    downstream_system: PLUMB-*
    interface_medium: SIGNAL-BA
    description: 楼宇自控监控给排水设备
    
  - interface_id: IF_NURSE_TO_HIS
    upstream_system: INT-NURSE
    downstream_system: HIS (外部)
    interface_medium: DATA-IP
    description: 护理呼叫与HIS患者信息集成
    
  - interface_id: IF_BA_TO_IBMS
    upstream_system: INT-BA
    downstream_system: INT-IBMS
    interface_medium: DATA-IP
    description: 楼宇自控接入集成平台
    
  - interface_id: IF_FA_TO_IBMS
    upstream_system: FIRE-ALARM
    downstream_system: INT-IBMS
    interface_medium: DATA-IP
    description: 火灾报警接入集成平台

Quality_Checklist_Batch3:

  # 结构完整性
  structure_completeness:
    - check: 给水系统从市政→水箱→泵组→用户完整链路
      status: ✅
    - check: 排水系统从洁具→立管→化粪池→市政完整链路
      status: ✅
    - check: 纯水系统制备+循环完整流程
      status: ✅
    - check: 消火栓系统水源→泵→管网→消火栓完整链路
      status: ✅
    - check: 喷淋系统湿式/预作用分支完整
      status: ✅
    - check: 火灾报警探测→主机→联动完整链路
      status: ✅
    - check: 楼宇自控三层架构完整
      status: ✅
    - check: 护理呼叫床头→护士站完整链路
      status: ✅

  # 消防联动完整性
  fire_linkage:
    - check: 消防泵联动控制
      status: ✅
    - check: 防排烟联动控制
      status: ✅
    - check: 电梯迫降联动
      status: ✅
    - check: 非消防电源切断
      status: ✅
    - check: 消防广播联动
      status: ✅

  # 参数完整性
  parameter_completeness:
    - check: 给水压力参数完整
      status: ✅
    - check: 消防水压/水量参数符合规范
      status: ✅
    - check: 纯水水质参数完整
      status: ✅
    - check: 火灾探测器覆盖面积参数
      status: ✅
    - check: BA系统点数容量参数
      status: ✅

  # 下游接口
  downstream_interfaces:
    - agent: Agent-03 (设备属性)
      status: ✅ 设备参数完整
    - agent: Agent-04 (流动模型)
      status: ✅ 压力/流量参数提供
    - agent: Agent-05 (空间定位)
      status: ✅ location_hint完整
    - agent: Agent-06 (联动逻辑)
      status: ✅ 消防联动逻辑完整

Medium_Types:

  # ==========================================================================
  # 水介质 (Water Media)
  # ==========================================================================
  Water_Media:
  
    - medium_id: CHW
      medium_name: 冷冻水
      medium_name_en: Chilled Water
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        supply_temperature: {value: 7, unit: ℃}
        return_temperature: {value: 12, unit: ℃}
        delta_t: {value: 5, unit: ℃}
        pressure: {value: 0.4-0.8, unit: MPa}
      color_code: 绿色
      
    - medium_id: HW
      medium_name: 空调热水
      medium_name_en: Heating Water
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        supply_temperature: {value: 60, unit: ℃}
        return_temperature: {value: 50, unit: ℃}
        delta_t: {value: 10, unit: ℃}
        pressure: {value: 0.4-0.8, unit: MPa}
      color_code: 红色
      
    - medium_id: CW
      medium_name: 冷却水
      medium_name_en: Condenser Water
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        supply_temperature: {value: 32, unit: ℃}
        return_temperature: {value: 37, unit: ℃}
        delta_t: {value: 5, unit: ℃}
        pressure: {value: 0.3-0.5, unit: MPa}
      color_code: 蓝绿色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-DW
      medium_name: 生活给水
      medium_name_en: Domestic Water
      category: PLUMBING
      typical_properties:
        temperature: {value: 5-25, unit: ℃}
        pressure: {value: 0.15-0.35, unit: MPa}
        quality: GB 5749生活饮用水标准
      color_code: 蓝色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-HW
      medium_name: 生活热水
      medium_name_en: Domestic Hot Water
      category: PLUMBING
      typical_properties:
        supply_temperature: {value: 55-60, unit: ℃}
        return_temperature: {value: 50, unit: ℃}
        pressure: {value: 0.15-0.35, unit: MPa}
      color_code: 红色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-SAN
      medium_name: 污废水
      medium_name_en: Sanitary Water
      category: PLUMBING
      typical_properties:
        type: 重力流
        pH: {value: 6-9, unit: null}
      color_code: 黑色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-STORM
      medium_name: 雨水
      medium_name_en: Storm Water
      category: PLUMBING
      typical_properties:
        type: 重力流
      color_code: 灰色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-RW
      medium_name: 中水
      medium_name_en: Reclaimed Water
      category: PLUMBING
      typical_properties:
        quality: GB/T 18920城市杂用水标准
        usage: [冲厕, 绿化, 道路冲洗]
      color_code: 浅绿色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-FIRE
      medium_name: 消防水
      medium_name_en: Fire Water
      category: FIRE_PROTECTION
      typical_properties:
        pressure_hydrant: {value: 0.35-0.5, unit: MPa}
        pressure_sprinkler: {value: 0.1-0.15, unit: MPa}
      color_code: 红色
      
    - medium_id: WATER-PURE
      medium_name: 纯水
      medium_name_en: Purified Water
      category: PLUMBING
      typical_properties:
        resistivity: {value: ">10", unit: MΩ·cm}
        toc: {value: "<500", unit: ppb}
        bacteria: {value: "<100", unit: CFU/mL}
      color_code: 白色

  # ==========================================================================
  # 空气介质 (Air Media)
  # ==========================================================================
  Air_Media:
  
    - medium_id: AIR-OA
      medium_name: 室外新风
      medium_name_en: Outdoor Air
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        temperature: 室外设计参数
        humidity: 室外设计参数
      
    - medium_id: AIR-SA
      medium_name: 送风
      medium_name_en: Supply Air
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        temperature_summer: {value: 14-18, unit: ℃}
        temperature_winter: {value: 35-45, unit: ℃}
        
    - medium_id: AIR-RA
      medium_name: 回风
      medium_name_en: Return Air
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        temperature_summer: {value: 25-27, unit: ℃}
        temperature_winter: {value: 18-22, unit: ℃}
        
    - medium_id: AIR-EA
      medium_name: 排风
      medium_name_en: Exhaust Air
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        destination: 室外排放
        
    - medium_id: AIR-CLEAN
      medium_name: 洁净送风
      medium_name_en: Clean Room Supply Air
      category: HVAC
      typical_properties:
        cleanliness_levels:
          - {class: ISO5, particles: "≤3520/m³@0.5μm"}
          - {class: ISO6, particles: "≤35200/m³@0.5μm"}
          - {class: ISO7, particles: "≤352000/m³@0.5μm"}
          - {class: ISO8, particles: "≤3520000/m³@0.5μm"}
          
    - medium_id: AIR-SMOKE
      medium_name: 烟气
      medium_name_en: Smoke
      category: FIRE_PROTECTION
      typical_properties:
        exhaust_velocity: {value: "≥15", unit: m/s}
        temperature: {value: 280, unit: ℃, note: 设计温度}

  # ==========================================================================
  # 电力介质 (Electrical Media)
  # ==========================================================================
  Electrical_Media:
  
    - medium_id: ELEC-HV
      medium_name: 高压电
      medium_name_en: High Voltage
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        voltage: {value: 10, unit: kV}
        frequency: {value: 50, unit: Hz}
        phases: 3
        
    - medium_id: ELEC-LV
      medium_name: 低压电
      medium_name_en: Low Voltage
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        voltage: {value: "380/220", unit: V}
        frequency: {value: 50, unit: Hz}
        system: "3P+N+PE"
        
    - medium_id: ELEC-EPS
      medium_name: 应急电源
      medium_name_en: Emergency Power
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        voltage: {value: "380/220", unit: V}
        source: 柴油发电机
        startup_time: {value: "≤15", unit: s}
        
    - medium_id: ELEC-UPS
      medium_name: 不间断电源
      medium_name_en: UPS Power
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        voltage: {value: "380/220", unit: V}
        backup_time: {value: 15-30, unit: min}
        transfer_time: {value: 0, unit: ms}
        
    - medium_id: ELEC-IT
      medium_name: 隔离电源
      medium_name_en: Isolated Power
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        voltage: {value: 220, unit: V}
        grounding: 不接地系统
        insulation_monitor: 必需
        application: 2类医疗场所
        
    - medium_id: ELEC-DC
      medium_name: 直流电
      medium_name_en: DC Power
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        voltage: {value: 48-750, unit: V}
        source: [光伏, 蓄电池]
        
    - medium_id: GROUND
      medium_name: 接地
      medium_name_en: Ground
      category: ELECTRICAL
      typical_properties:
        resistance: {value: "≤1", unit: Ω}
        types: [防雷接地, 保护接地, 功能接地, 等电位联结]

  # ==========================================================================
  # 医疗气体介质 (Medical Gas Media)
  # ==========================================================================
  Medical_Gas_Media:
  
    - medium_id: GAS-O2
      medium_name: 医用氧气
      medium_name_en: Medical Oxygen
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        purity: {value: "≥99.5", unit: "%"}
        pressure_source: {value: 0.8-1.0, unit: MPa}
        pressure_terminal: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
        color_code: 白色
        standard: YY/T 0187
        
    - medium_id: GAS-VAC
      medium_name: 医用负压
      medium_name_en: Medical Vacuum
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        pressure: {value: "-40 ~ -60", unit: kPa}
        flow_per_terminal: {value: 40, unit: L/min}
        color_code: 黄色
        
    - medium_id: GAS-AIR
      medium_name: 医用压缩空气
      medium_name_en: Medical Compressed Air
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        pressure_terminal: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
        dew_point: {value: "≤-40", unit: ℃}
        oil_content: {value: "≤0.1", unit: mg/m³}
        particle: {value: "≤0.5", unit: μm}
        color_code: 黑白相间
        
    - medium_id: GAS-N2O
      medium_name: 笑气
      medium_name_en: Nitrous Oxide
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        purity: {value: "≥99", unit: "%"}
        pressure_terminal: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
        color_code: 蓝色
        
    - medium_id: GAS-N2
      medium_name: 医用氮气
      medium_name_en: Medical Nitrogen
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        purity: {value: "≥99.5", unit: "%"}
        pressure_terminal: {value: 0.4-0.8, unit: MPa}
        color_code: 黑色
        
    - medium_id: GAS-CO2
      medium_name: 医用二氧化碳
      medium_name_en: Medical Carbon Dioxide
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        purity: {value: "≥99.5", unit: "%"}
        pressure_terminal: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
        color_code: 灰色
        application: 腹腔镜手术
        
    - medium_id: GAS-AGSS
      medium_name: 麻醉废气
      medium_name_en: Anesthetic Gas Scavenging
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        pressure: {value: "-25 ~ -50", unit: mmH2O}
        flow_per_terminal: {value: 50, unit: L/min}
        
    - medium_id: GAS-He
      medium_name: 医用氦气
      medium_name_en: Medical Helium
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        purity: {value: "≥99.99", unit: "%"}
        application: [MRI冷却, 肺功能检测]
        
    - medium_id: GAS-Ar
      medium_name: 医用氩气
      medium_name_en: Medical Argon
      category: MEDICAL_GAS
      typical_properties:
        purity: {value: "≥99.99", unit: "%"}
        application: 氩气刀手术

  # ==========================================================================
  # 控制与信号介质 (Control & Signal Media)
  # ==========================================================================
  Control_Signal_Media:
  
    - medium_id: DATA-IP
      medium_name: IP数据
      medium_name_en: IP Data
      category: INTELLIGENT
      typical_properties:
        protocol: TCP/IP
        speed: {value: "100M/1G/10G", unit: bps}
        
    - medium_id: DATA-BA
      medium_name: 楼控数据
      medium_name_en: BAS Data
      category: INTELLIGENT
      typical_properties:
        protocols: [BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks]
        
    - medium_id: SIGNAL-FA
      medium_name: 火警信号
      medium_name_en: Fire Alarm Signal
      category: FIRE_PROTECTION
      typical_properties:
        type: 二总线/四总线
        
    - medium_id: SIGNAL-NURSE
      medium_name: 护理呼叫信号
      medium_name_en: Nurse Call Signal
      category: INTELLIGENT
      typical_properties:
        levels: [普通呼叫, 紧急呼叫, 医护呼叫]
        
    - medium_id: SIGNAL-TIME
      medium_name: 时间信号
      medium_name_en: Time Signal
      category: INTELLIGENT
      typical_properties:
        source: [GPS, 北斗, NTP]
        accuracy: {value: "±0.5", unit: "秒/天"}
        
    - medium_id: SIGNAL-AUDIO
      medium_name: 音频信号
      medium_name_en: Audio Signal
      category: INTELLIGENT
      typical_properties:
        frequency: {value: 50-15000, unit: Hz}
        
    - medium_id: SIGNAL-VIDEO
      medium_name: 视频信号
      medium_name_en: Video Signal
      category: INTELLIGENT
      typical_properties:
        resolution: [1080P, 4K]
        protocol: [RTSP, ONVIF]

System_Interfaces_Batch2:

  # 电气系统链路
  - interface_id: IF_HV_TO_LV
    upstream_system: ELEC-HV
    downstream_system: ELEC-LV-MAIN
    interface_equipment: 变压器
    interface_medium: ELEC-HV → ELEC-LV
    
  - interface_id: IF_EPS_TO_LV
    upstream_system: ELEC-EPS
    downstream_system: ELEC-LV-MAIN
    interface_equipment: ATS自动转换开关
    interface_medium: ELEC-EPS
    
  - interface_id: IF_LV_TO_IT
    upstream_system: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
    downstream_system: ELEC-IT
    interface_equipment: 隔离变压器
    interface_medium: ELEC-LV → ELEC-IT
    
  # 医疗气体系统与电气系统
  - interface_id: IF_ELEC_TO_O2
    upstream_system: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
    downstream_system: MGAS-O2
    interface_medium: ELEC-LV
    purpose: 液氧气化器加热、监控报警系统
    
  - interface_id: IF_ELEC_TO_VAC
    upstream_system: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
    downstream_system: MGAS-VAC
    interface_medium: ELEC-LV
    purpose: 真空泵动力
    
  - interface_id: IF_ELEC_TO_AIR
    upstream_system: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
    downstream_system: MGAS-AIR
    interface_medium: ELEC-LV
    purpose: 空压机、干燥机动力
    
  # 医疗气体终端汇聚
  - interface_id: IF_MGAS_TO_HEADWALL
    upstream_systems: [MGAS-O2, MGAS-VAC, MGAS-AIR]
    downstream_system: 床头设备带
    interface_medium: [GAS-O2, GAS-VAC, GAS-AIR]
    location: 病房、ICU床头
    
  - interface_id: IF_MGAS_TO_PENDANT
    upstream_systems: [MGAS-O2, MGAS-VAC, MGAS-AIR, MGAS-N2O, MGAS-AGSS]
    downstream_system: 手术室吊塔
    interface_medium: [GAS-O2, GAS-VAC, GAS-AIR, GAS-N2O, GAS-AGSS]
    location: 手术室

Quality_Checklist_Batch2:

  # 结构完整性
  structure_completeness:
    - check: 所有电气系统形成完整供电链路（HV→LV→终端）
      status: ✅
    - check: 应急电源系统具备完整的启动和转换逻辑
      status: ✅
    - check: 隔离电源系统包含绝缘监测
      status: ✅
    - check: 医疗气体系统具备双气源/冗余设计
      status: ✅
    - check: 负压吸引系统路径方向正确（终端→泵房）
      status: ✅

  # 安全设计
  safety_design:
    - check: 电气系统分级保护完整
      status: ✅
    - check: IT系统安全逻辑明确
      status: ✅
    - check: 医疗气体报警系统完整
      status: ✅
    - check: 冗余/备用路径已定义
      status: ✅

  # 参数完整性

  # 下游接口
