        medium_out: GAS-O2
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: MGAS-O2_DST_ZONE_VALVE_{Floor}_{Zone}
        
        equipment_parameters:
          components: [截止阀, 减压阀, 压力表, 报警接口]
          inlet_pressure: {value: 0.5-0.6, unit: MPa}
          outlet_pressure: {value: 0.4-0.45, unit: MPa}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: WALL_CABINET
          position: 护士站附近走廊
          
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - {point_id: ZONE_PRESSURE, type: AI, description: 区域压力}
          status:
            - {point_id: ZONE_LOW_P, type: DI, description: 低压报警}
            - {point_id: ZONE_HIGH_P, type: DI, description: 高压报警}

      - node_id: MGAS-O2_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        node_name: 楼层支管
        node_name_en: Floor Branch Pipe
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: BRH
        
        function: 楼层水平分配
        medium_in: GAS-O2
        medium_out: GAS-O2
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 脱脂铜管
          diameter: {value: DN15-DN25, unit: mm}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: CEILING_VOID
          position: 病房走廊吊顶

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-O2_SNK_TERMINAL
        node_name: 氧气终端
        node_name_en: Oxygen Terminal Outlet
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        consumption_type: 氧气供应
        medium_in: GAS-O2
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: MGAS-O2_SNK_TERMINAL_{Floor}_{Room}_{Seq}
        
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 快速接头
          standard: 德标DIN/美标DISS/国标
          flow_rate: {value: 10-15, unit: L/min}
          terminal_pressure: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
          color_code: 白色
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: WALL / HEADWALL / PENDANT
          position: 床头设备带、手术室吊塔
          
        typical_quantity:
          per_bed_icu: 2
          per_bed_ward: 1
          per_or: 4

  # ============================================================
  # 边定义
  # ============================================================
  edges:
  
    supply_edges:
    
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 液氧站至切换装置
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-O2_SRC_LOX_TANK
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_AUTO_SWITCH
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.8-1.0, unit: MPa}
        physical_properties:
          material: 铜管
          diameter: DN40
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_002
        edge_name: 汇流排至切换装置
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-O2_SRC_MANIFOLD
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_AUTO_SWITCH
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.8-1.0, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_003
        edge_name: 切换装置至总阀门
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_AUTO_SWITCH
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_MAIN_VALVE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_004
        edge_name: 总阀门至一级减压
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_MAIN_VALVE
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_FIRST_REG
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.8-1.0, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_005
        edge_name: 一级减压至主管
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_FIRST_REG
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.5-0.6, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_006
        edge_name: 主管至立管
        edge_type: BRH
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_RISER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_007
        edge_name: 立管至区域阀门箱
        edge_type: BRH
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_RISER
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_008
        edge_name: 区域阀门箱至楼层支管
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        to_node: MGAS-O2_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.4-0.45, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_009
        edge_name: 楼层支管至终端
        edge_type: TRM
        from_node: MGAS-O2_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        to_node: MGAS-O2_SNK_TERMINAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-O2
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}

  # ============================================================
  # 路径定义
  # ============================================================
  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: MGAS-O2_PATH_MAIN
      path_name: 氧气主供路径
      path_type: SUP
      sequence:
        - {step: 1, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_SRC_LOX_TANK}
        - {step: 2, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_001}
        - {step: 3, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_AUTO_SWITCH}
        - {step: 4, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_003}
        - {step: 5, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_MAIN_VALVE}
        - {step: 6, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_004}
        - {step: 7, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_FIRST_REG}
        - {step: 8, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_005}
        - {step: 9, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_MAIN_PIPE}
        - {step: 10, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_006}
        - {step: 11, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_RISER}
        - {step: 12, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_007}
        - {step: 13, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_ZONE_VALVE}
        - {step: 14, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_008}
        - {step: 15, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_FLOOR_PIPE}
        - {step: 16, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_009}
        - {step: 17, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_SNK_TERMINAL}
        
    - path_id: MGAS-O2_PATH_BACKUP
      path_name: 氧气备用路径
      path_type: BKP
      description: 液氧故障时，汇流排自动接管供气
      sequence:
        - {step: 1, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_SRC_MANIFOLD}
        - {step: 2, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-O2_EDGE_002}
        - {step: 3, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-O2_DST_AUTO_SWITCH}
        # 后续路径与主路径相同

  # ============================================================
  # 回路/冗余定义
  # ============================================================
  loops:
  
    - loop_id: MGAS-O2_LOOP_DUAL_SOURCE
      loop_name: 双气源冗余
      loop_type: redundant
      
      description: |
        液氧为主气源，汇流排为备用气源。
        液氧压力低于设定值时自动切换至汇流排。
        液氧恢复后自动切回。
        
      primary_source: MGAS-O2_SRC_LOX_TANK
      backup_source: MGAS-O2_SRC_MANIFOLD
      switchover_node: MGAS-O2_DST_AUTO_SWITCH
      switchover_pressure: {value: 0.6, unit: MPa}

  # ============================================================
  # 报警与监控
  # ============================================================
  alarm_system:
  
    alarm_stations:
      - location: 供气站
        alarms: [液位低, 压力异常, 气源切换]
        
      - location: 护士站（每区域）
        alarms: [区域压力低, 区域压力高]
        
      - location: 中央监控室
        alarms: [所有报警汇总]
        
    alarm_levels:
      - level: 高优先级
        conditions: [液位极低, 压力极低, 系统故障]
        response: 声光报警 + 远程通知
        
      - level: 中优先级
        conditions: [液位低, 气源切换]
        response: 声光报警
        
      - level: 低优先级
        conditions: [液位预警]
        response: 指示灯:System_Topology


# ============================================================
  # 系统标识
  # ============================================================
  identity:
    system_id: MGAS-VAC
    system_name: 医用负压吸引系统
    system_name_en: Medical Vacuum System
    category: MEDICAL_GAS
    version: 1.0
    
    description: |
      医院中心负压吸引系统，采用真空泵机组产生负压，
      通过管网输送至各医疗区域终端，用于吸引手术废液、痰液等。
      
    design_basis:
      vacuum_level: {value: -40 ~ -60, unit: kPa}
      flow_per_terminal: {value: 40, unit: L/min}
      pump_configuration: "N+1备用"
      
    serving_scope:
      - 手术室
      - ICU
      - 急诊
      - 病房
      - 门诊治疗室

  # ============================================================
  # 系统边界
  # ============================================================
  boundary:
    inputs:
      - boundary_id: MGAS-VAC_BND_IN_ELEC
        boundary_name: 电源
        medium: ELEC-LV
        source_system: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
        
    outputs:
      - boundary_id: MGAS-VAC_BND_OUT_VAC
        boundary_name: 负压终端
        medium: GAS-VAC
        target: 医疗设备/治疗带
        
      - boundary_id: MGAS-VAC_BND_OUT_EXHAUST
        boundary_name: 废气排放
        medium: AIR-EA
        is_external: true
        target: 大气

  # ============================================================
  # 节点定义
  # ============================================================
  nodes:
  
    source_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP
        node_name: 真空泵组
        node_name_en: Vacuum Pump Set
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 产生负压
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP_{NN}
        
        typical_configuration:
          quantity: 3-4
          redundancy: "N+1"
          
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 油封旋片泵/水环泵/干式无油泵
          capacity_each: {value: 100-250, unit: m³/h}
          ultimate_vacuum: {value: -85, unit: kPa}
          working_vacuum: {value: -60, unit: kPa}
          power: {value: 7.5-15, unit: kW}
          noise: {value: "≤75", unit: dB(A)}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 负压泵房
          floor: 地下室或设备层
          
        installation_requirements:
          - 通风良好
          - 减振基础
          - 废气排放接口
          - 噪声控制
          
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - {point_id: VAC_PUMP_I, type: AI, description: 运行电流}
            - {point_id: VAC_PUMP_TEMP, type: AI, description: 泵温}
          status:
            - {point_id: VAC_PUMP_RUN, type: DI, description: 运行状态}
            - {point_id: VAC_PUMP_FAULT, type: DI, description: 故障报警}
          commands:
            - {point_id: VAC_PUMP_START, type: DO, description: 启停控制}

    distribution_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_RECEIVER
        node_name: 真空罐
        node_name_en: Vacuum Receiver Tank
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: BUF
        
        function: 缓冲储存、稳定真空度
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        equipment_parameters:
          capacity: {value: 500-1500, unit: L}
          working_pressure: {value: -60, unit: kPa}
          material: 不锈钢
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 负压泵房
          
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - {point_id: VAC_TANK_P, type: AI, description: 罐内真空度}

      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_BACTERIA_FILTER
        node_name: 细菌过滤器
        node_name_en: Bacterial Filter
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: TRF
        
        function: 过滤细菌、防止交叉污染
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        equipment_parameters:
          filter_efficiency: {value: "≥99.97%@0.3μm", unit: null}
          replacement_cycle: {value: 6-12, unit: 月}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 负压泵房

      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        node_name: 负压主管
        node_name_en: Vacuum Main Pipe
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: TRK
        
        function: 水平输配主干管
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 镀锌钢管/不锈钢管
          diameter: {value: DN65-DN100, unit: mm}
          slope: {value: "≥3‰", note: 向泵房方向倾斜}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: CEILING_VOID / PIPE_TRENCH

      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_RISER
        node_name: 负压立管
        node_name_en: Vacuum Riser
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: SPL
        
        function: 垂直输配
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 镀锌钢管/不锈钢管
          diameter: {value: DN40-DN50, unit: mm}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: SHAFT
          shaft_type: 医气管井

      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        node_name: 区域阀门箱
        node_name_en: Zone Valve Box
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: REG
        
        function: 区域控制
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          components: [截止阀, 真空表, 报警接口]
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: WALL_CABINET
          position: 护士站附近走廊
          
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - {point_id: ZONE_VAC, type: AI, description: 区域真空度}
          status:
            - {point_id: ZONE_VAC_LOW, type: DI, description: 真空度低报警}

      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        node_name: 楼层支管
        node_name_en: Floor Branch Pipe
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: BRH
        
        function: 楼层水平分配
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        medium_out: GAS-VAC
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 镀锌钢管
          diameter: {value: DN25-DN32, unit: mm}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: CEILING_VOID

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_SNK_TERMINAL
        node_name: 负压吸引终端
        node_name_en: Vacuum Terminal Outlet
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        consumption_type: 负压吸引
        medium_in: GAS-VAC
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 快速接头
          flow_rate: {value: 40, unit: L/min}
          vacuum_level: {value: -40 ~ -60, unit: kPa}
          color_code: 黄色
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: WALL / HEADWALL / PENDANT
          position: 床头设备带、手术室吊塔
          
        typical_quantity:
          per_bed_icu: 2
          per_bed_ward: 1
          per_or: 3

      - node_id: MGAS-VAC_SNK_EXHAUST
        node_name: 废气排放口
        node_name_en: Exhaust Outlet
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        consumption_type: 废气排放
        medium_in: AIR-EA
        is_external: true
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: EXTERIOR
          position: 屋顶（远离新风口）
          height: ≥ 3m高于屋面

  # ============================================================
  # 边定义
  # ============================================================
  edges:
  
    supply_edges:
    
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 真空罐至真空泵
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_RECEIVER
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        note: 抽气方向（被抽气体流向）
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_002
        edge_name: 过滤器至真空罐
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_BACTERIA_FILTER
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_RECEIVER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_003
        edge_name: 主管至过滤器
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_BACTERIA_FILTER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_004
        edge_name: 立管至主管
        edge_type: BRH
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_RISER
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_005
        edge_name: 区域阀门箱至立管
        edge_type: BRH
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_RISER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_006
        edge_name: 楼层支管至区域阀门箱
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_007
        edge_name: 终端至楼层支管
        edge_type: TRM
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_SNK_TERMINAL
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-VAC
        note: 被抽气体从终端流向主管
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_008
        edge_name: 真空泵废气排放
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP
        to_node: MGAS-VAC_SNK_EXHAUST
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: AIR-EA

  # ============================================================
  # 路径定义
  # ============================================================
  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: MGAS-VAC_PATH_MAIN
      path_name: 负压吸引路径
      path_type: SUP
      description: 气体流动方向：终端→泵房
      sequence:
        - {step: 1, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_SNK_TERMINAL}
        - {step: 2, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_007}
        - {step: 3, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_FLOOR_PIPE}
        - {step: 4, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_006}
        - {step: 5, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_ZONE_VALVE}
        - {step: 6, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_005}
        - {step: 7, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_RISER}
        - {step: 8, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_004}
        - {step: 9, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_MAIN_PIPE}
        - {step: 10, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_003}
        - {step: 11, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_BACTERIA_FILTER}
        - {step: 12, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_002}
        - {step: 13, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_DST_RECEIVER}
        - {step: 14, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_001}
        - {step: 15, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP}
        
    - path_id: MGAS-VAC_PATH_EXHAUST
      path_name: 废气排放路径
      path_type: EXH
      sequence:
        - {step: 1, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_SRC_PUMP}
        - {step: 2, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-VAC_EDGE_008}
        - {step: 3, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-VAC_SNK_EXHAUST}

  # ============================================================
  # 控制逻辑
  # ============================================================
  control_logic:
  
    pump_control:
      mode: 真空度控制
      setpoint:
        start: {value: -50, unit: kPa, note: 真空度降至此值启动备用泵}
        stop: {value: -65, unit: kPa, note: 真空度达此值停止运行泵}
      sequence: 轮换运行（均衡磨损）
      
    alarm_logic:
      - condition: 真空度 > -40kPa
        level: 高优先级
        action: 声光报警 + 启动全部泵
        
      - condition: 真空度 > -50kPa
        level: 中优先级
        action: 报警 + 启动备用泵
        
      - condition: 泵故障
        level: 高优先级
        action: 声光报警 + 启动备用泵:System_Topology


# ============================================================
  # 系统标识
  # ============================================================
  identity:
    system_id: MGAS-AIR
    system_name: 医用压缩空气系统
    system_name_en: Medical Compressed Air System
    category: MEDICAL_GAS
    version: 1.0
    
    description: |
      医院医用压缩空气系统，采用无油空压机产生压缩空气，
      经干燥、过滤净化后通过管网输送至各医疗区域终端。
      用于呼吸机驱动、气动工具等医疗用途。
      
    design_basis:
      supply_pressure: {value: 0.7-0.8, unit: MPa}
      terminal_pressure: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
      dew_point: {value: "≤-40", unit: ℃}
      oil_content: {value: "≤0.1", unit: "mg/m³"}
      particle: {value: "≤0.5", unit: μm}
      
    serving_scope:
      - 手术室
      - ICU
      - 急诊
      - NICU
      - 呼吸治疗

  # ============================================================
  # 系统边界
  # ============================================================
  boundary:
    inputs:
      - boundary_id: MGAS-AIR_BND_IN_ATM
        boundary_name: 大气
        medium: AIR-OA
        is_external: true
        
      - boundary_id: MGAS-AIR_BND_IN_ELEC
        boundary_name: 电源
        medium: ELEC-LV
        source_system: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
        
    outputs:
      - boundary_id: MGAS-AIR_BND_OUT_AIR
        boundary_name: 压缩空气终端
        medium: GAS-AIR
        target: 医疗设备

  # ============================================================
  # 节点定义
  # ============================================================
  nodes:
  
    source_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_SRC_INTAKE
        node_name: 进气口
        node_name_en: Air Intake
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 吸入大气
        medium_out: AIR-OA
        is_external: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          filter: 初效过滤
          position: 远离污染源
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: EXTERIOR
          position: 室外洁净区域
          height: ≥ 2m
          
      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_SRC_COMPRESSOR
        node_name: 无油空压机
        node_name_en: Oil-free Air Compressor
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 压缩空气产生
        medium_in: AIR-OA
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: MGAS-AIR_SRC_COMPRESSOR_{NN}
        
        typical_configuration:
          quantity: 3
          redundancy: "N+1"
          
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 无油涡旋式/螺杆式
          capacity_each: {value: 1-3, unit: m³/min}
          discharge_pressure: {value: 0.8, unit: MPa}
          power: {value: 7.5-22, unit: kW}
          noise: {value: "≤75", unit: dB(A)}
          oil_free: true
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 空压机房
          
        installation_requirements:
          - 通风良好
          - 减振基础
          - 进气过滤
          - 噪声控制
          
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - {point_id: COMP_P, type: AI, description: 排气压力}
            - {point_id: COMP_I, type: AI, description: 运行电流}
            - {point_id: COMP_TEMP, type: AI, description: 排气温度}
          status:
            - {point_id: COMP_RUN, type: DI, description: 运行状态}
            - {point_id: COMP_FAULT, type: DI, description: 故障报警}
          commands:
            - {point_id: COMP_START, type: DO, description: 启停控制}

    distribution_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_RECEIVER
        node_name: 储气罐
        node_name_en: Air Receiver Tank
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: BUF
        
        function: 缓冲储存、稳定压力
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          capacity: {value: 1000-3000, unit: L}
          working_pressure: {value: 1.0, unit: MPa}
          material: 碳钢
          drain: 自动排水器
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 空压机房
          
      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_DRYER
        node_name: 冷冻式干燥机
        node_name_en: Refrigerated Air Dryer
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: TRF
        
        function: 冷却除湿
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 冷冻式
          capacity: {value: 3-10, unit: m³/min}
          outlet_dew_point: {value: 2-10, unit: ℃}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 空压机房

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_ADSORB_DRYER
        node_name: 吸附式干燥机
        node_name_en: Desiccant Air Dryer
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: TRF
        
        function: 深度干燥
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 无热再生/加热再生
          capacity: {value: 3-10, unit: m³/min}
          outlet_dew_point: {value: "-40 ~ -70", unit: ℃}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 空压机房

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_FILTER_SET
        node_name: 过滤器组
        node_name_en: Filter Set
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: TRF
        
        function: 多级过滤净化
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          stages:
            - {stage: 1, type: 除水过滤器, efficiency: "液滴≤0.1ppm"}
            - {stage: 2, type: 除油过滤器, efficiency: "油雾≤0.01ppm"}
            - {stage: 3, type: 除菌过滤器, efficiency: "≥99.99%@0.01μm"}
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 空压机房

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_REGULATOR
        node_name: 一级减压阀
        node_name_en: First Stage Regulator
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: REG
        
        function: 压力调节
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          inlet_pressure: {value: 0.7-0.8, unit: MPa}
          outlet_pressure: {value: 0.5-0.6, unit: MPa}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: MEP_ROOM
          room_name: 空压机房

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        node_name: 压缩空气主管
        node_name_en: Compressed Air Main Pipe
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: TRK
        
        function: 水平输配主干管
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 脱脂铜管/不锈钢管
          diameter: {value: DN40-DN65, unit: mm}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: CEILING_VOID / PIPE_TRENCH

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_RISER
        node_name: 压缩空气立管
        node_name_en: Compressed Air Riser
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: SPL
        
        function: 垂直输配
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 脱脂铜管/不锈钢管
          diameter: {value: DN25-DN32, unit: mm}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: SHAFT
          shaft_type: 医气管井

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        node_name: 区域阀门箱
        node_name_en: Zone Valve Box
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: REG
        
        function: 区域控制与二级减压
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          components: [截止阀, 减压阀, 压力表, 报警接口]
          outlet_pressure: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: WALL_CABINET
          position: 护士站附近走廊

      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        node_name: 楼层支管
        node_name_en: Floor Branch Pipe
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_category: DST
        node_subtype: BRH
        
        function: 楼层水平分配
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        medium_out: GAS-AIR
        
        equipment_parameters:
          material: 脱脂铜管
          diameter: {value: DN15-DN20, unit: mm}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: CEILING_VOID

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: MGAS-AIR_SNK_TERMINAL
        node_name: 压缩空气终端
        node_name_en: Compressed Air Terminal Outlet
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        consumption_type: 压缩空气供应
        medium_in: GAS-AIR
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 快速接头
          terminal_pressure: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
          color_code: 黑白相间
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: WALL / HEADWALL / PENDANT
          position: 床头设备带、手术室吊塔
          
        typical_quantity:
          per_bed_icu: 2
          per_bed_ward: 1
          per_or: 2

  # ============================================================
  # 边定义
  # ============================================================
  edges:
  
    supply_edges:
    
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 进气口至空压机
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_SRC_INTAKE
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_SRC_COMPRESSOR
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: AIR-OA
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_002
        edge_name: 空压机至储气罐
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_SRC_COMPRESSOR
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_RECEIVER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.8, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_003
        edge_name: 储气罐至冷干机
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_RECEIVER
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_DRYER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_004
        edge_name: 冷干机至吸干机
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_DRYER
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_ADSORB_DRYER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_005
        edge_name: 吸干机至过滤器组
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_ADSORB_DRYER
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_FILTER_SET
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_006
        edge_name: 过滤器组至减压阀
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_FILTER_SET
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_REGULATOR
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_007
        edge_name: 减压阀至主管
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_REGULATOR
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.5-0.6, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_008
        edge_name: 主管至立管
        edge_type: BRH
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_MAIN_PIPE
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_RISER
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_009
        edge_name: 立管至区域阀门箱
        edge_type: BRH
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_RISER
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_010
        edge_name: 区域阀门箱至楼层支管
        edge_type: TRK
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_ZONE_VALVE
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR
        medium_properties:
          pressure: {value: 0.4-0.5, unit: MPa}
          
      - edge_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 楼层支管至终端
        edge_type: TRM
        from_node: MGAS-AIR_DST_FLOOR_PIPE
        to_node: MGAS-AIR_SNK_TERMINAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: GAS-AIR

  # ============================================================
  # 路径定义
  # ============================================================
  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: MGAS-AIR_PATH_MAIN
      path_name: 压缩空气主路径
      path_type: SUP
      sequence:
        - {step: 1, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_SRC_INTAKE}
        - {step: 2, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_001}
        - {step: 3, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_SRC_COMPRESSOR}
        - {step: 4, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_002}
        - {step: 5, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_RECEIVER}
        - {step: 6, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_003}
        - {step: 7, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_DRYER}
        - {step: 8, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_004}
        - {step: 9, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_ADSORB_DRYER}
        - {step: 10, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_005}
        - {step: 11, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_FILTER_SET}
        - {step: 12, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_006}
        - {step: 13, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_REGULATOR}
        - {step: 14, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_007}
        - {step: 15, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_MAIN_PIPE}
        - {step: 16, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_008}
        - {step: 17, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_RISER}
        - {step: 18, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_009}
        - {step: 19, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_ZONE_VALVE}
        - {step: 20, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_010}
        - {step: 21, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_DST_FLOOR_PIPE}
        - {step: 22, element_type: edge, element_id: MGAS-AIR_EDGE_011}
        - {step: 23, element_type: node, element_id: MGAS-AIR_SNK_TERMINAL}

  # ============================================================
  # 气体质量监控
  # ============================================================
  quality_monitoring:
  
    parameters:
      - parameter: 露点温度
        limit: {value: "≤-40", unit: ℃}
        monitoring_point: 干燥机出口
        
      - parameter: 含油量
        limit: {value: "≤0.1", unit: "mg/m³"}
        monitoring_point: 过滤器出口
        
      - parameter: 颗粒物
        limit: {value: "≤0.5", unit: μm}
        monitoring_point: 过滤器出口
        
      - parameter: CO含量
        limit: {value: "≤5", unit: ppm}
        monitoring_point: 主管
        
    alarm_conditions:
      - condition: 露点超标
        action: 报警 + 检查干燥机
        
      - condition: 压差过高
        action: 报警 + 更换过滤器:System_Interfaces_Batch2


identity:
    name: FCU房间新风分配系统
    description: 定义新风从MAU到FCU房间的完整分配路径
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024
    applicable_systems:
      - HVAC-AHU（MAU新风机组）
      - HVAC-FCU

  # ========================================
  # 系统架构层级
  # ========================================
  system_architecture:
    
    tier_1_central_processing:
      name: 集中新风处理
      equipment: 新风处理机组（MAU）
      location: 设备层/屋顶/地下室
      
      processing_sequence:
        step_1:
          name: 进气段
          components:
            - 新风百叶
            - 防雨罩
            - 防虫网
        step_2:
          name: 初效过滤
          filter: G4
          pressure_drop: {value: "50-100", unit: Pa}
        step_3:
          name: 热回收（可选）
          type: 全热交换器
          efficiency: {value: ">60", unit: "%"}
        step_4:
          name: 表冷/加热
          coil: 冷热盘管
          output_temp:
            summer: {value: 16, unit: ℃}
            winter: {value: 28, unit: ℃}
        step_5:
          name: 加湿（冬季）
          type: 干蒸汽加湿
          target: {value: 40, unit: "%RH"}
        step_6:
          name: 中效过滤
          filter: F7/F8
          pressure_drop: {value: "100-150", unit: Pa}
        step_7:
          name: 送风段
          fan: 离心风机（变频）
          
      output_parameters:
        temperature:
          summer: {value: 18, unit: ℃}
          winter: {value: 24, unit: ℃}
          transition: {value: 22, unit: ℃}
        humidity: {value: "45-55", unit: "%RH"}
        filtration: F7/F8
        
    tier_2_main_distribution:
      name: 主新风管网
      description: 从MAU到各楼层的主干管
      
      duct_parameters:
        material: 镀锌钢板
        thickness: {value: "0.75-1.2", unit: mm}
        insulation:
          material: 橡塑保温
          thickness: {value: 20, unit: mm}
          purpose: 防冷凝
        fire_damper:
          location: 穿越防火分区处
          rating: 70℃易熔片
          
      main_riser:
        description: 新风竖井/立管
        size: 根据服务楼层风量计算
        velocity: {value: "6-8", unit: "m/s"}
        location: 管井内
        
      floor_branch:
        description: 楼层水平主管
        size: 根据楼层风量计算
        velocity: {value: "5-7", unit: "m/s"}
        routing: 走廊吊顶上方
        
    tier_3_floor_header:
      name: 楼层新风分集器
      description: 楼层新风分配中心
      
      equipment:
        header_box:
          name: 新风分配箱
          material: 镀锌钢板
          size: 根据楼层风量
          location: 管井或走廊吊顶
          
        components:
          total_damper:
            name: 楼层总风阀
            type: 电动调节阀
            control: BA联动
          branch_dampers:
            name: 分支调节阀
            type: 手动/电动
            quantity: 每个房间支路一个
          measuring_station:
            name: 风量测量装置
            type: 皮托管阵列/文丘里
            purpose: 调试平衡
            
      control_points:
        sensors:
          - point_id: FH_FA_FLOW
            point_name: 楼层新风总量
            point_type: AI
            unit: "m³/h"
          - point_id: FH_FA_TEMP
            point_name: 新风温度
            point_type: AI
            unit: ℃
        commands:
          - point_id: FH_DAMPER
            point_name: 总风阀开度
            point_type: AO
            range: [0, 100]
            
    tier_4_room_terminal:
      name: 房间新风末端
      description: 新风进入房间的方式
      
      methods:
        method_1:
          name: 新风接入FCU回风口
          description: 新风管接入FCU吸风口，与回风混合
          
          advantages:
            - 新风与回风在FCU内混合均匀
            - 无需额外送风口
            - FCU处理后送出
            
          disadvantages:
            - FCU回风管需要开孔接入
            - 新风量受FCU风量限制
            - 可能影响FCU过滤器寿命
            
          installation:
            connection: DN100-DN150软接头
            position: FCU回风口侧面
            damper: 手动调节阀（调试用）
            
          applicable: 一般病房、办公室
          
        method_2:
          name: 房间壁面独立新风口
          description: 新风通过墙面风口直接进入房间
          
          advantages:
            - 与FCU完全独立
            - 新风直接进入房间
            - FCU故障不影响新风
            
          disadvantages:
            - 可能产生气流短路
            - 冬季冷风感
            - 需要合理布置位置
            
          installation:
            diffuser: 单层百叶风口
            position: 窗户对面墙（远离FCU送风口）
            height: 距地2.2m以上
            velocity: {value: "<2", unit: "m/s"}
            
          applicable: 需要大新风量的房间
          
        method_3:
          name: 吊顶散流器供新风（推荐）
          description: 新风通过吊顶散流器送入房间
          
          advantages:
            - 避免气流短路
            - 与FCU送风相近方式
            - 新风分布均匀
            
          disadvantages:
            - 吊顶开孔增加
            - 需要额外新风支管
            - 防火分区需设防火阀
            
          installation:
            diffuser: 方形散流器/条缝风口
            size: {value: "150×150 - 300×300", unit: mm}
            position: 远离FCU送风口
            fire_damper: 穿越防火分区时设置
            
          applicable: VIP病房、精密控制区域
          
        recommended_selection:
          general_ward: method_1（接入FCU回风口）
          isolation_ward: method_3（独立新风口）
          vip_room: method_3
          office: method_1或method_2
          
  # ========================================
  # 新风量计算与分配
  # ========================================
  fresh_air_calculation:
    
    per_person_requirement:
      standard: GB 50736-2012
      hospital_values:
        ward: {value: 30, unit: "m³/h/人"}
        outpatient: {value: 30, unit: "m³/h/人"}
        office: {value: 30, unit: "m³/h/人"}
        lobby: {value: 20, unit: "m³/h/人"}
        
    design_occupancy:
      single_ward:
        area: {value: 20, unit: "m²"}
        persons: {value: 2, unit: "人"}
        fresh_air: {value: 60, unit: "m³/h"}
      double_ward:
        area: {value: 30, unit: "m²"}
        persons: {value: 3, unit: "人"}
        fresh_air: {value: 90, unit: "m³/h"}
      multi_ward:
        area: {value: 50, unit: "m²"}
        persons: {value: 5, unit: "人"}
        fresh_air: {value: 150, unit: "m³/h"}
      private_office:
        area: {value: 15, unit: "m²"}
        persons: {value: 1, unit: "人"}
        fresh_air: {value: 30, unit: "m³/h"}
        
    minimum_background_ventilation:
      description: 无人时背景通风
      rate: {value: 0.5, unit: "次/h"}
      purpose: 维持室内空气新鲜
      control: 定时器或CO2传感器
      
    total_calculation:
      floor_total: 各房间新风量之和 × 1.1（余量系数）
      building_total: 各楼层之和 × 1.05（管道漏风）
      mau_capacity: 建筑总量 × 1.1（设计余量）
      
  # ========================================
  # 防短路设计
  # ========================================
  short_circuit_prevention:
    
    definition: |
      气流短路指新风送入后未充分混合即被排出或回风，
      导致新风效果不佳。
      
    prevention_measures:
      layout_principle:
        - 新风口与回风口（FCU吸风口）距离>3m
        - 新风送入高度与回风高度不同
        - 新风顺着气流主方向送入
        
      diffuser_selection:
        - 新风口选用低速送风型
        - 避免直吹人体
        - 与FCU送风方向一致或协调
        
      fcu_location:
        - FCU回风口朝向房间内部
        - 避免FCU送风直接对着门/窗
        
      computational_verification:
        method: CFD模拟
        criteria:
          换气效率: ">60%"
          空气龄: "<120s"
          不满意率: "<10%"
          
  # ========================================
  # 新风系统控制
  # ========================================
  control_strategy:
    
    constant_volume:
      description: 定风量新风系统
      method: MAU变频风机维持总风量恒定
      floor_damper: 固定开度（调试后锁定）
      applicable: 一般病房、办公区
      
    demand_controlled:
      description: 需求控制通风（DCV）
      method: 根据CO2浓度调节新风量
      
      sensors:
        co2:
          location: 典型房间或回风管
          setpoint: {value: 800, unit: ppm}
          range: {value: "400-1000", unit: ppm}
        occupancy:
          type: 人体感应/人数统计
          purpose: 无人时减少新风
          
      control:
        co2_high: 增加新风量
        co2_low: 减少新风量（不低于最小值）
        unoccupied: 最小背景通风
        
      applicable: 会议室、大厅、变人数区域
      
    schedule_based:
      description: 时间表控制
      method: 按作息时间调节
      
      schedule:
        occupied_hours:
          time: "07:00-21:00"
          fresh_air: 100%设计值
        unoccupied_hours:
          time: "21:00-07:00"
          fresh_air: 30%设计值（背景通风）
        pre_occupancy:
          time: 提前30分钟
          fresh_air: 100%
          purpose: 预通风:Condensate_Drain_System


identity:
    system_id: PLUMB-RW
    system_name: 雨水排水系统
    system_name_en: Rainwater Drainage System
    system_category: PLUMB
    system_type: 给排水-雨水
    priority_level: P3-GENERAL
    
    description: |
      医院建筑雨水排水系统，收集屋面、露台、广场等区域雨水并排放。
      采用重力流排水为主，必要时设置雨水泵站。
      设置雨水收集回用系统，用于绿化灌溉和道路冲洗。
      系统设计满足暴雨重现期要求，防止内涝。
      
    design_basis:
      rainfall:
        design_return_period: {value: 50, unit: "年", note: "重要公共建筑"}
        rainfall_intensity:
          formula: "q = 167A₁(1+C·lgP)/(t+b)ⁿ"
          note: 根据当地暴雨强度公式
        duration: {value: 5, unit: min}
      roof_area:
        total: {value: 15000, unit: "m²", note: "典型大型医院"}
      runoff_coefficient:
        roof: {value: 0.9}
        pavement: {value: 0.85}
        green: {value: 0.15}
        
    design_standards:
      - GB 50015-2019 建筑给水排水设计标准
      - GB 50014-2021 室外排水设计标准
      - GB 50400-2016 建筑与小区雨水控制及利用工程技术规范
      - 海绵城市建设技术指南
    
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  boundary:
    inputs:
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_001
        name: 屋面雨水
        from_system: 建筑屋面
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_002
        name: 露台雨水
        from_system: 室外露台/平台
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_003
        name: 场地雨水
        from_system: 室外场地
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_IN_004
        name: 电力供应
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        medium: ELEC-LV
        parameters:
          for: 雨水泵站
          
    outputs:
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_OUT_001
        name: 市政雨水管网
        to_system: 市政雨水
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_OUT_002
        name: 雨水回用
        to_system: 绿化/道路冲洗
        medium: WATER-RECLAIM
        
      - boundary_id: PLUMB-RW_OUT_003
        name: 状态反馈
        to_system: INT-BA
        medium: SIGNAL-BMS

  nodes:
  
    source_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        node_name: 屋面雨水收集
        node_name_en: Roof Rainwater Collection
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 收集屋面雨水
        medium_in: RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          roof_types:
            flat_roof:
              name: 平屋面
              slope: {value: "1-3", unit: "%"}
              drainage: 有组织排水
            sloped_roof:
              name: 坡屋面
              slope: {value: ">10", unit: "%"}
              drainage: 檐沟收集
            green_roof:
              name: 绿化屋面
              drainage: 蓄排水板+溢流
              retention: {value: 50, unit: "mm"}
              
          collection_components:
            roof_drain:
              name: 雨水斗
              type:
                gravity: 重力式雨水斗
                siphon: 虹吸式雨水斗
              material: 铸铁/不锈钢
              size: DN75-DN150
              strainer: 防叶片格栅
            gutter:
              name: 天沟/檐沟
              material: 镀锌钢板/不锈钢
              size: 根据汇水面积
              slope: {value: ">0.5", unit: "%"}
            overflow:
              name: 溢流口
              purpose: 超设计暴雨时溢流
              size: 不小于雨水斗
              
        design_calculation:
          flow_rate:
            formula: "Q = ψ × q × F / 10000"
            parameters:
              ψ: 径流系数
              q: 暴雨强度 (L/s·ha)
              F: 汇水面积 (m²)
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 屋面
          distribution: 按汇水分区布置

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SRC_GROUND
        node_name: 场地雨水收集
        node_name_en: Ground Rainwater Collection
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 收集场地雨水
        medium_in: RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          collection_facilities:
            catch_basin:
              name: 雨水口
              type: 平箅式/立箅式
              grate: 铸铁/球墨铸铁
              size: 400×600mm
              capacity: {value: 20, unit: "L/s"}
              spacing: {value: "25-50", unit: m}
            trench_drain:
              name: 线性排水沟
              material: 树脂混凝土
              width: {value: 150, unit: mm}
              grate: 不锈钢格栅
              application: 广场、入口
            permeable_pavement:
              name: 透水铺装
              type: 透水砖/透水混凝土
              infiltration: {value: ">1", unit: "mm/min"}
              application: 停车场、人行道
              
          sponge_city_facilities:
            rain_garden:
              name: 雨水花园
              purpose: 滞留、净化
              depth: {value: 150, unit: mm}
            bioswale:
              name: 植草沟
              purpose: 传输、净化
              slope: {value: "1-4", unit: "%"}
            detention_pond:
              name: 滞留塘
              purpose: 调蓄峰值流量
              volume: 根据设计计算
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 室外场地
          areas: 停车场、广场、道路

    distribution_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        node_name: 重力流排水系统
        node_name_en: Gravity Drainage System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PIP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 重力排放屋面雨水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 重力流内排水
          
          components:
            vertical_stack:
              name: 雨水立管
              material: HDPE/铸铁
              size: {value: "DN100-DN150", unit: mm}
              location: 建筑内管井
              quantity: 按汇水分区
            horizontal_pipe:
              name: 雨水横管
              material: HDPE/铸铁
              size: {value: "DN150-DN300", unit: mm}
              location: 地下室顶板下/室外埋地
              slope: {value: ">1", unit: "%"}
            check_valve:
              name: 逆止阀
              location: 出户管
              purpose: 防止市政倒灌
              
          design_parameters:
            max_flow_velocity: {value: 3, unit: "m/s"}
            min_slope: {value: 1, unit: "%"}
            fullness: {value: "<0.8"}
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 建筑内/地下

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_SIPHON_SYSTEM
        node_name: 虹吸式排水系统
        node_name_en: Siphonic Drainage System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PIP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 虹吸原理快速排水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 虹吸式屋面雨水排水
          
          principle: |
            利用虹吸原理，管道满流运行，
            排水能力大，管径小，不需要坡度。
            
          components:
            siphon_drain:
              name: 虹吸雨水斗
              type: 气水分离型
              material: HDPE/不锈钢
              features:
                - 防涡流
                - 气水分离
                - 自清洁
            siphon_pipe:
              name: 虹吸管道
              material: HDPE（热熔连接）
              pressure_rating: PN10
              features:
                - 满流设计
                - 无需坡度
                - 可水平敷设
            transition_point:
              name: 虹吸/重力转换点
              location: 建筑底部
              function: 虹吸转为重力流
              
          advantages:
            - 管径小（比重力流小30-50%）
            - 横管无需坡度
            - 排水能力大
            - 适合大跨度屋面
            
          design_parameters:
            design_depth: {value: 55, unit: mm, note: "斗前水深"}
            max_negative_pressure: {value: -80, unit: kPa}
            flow_velocity: {value: "3-10", unit: "m/s"}
            
        applicable: 大型裙房屋面、门诊大厅屋面
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 大跨度屋面

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_PUMP_STATION
        node_name: 雨水提升泵站
        node_name_en: Rainwater Pump Station
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PMP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 提升低洼区域雨水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        multiplicity: optional
        condition: 当雨水无法重力排放时设置
        
        equipment_parameters:
          application:
            - 地下室车道入口
            - 下沉广场
            - 低于市政管网标高区域
            
          components:
            sump:
              name: 集水池
              material: 钢筋混凝土
              volume: 根据来水量计算
              depth: {value: ">1.5", unit: m}
            pump:
              name: 潜水排污泵
              type: 潜水轴流泵/混流泵
              quantity: {value: "≥2", unit: "台", note: "1用1备"}
              material: 铸铁/不锈钢
              capacity: 根据汇水面积
            level_control:
              name: 液位控制
              type: 浮球开关/超声波液位计
              levels:
                start: 高液位
                stop: 低液位
                alarm: 超高液位
            check_valve:
              name: 止回阀
              location: 泵出口
            gate_valve:
              name: 闸阀
              location: 泵进出口
              
          control_logic:
            normal:
              - 水位达到启动液位→启动1台泵
              - 水位继续上升→启动2台泵
              - 水位下降至停止液位→停泵
            alarm:
              - 超高液位报警
              - 泵故障报警
            alternation:
              - 双泵交替运行
              - 故障自动切换
              
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: RW_SUMP_LEVEL
              point_name: 集水池液位
              point_type: AI
              unit: m
          status:
            - point_id: RW_PUMP_RUN
              point_name: 雨水泵运行
              point_type: DI
          alarms:
            - point_id: RW_HIGH_LEVEL
              alarm_name: 液位超高
              severity: HIGH
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 地下室/室外
          position: 汇水最低点

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_RECLAIM
        node_name: 雨水收集回用系统
        node_name_en: Rainwater Harvesting System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: TRT
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 雨水收集处理回用
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RECLAIM
        
        multiplicity: optional
        condition: 节水要求或海绵城市要求
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_components:
            initial_diversion:
              name: 初期雨水弃流装置
              function: 弃除初期污染雨水
              volume: {value: "2-5", unit: "mm降雨"}
              method: 容积式/流量式
            storage_tank:
              name: 雨水蓄水池
              material: 钢筋混凝土/PP模块
              volume:
                calculation: 根据汇水面积和回用量
                typical: {value: "200-500", unit: "m³"}
              location: 地下
            treatment:
              name: 雨水处理设备
              process:
                - 格栅过滤
                - 沉淀
                - 过滤（砂滤/膜滤）
                - 消毒（次氯酸钠）
              output_quality: 符合《城市污水再生利用 城市杂用水水质》
            supply_pump:
              name: 雨水供水泵
              type: 变频供水
              pressure: 根据供水点需求
            monitoring:
              parameters:
                - 浊度
                - pH
                - 余氯
                
          reuse_applications:
            greening:
              name: 绿化灌溉
              percentage: {value: 60, unit: "%"}
            road_washing:
              name: 道路冲洗
              percentage: {value: 20, unit: "%"}
            car_wash:
              name: 洗车
              percentage: {value: 10, unit: "%"}
            toilet_flushing:
              name: 冲厕（可选）
              percentage: {value: 10, unit: "%"}
              note: 需要独立中水管道
              
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: RW_TANK_LEVEL
              point_name: 蓄水池液位
              point_type: AI
              unit: m
            - point_id: RW_TURBIDITY
              point_name: 浊度
              point_type: AI
              unit: NTU
          status:
            - point_id: RW_SUPPLY_PUMP
              point_name: 供水泵运行
              point_type: DI
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 地下室/室外
          area: 绿化带附近

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
        node_name: 市政雨水管网
        node_name_en: Municipal Storm Sewer
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 排入市政雨水系统
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          connection:
            point: 院区雨水出口
            pipe_size: {value: "DN400-DN600", unit: mm}
            check_valve: required
            
          requirements:
            elevation: 高于市政管网
            flow_control: 必要时设置调蓄
            water_quality: 符合排放标准
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 院区边界
          connection: 市政雨水井

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SNK_REUSE
        node_name: 雨水回用点
        node_name_en: Rainwater Reuse Point
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 雨水回用末端
        medium_in: WATER-RECLAIM
        medium_out: WATER-RECLAIM
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          outlets:
            irrigation_valve:
              name: 绿化灌溉阀门
              type: 电磁阀
              control: 定时/智能灌溉
              location: 绿化带
            wash_tap:
              name: 冲洗龙头
              type: 自闭式水嘴
              marking: "非饮用水"标识
              location: 道路边、停车场
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 室外绑定化区域

  edges:
  
    collection_edges:
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 屋面至雨水斗
        edge_type: SURFACE
        from_node: 屋面
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: RAIN
        
    drainage_edges:
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 雨水立管
        edge_type: PIP
        from_node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_012
        edge_name: 出户雨水管
        edge_type: PIP
        from_node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: WATER-RAIN

  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: PLUMB-RW_PATH_GRAVITY
      path_name: 重力排水路径
      path_type: DRAIN
      description: 屋面雨水重力排放
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
          action: 雨水斗收集屋面雨水
        - step: 2
          node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
          action: 立管、横管输送
        - step: 3
          node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
          action: 排入市政雨水管

    - path_id: PLUMB-RW_PATH_RECLAIM
      path_name: 雨水回用路径
      path_type: RECLAIM
      description: 雨水收集处理回用
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
          action: 收集初期弃流后的雨水
        - step: 2
          node: PLUMB-RW_DST_RECLAIM
          action: 蓄水、处理、消毒
        - step: 3
          node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_REUSE
          action: 供绿化灌溉使用

  control_logic:
  
    pump_station_control:
      name: 雨水泵站控制
      description: 液位控制启停泵
      
      control_sequence:
        start_1:
          trigger: 液位>启动1
          action: 启动1#泵
        start_2:
          trigger: 液位>启动2
          action: 启动2#泵
        stop:
          trigger: 液位<停止
          action: 停止所有泵
        alarm:
          trigger: 液位>报警
          action: 超高液位报警
          
    reclaim_system_control:
      name: 雨水回用控制
      description: 雨水收集和供水控制
      
      control_sequence:
        collection:
          - 初期雨水弃流（前2mm降雨）
          - 弃流后雨水进入蓄水池
          - 池满后溢流至市政
        treatment:
          - 蓄水池液位>处理启动→启动处理设备
          - 清水池满→停止处理
        supply:
          - 用水信号→启动供水泵
          - 变频恒压供水
          - 蓄水池液位低→切换至自来水

  alarm_protection:
  
    drainage_alarms:
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_OVERFLOW
        alarm_name: 雨水溢流
        severity: MEDIUM
        trigger: 屋面溢流口有水流出
        action: 检查排水系统
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_PUMP_FAIL
        alarm_name: 雨水泵故障
        severity: HIGH
        trigger: 泵运行信号与液位矛盾
        action: 检修泵，启动备用
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_HIGH_LEVEL
        alarm_name: 集水池超高液位
        severity: CRITICAL
        trigger: 液位超限
        action: 紧急排水，防止内涝

  dependencies:
    
    upstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_RW_POWER
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY
        criticality: MEDIUM
        for: 雨水泵站
        
    downstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_TO_MUNICIPAL
        to_system: 市政雨水
        dependency_type: DRAINAGE
        criticality: MEDIUM:System_Topology


identity:
    system_id: ELEC-LTG
    system_name: 照明系统
    system_name_en: Lighting System
    system_category: ELEC
    system_type: 电气-照明
    priority_level: P2-BUSINESS_CRITICAL
    
    description: |
      医院照明系统，包括一般照明、应急照明、装饰照明等。
      根据不同医疗功能区域的照明需求进行差异化设计。
      与智能控制系统集成，实现节能和场景控制。
      应急照明系统确保疏散和关键区域的持续照明。
      
    design_basis:
      illuminance_standards:
        operating_room:
          general: {value: 750, unit: lux}
          surgical_field: {value: "20000-160000", unit: lux}
        treatment_room: {value: 500, unit: lux}
        ward: {value: 100, unit: lux}
        corridor: {value: 100, unit: lux}
        lobby: {value: 200, unit: lux}
        office: {value: 300, unit: lux}
      color_temperature:
        operating_room: {value: 4000, unit: K}
        ward: {value: 3000, unit: K}
        public_area: {value: 4000, unit: K}
      color_rendering:
        medical_area: {value: ">90", unit: Ra}
        general_area: {value: ">80", unit: Ra}
        
    design_standards:
      - GB 50034-2013 建筑照明设计标准
      - GB 51039-2014 综合医院建筑设计规范
      - GB 17945-2010 消防应急照明和疏散指示系统
      - GB 50016-2014 建筑设计防火规范
    
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  boundary:
    inputs:
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_001
        name: 正常电源
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        medium: ELEC-LV
        parameters:
          voltage: 220V AC
          
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_002
        name: 应急电源
        from_system: ELEC-EPS
        medium: ELEC-LV
        parameters:
          for: 应急照明和疏散指示
          
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_003
        name: 控制信号
        from_system: INT-BA
        medium: SIGNAL-BMS
        
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_004
        name: 火灾信号
        from_system: FIRE-FAS
        medium: SIGNAL-FIRE
        
    outputs:
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_OUT_001
        name: 照明效果
        to_system: 建筑空间
        medium: LIGHT
        
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_OUT_002
        name: 状态反馈
        to_system: INT-BA
        medium: SIGNAL-BMS

  nodes:
  
    source_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
        node_name: 正常照明电源
        node_name_en: Normal Lighting Power
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 为一般照明提供电源
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: ELEC-LV
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          source: 低压配电室照明配电柜
          voltage: 220V AC
          circuit: 照明配电箱
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: 配电室
          distribution: 各楼层照明配电箱

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SRC_EMERGENCY
        node_name: 应急照明电源
        node_name_en: Emergency Lighting Power
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 为应急照明提供电源
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: ELEC-LV
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          sources:
            eps:
              name: EPS应急电源
              capacity: 根据应急照明负荷
              duration: {value: "≥90", unit: min}
            battery:
              name: 灯具自带蓄电池
              type: 磷酸铁锂/镍氢
              duration: {value: "≥90", unit: min}
          switching_time: {value: "<5", unit: s}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: EPS室/各灯具

    distribution_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        node_name: 照明配电箱
        node_name_en: Lighting Distribution Panel
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: DST
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 照明电源分配
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: ELEC-LV
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL_{Building}_{Floor}_{Zone}
        
        equipment_parameters:
          type: 照明配电箱
          enclosure: IP30（室内）
          
          circuits:
            general_lighting:
              name: 一般照明回路
              voltage: 220V
              breaker: C型MCB
              capacity: {value: "16-32", unit: A}
            emergency_lighting:
              name: 应急照明回路
              voltage: 220V
              source: EPS或双电源
            controlled_lighting:
              name: 受控照明回路
              control: 智能控制模块
              
          smart_features:
            relay_module:
              name: 智能继电器模块
              protocol: KNX/Modbus
              function: 回路开关控制
            dimming_module:
              name: 调光模块
              type: 0-10V/DALI
              function: 亮度调节
              
        control_points:
          status:
            - point_id: LP_MAIN_CB
              point_name: 总开关状态
              point_type: DI
            - point_id: LP_CIRCUIT_STATUS
              point_name: 回路状态
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: LP_CIRCUIT_CMD
              point_name: 回路控制
              point_type: DO
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 电气管井/走廊
          floor: 每层

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
        node_name: 一般照明灯具
        node_name_en: General Lighting Fixtures
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: LTG
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 一般区域照明
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: LIGHT
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: 根据区域类型
        
        equipment_parameters:
          fixture_types:
            panel_light:
              name: LED平板灯
              power: {value: "24-48", unit: W}
              size: 600×600mm / 300×1200mm
              application: 办公室、走廊、病房
              features:
                - 无频闪
                - 高显色（Ra>90）
                - 防眩光（UGR<19）
            downlight:
              name: LED筒灯
              power: {value: "7-20", unit: W}
              size: Φ100-Φ200mm
              application: 大厅、走廊
            linear_light:
              name: LED线条灯
              power: {value: "15-40", unit: "W/m"}
              application: 走廊、指示
            pendant_light:
              name: 吊灯
              power: {value: "varies", unit: W}
              application: 大厅、餐厅
              
          lamp_parameters:
            led:
              efficacy: {value: ">100", unit: "lm/W"}
              lifespan: {value: 50000, unit: h}
              color_temp: {value: "3000-6000", unit: K}
              cri: {value: ">80", unit: Ra}
              
          control:
            switch: 传统开关
            dimming: 可调光（0-10V/DALI）
            sensor: 人体感应/光感
            schedule: 定时控制
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 各功能房间
          mounting: 嵌入式/明装/吊装

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_MEDICAL
        node_name: 医疗专用照明
        node_name_en: Medical Specialty Lighting
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: LTG
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 医疗专业照明
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: LIGHT
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          fixture_types:
            surgical_light:
              name: 手术无影灯
              type: LED/卤素
              illuminance: {value: "20000-160000", unit: lux}
              color_temp: {value: "3500-5000", unit: K}
              cri: {value: ">95", unit: Ra}
              features:
                - 无影
                - 冷光（低热辐射）
                - 可调焦距
                - 可调色温
              mounting: 吊顶/壁挂
              backup_power: UPS供电
              
            examination_light:
              name: 检查灯
              type: LED
              illuminance: {value: "10000-50000", unit: lux}
              application: 诊室、治疗室
              features:
                - 可移动
                - 聚光/散光可调
                
            reading_light:
              name: 床头阅读灯
              power: {value: "5-10", unit: W}
              color_temp: {value: 3000, unit: K}
              control: 床头开关
              application: 病房
              
            night_light:
              name: 夜间照明灯
              power: {value: "1-3", unit: W}
              illuminance: {value: "5-10", unit: lux}
              application: 病房、走廊
              features:
                - 脚踢线安装
                - 自动亮度调节
                
            observation_light:
              name: 观察灯
              power: {value: "10-20", unit: W}
              color_temp: {value: 4000, unit: K}
              application: ICU、NICU
              features:
                - 可调光
                - 不干扰患者睡眠
                
        location_hint:
          space_type: 医疗功能区

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_EMERGENCY
        node_name: 应急照明系统
        node_name_en: Emergency Lighting System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: EMR
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 火灾及停电时照明
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: LIGHT
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: 全院分布
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_architecture:
            centralized:
              name: 集中控制型
              description: A型应急照明（消防联动）
              controller: 应急照明控制器
              communication: 二总线
              features:
                - 集中监控
                - 智能疏散
                - 消防联动
            distributed:
              name: 分散型
              description: 自带蓄电池灯具
              battery: 灯具内置
              duration: {value: "≥90", unit: min}
              
          fixture_types:
            emergency_luminaire:
              name: 应急照明灯
              type: LED
              power: {value: "3-10", unit: W}
              illuminance: {value: "≥1", unit: lux}
              mounting: 吊装/壁挂
              spacing: {value: "<20", unit: m}
              location:
                - 走廊
                - 楼梯间
                - 设备房
                - 关键功能房间
                
            exit_sign:
              name: 疏散指示标志
              type: LED
              power: {value: "1-3", unit: W}
              luminance: {value: "≥5", unit: "cd/m²"}
              visibility: {value: "≥20", unit: m}
              types:
                - 安全出口标志
                - 疏散方向标志
                - 楼层标志
              location:
                - 安全出口上方
                - 走廊转弯处
                - 交叉路口
                
            floor_marking:
              name: 地面疏散标志
              type: 蓄光型/电致发光
              location: 走廊地面
              spacing: {value: "<3", unit: m}
              application: 大型公共区域
              
          intelligent_evacuation:
            name: 智能疏散系统
            components:
              main_controller:
                name: 应急照明控制器
                location: 消防控制室
                function:
                  - 系统监控
                  - 故障检测
                  - 消防联动
                  - 疏散路径规划
              area_controller:
                name: 区域控制器
                location: 各防火分区
                function:
                  - 区域监控
                  - 就地控制
              luminaires:
                name: 可寻址灯具
                feature: 双向通讯
                function:
                  - 方向可变
                  - 状态反馈
                  - 故障报告
                  
            operation_modes:
              normal:
                description: 平时状态
                luminaires: 充电待机
                signs: 常亮指示
              fire_mode:
                description: 火灾状态
                trigger: FAS火灾信号
                action:
                  - 所有应急灯亮
                  - 疏散指示按计算路径指向
                  - 着火区域指示改变方向
              blackout:
                description: 停电状态
                trigger: 正常电源失电
                action: 应急灯自动点亮
                
        control_points:
          status:
            - point_id: EL_SYSTEM_STATUS
              point_name: 系统状态
              point_type: DI
              values: [正常, 故障, 应急]
            - point_id: EL_BATTERY_STATUS
              point_name: 电池状态
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: EL_FIRE_MODE
              point_name: 消防模式
              point_type: DI
              from: FIRE-FAS
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 全院
          distribution: 疏散通道/关键区域

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_CONTROL
        node_name: 智能照明控制系统
        node_name_en: Intelligent Lighting Control System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: CTR
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 照明智能控制
        medium_in: SIGNAL
        medium_out: CONTROL
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 智能照明控制系统
          protocol:
            field_bus:
              - KNX
              - DALI
              - Modbus
            integration: BACnet（与BA集成）
            
          components:
            central_controller:
              name: 照明主控制器
              location: BA机房
              function:
                - 全院照明监控
                - 场景控制
                - 定时控制
                - 能耗统计
            area_controller:
              name: 区域控制器
              location: 各楼层/区域
              function:
                - 区域照明控制
                - 传感器采集
            field_devices:
              switch_actuator:
                name: 开关执行器
                type: 继电器模块
                channels: {value: "4-12", unit: "路"}
              dimming_actuator:
                name: 调光执行器
                type: 0-10V/DALI
                channels: {value: "4-8", unit: "路"}
              sensor:
                types:
                  - 人体感应传感器
                  - 照度传感器
                  - 多功能面板
                  
          control_strategies:
            time_schedule:
              name: 时间表控制
              description: 按作息时间开关
              application: 公共区域、办公室
              example:
                - "07:00 开启公共区域照明"
                - "18:00 调暗非必要区域"
                - "22:00 切换夜间模式"
                
            occupancy_sensing:
              name: 人体感应控制
              description: 检测人员进入/离开
              application: 走廊、卫生间、会议室
              parameters:
                detection_range: {value: 8, unit: m}
                hold_time: {value: "5-15", unit: min}
                
            daylight_harvesting:
              name: 日光补偿控制
              description: 根据自然光调节人工照明
              application: 窗边区域
              parameters:
                target_illuminance: {value: 300, unit: lux}
                control_band: {value: "±50", unit: lux}
                
            scene_control:
              name: 场景控制
              description: 预设照明场景
              scenes:
                ward_day:
                  name: 病房-日间
                  illuminance: {value: 100, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 4000, unit: K}
                ward_night:
                  name: 病房-夜间
                  illuminance: {value: 10, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 2700, unit: K}
                examination:
                  name: 检查模式
                  illuminance: {value: 500, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 5000, unit: K}
                cleaning:
                  name: 清洁模式
                  illuminance: {value: 300, unit: lux}
                  duration: {value: 30, unit: min}
                  
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: LCS_ILLUMINANCE
              point_name: 环境照度
              point_type: AI
              unit: lux
            - point_id: LCS_OCCUPANCY
              point_name: 人员在场
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: LCS_SCENE
              point_name: 场景切换
              point_type: DO
            - point_id: LCS_DIMMING
              point_name: 调光控制
              point_type: AO
              range: [0, 100]
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: BA机房/各区域

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SNK_SPACE
        node_name: 照明空间
        node_name_en: Illuminated Space
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 接受照明效果
        medium_in: LIGHT
        medium_out: ILLUMINATED_ENVIRONMENT
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          space_categories:
            medical_treatment:
              areas:
                - 手术室
                - 诊室
                - 治疗室
                - 检查室
              requirements:
                - 高照度
                - 高显色性
                - 无频闪
                - 专业灯具
            patient_care:
              areas:
                - 病房
                - ICU
                - 观察室
              requirements:
                - 舒适照明
                - 夜间照明
                - 分区控制
                - 患者个人控制
            public_circulation:
              areas:
                - 门诊大厅
                - 走廊
                - 电梯厅
              requirements:
                - 均匀照明
                - 节能控制
                - 应急照明
            support_service:
              areas:
                - 办公室
                - 会议室
                - 餐厅
                - 库房
              requirements:
                - 标准照明
                - 智能控制
                
        location_hint:
          space_type: 全院建筑空间

  edges:
  
    power_edges:
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 正常电源至配电箱
        edge_type: CAB
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: ELEC-LV
        
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_002
        edge_name: 配电箱至灯具
        edge_type: CAB
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: ELEC-LV

    control_edges:
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 控制系统至配电箱
        edge_type: SIG
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_CONTROL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: SIGNAL-CONTROL

  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: ELEC-LTG_PATH_NORMAL
      path_name: 正常照明路径
      path_type: PWR
      description: 正常供电照明
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
          action: 从低压配电供电
        - step: 2
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
          action: 配电箱分配
        - step: 3
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
          action: 灯具点亮
        - step: 4
          node: ELEC-LTG_SNK_SPACE
          action: 空间照明

    - path_id: ELEC-LTG_PATH_EMERGENCY
      path_name: 应急照明路径
      path_type: EMR
      description: 火灾或停电时应急照明
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          trigger: 火灾信号或停电
        - step: 2
          node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_EMERGENCY
          action: EPS或电池供电
        - step: 3
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_EMERGENCY
          action: 应急灯具点亮
        - step: 4
          node: 疏散通道
          action: 提供疏散照明

  control_logic:
  
    daily_schedule:
      name: 日常时间表控制
      description: 按医院作息自动控制
      
      schedule:
        "06:30":
          action: 开启公共区域照明
          areas: 走廊、大厅、电梯厅
        "07:00":
          action: 开启诊室照明
          areas: 门诊、医技
        "08:00":
          action: 全部照明正常
        "18:00":
          action: 关闭部分照明
          areas: 非必要办公区
        "21:00":
          action: 切换夜间模式
          areas: 病房（降低照度）
        "22:00":
          action: 公共区域减光
          areas: 走廊（50%亮度）
          
    fire_interlock:
      name: 消防联动
      description: 火灾时照明控制
      
      trigger: FIRE-FAS火灾确认信号
      
      response:
        emergency_lighting:
          action: 所有应急照明点亮
          mode: 100%亮度
        evacuation_signs:
          action: 疏散指示启动
          mode: 智能疏散（如有）
        non_fire_floors:
          action: 保持正常照明
          purpose: 避免恐慌

  alarm_protection:
  
    lighting_alarms:
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_LAMP_FAIL
        alarm_name: 灯具故障
        severity: LOW
        trigger: 灯具不亮/闪烁
        action: 更换灯具
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_CIRCUIT_TRIP
        alarm_name: 照明回路跳闸
        severity: MEDIUM
        trigger: 回路断路器跳闸
        action: 检查短路/过载
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_EMERGENCY_FAIL
        alarm_name: 应急照明故障
        severity: HIGH
        trigger: 应急灯自检失败
        action: 立即检修

  dependencies:
    
    upstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_NORMAL
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY
        criticality: HIGH
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_EMERGENCY
        from_system: ELEC-EPS
        dependency_type: EMERGENCY_POWER
        criticality: CRITICAL
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_FAS
        from_system: FIRE-FAS
        dependency_type: FIRE_SIGNAL
        criticality: CRITICAL
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_BA
        from_system: INT-BA
        dependency_type: CONTROL
        criticality: MEDIUM:System_Dependency_Matrix


identity:
    name: 医院机电系统依赖关系总图
    description: 展示所有系统间的依赖和联动关系
    version: 1.0
    total_systems: 26
    last_updated: 2024

  # ========================================
  # 系统清单
  # ========================================
  system_inventory:
    
    electrical_systems:
      - id: ELEC-HV
        name: 高压配电系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-LV
        name: 低压配电系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-EPS
        name: 应急电源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-UPS
        name: 不间断电源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-EL
        name: 电梯系统
        priority: P2
      - id: ELEC-LTG
