            siphon_drain:
              name: 虹吸雨水斗
              type: 气水分离型
              material: HDPE/不锈钢
              features:
                - 防涡流
                - 气水分离
                - 自清洁
            siphon_pipe:
              name: 虹吸管道
              material: HDPE（热熔连接）
              pressure_rating: PN10
              features:
                - 满流设计
                - 无需坡度
                - 可水平敷设
            transition_point:
              name: 虹吸/重力转换点
              location: 建筑底部
              function: 虹吸转为重力流
              
          advantages:
            - 管径小（比重力流小30-50%）
            - 横管无需坡度
            - 排水能力大
            - 适合大跨度屋面
            
          design_parameters:
            design_depth: {value: 55, unit: mm, note: "斗前水深"}
            max_negative_pressure: {value: -80, unit: kPa}
            flow_velocity: {value: "3-10", unit: "m/s"}
            
        applicable: 大型裙房屋面、门诊大厅屋面
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 大跨度屋面

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_PUMP_STATION
        node_name: 雨水提升泵站
        node_name_en: Rainwater Pump Station
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: PMP
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 提升低洼区域雨水
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        multiplicity: optional
        condition: 当雨水无法重力排放时设置
        
        equipment_parameters:
          application:
            - 地下室车道入口
            - 下沉广场
            - 低于市政管网标高区域
            
          components:
            sump:
              name: 集水池
              material: 钢筋混凝土
              volume: 根据来水量计算
              depth: {value: ">1.5", unit: m}
            pump:
              name: 潜水排污泵
              type: 潜水轴流泵/混流泵
              quantity: {value: "≥2", unit: "台", note: "1用1备"}
              material: 铸铁/不锈钢
              capacity: 根据汇水面积
            level_control:
              name: 液位控制
              type: 浮球开关/超声波液位计
              levels:
                start: 高液位
                stop: 低液位
                alarm: 超高液位
            check_valve:
              name: 止回阀
              location: 泵出口
            gate_valve:
              name: 闸阀
              location: 泵进出口
              
          control_logic:
            normal:
              - 水位达到启动液位→启动1台泵
              - 水位继续上升→启动2台泵
              - 水位下降至停止液位→停泵
            alarm:
              - 超高液位报警
              - 泵故障报警
            alternation:
              - 双泵交替运行
              - 故障自动切换
              
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: RW_SUMP_LEVEL
              point_name: 集水池液位
              point_type: AI
              unit: m
          status:
            - point_id: RW_PUMP_RUN
              point_name: 雨水泵运行
              point_type: DI
          alarms:
            - point_id: RW_HIGH_LEVEL
              alarm_name: 液位超高
              severity: HIGH
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 地下室/室外
          position: 汇水最低点

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_DST_RECLAIM
        node_name: 雨水收集回用系统
        node_name_en: Rainwater Harvesting System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: TRT
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 雨水收集处理回用
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RECLAIM
        
        multiplicity: optional
        condition: 节水要求或海绵城市要求
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_components:
            initial_diversion:
              name: 初期雨水弃流装置
              function: 弃除初期污染雨水
              volume: {value: "2-5", unit: "mm降雨"}
              method: 容积式/流量式
            storage_tank:
              name: 雨水蓄水池
              material: 钢筋混凝土/PP模块
              volume:
                calculation: 根据汇水面积和回用量
                typical: {value: "200-500", unit: "m³"}
              location: 地下
            treatment:
              name: 雨水处理设备
              process:
                - 格栅过滤
                - 沉淀
                - 过滤（砂滤/膜滤）
                - 消毒（次氯酸钠）
              output_quality: 符合《城市污水再生利用 城市杂用水水质》
            supply_pump:
              name: 雨水供水泵
              type: 变频供水
              pressure: 根据供水点需求
            monitoring:
              parameters:
                - 浊度
                - pH
                - 余氯
                
          reuse_applications:
            greening:
              name: 绿化灌溉
              percentage: {value: 60, unit: "%"}
            road_washing:
              name: 道路冲洗
              percentage: {value: 20, unit: "%"}
            car_wash:
              name: 洗车
              percentage: {value: 10, unit: "%"}
            toilet_flushing:
              name: 冲厕（可选）
              percentage: {value: 10, unit: "%"}
              note: 需要独立中水管道
              
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: RW_TANK_LEVEL
              point_name: 蓄水池液位
              point_type: AI
              unit: m
            - point_id: RW_TURBIDITY
              point_name: 浊度
              point_type: AI
              unit: NTU
          status:
            - point_id: RW_SUPPLY_PUMP
              point_name: 供水泵运行
              point_type: DI
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 地下室/室外
          area: 绿化带附近

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
        node_name: 市政雨水管网
        node_name_en: Municipal Storm Sewer
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 排入市政雨水系统
        medium_in: WATER-RAIN
        medium_out: WATER-RAIN
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          connection:
            point: 院区雨水出口
            pipe_size: {value: "DN400-DN600", unit: mm}
            check_valve: required
            
          requirements:
            elevation: 高于市政管网
            flow_control: 必要时设置调蓄
            water_quality: 符合排放标准
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 院区边界
          connection: 市政雨水井

      - node_id: PLUMB-RW_SNK_REUSE
        node_name: 雨水回用点
        node_name_en: Rainwater Reuse Point
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 雨水回用末端
        medium_in: WATER-RECLAIM
        medium_out: WATER-RECLAIM
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          outlets:
            irrigation_valve:
              name: 绿化灌溉阀门
              type: 电磁阀
              control: 定时/智能灌溉
              location: 绿化带
            wash_tap:
              name: 冲洗龙头
              type: 自闭式水嘴
              marking: "非饮用水"标识
              location: 道路边、停车场
              
        location_hint:
          space_type: 室外绑定化区域

  edges:
  
    collection_edges:
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 屋面至雨水斗
        edge_type: SURFACE
        from_node: 屋面
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: RAIN
        
    drainage_edges:
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 雨水立管
        edge_type: PIP
        from_node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: WATER-RAIN
        
      - edge_id: PLUMB-RW_EDGE_012
        edge_name: 出户雨水管
        edge_type: PIP
        from_node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
        to_node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: WATER-RAIN

  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: PLUMB-RW_PATH_GRAVITY
      path_name: 重力排水路径
      path_type: DRAIN
      description: 屋面雨水重力排放
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
          action: 雨水斗收集屋面雨水
        - step: 2
          node: PLUMB-RW_DST_GRAVITY_SYSTEM
          action: 立管、横管输送
        - step: 3
          node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_MUNICIPAL
          action: 排入市政雨水管

    - path_id: PLUMB-RW_PATH_RECLAIM
      path_name: 雨水回用路径
      path_type: RECLAIM
      description: 雨水收集处理回用
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: PLUMB-RW_SRC_ROOF
          action: 收集初期弃流后的雨水
        - step: 2
          node: PLUMB-RW_DST_RECLAIM
          action: 蓄水、处理、消毒
        - step: 3
          node: PLUMB-RW_SNK_REUSE
          action: 供绿化灌溉使用

  control_logic:
  
    pump_station_control:
      name: 雨水泵站控制
      description: 液位控制启停泵
      
      control_sequence:
        start_1:
          trigger: 液位>启动1
          action: 启动1#泵
        start_2:
          trigger: 液位>启动2
          action: 启动2#泵
        stop:
          trigger: 液位<停止
          action: 停止所有泵
        alarm:
          trigger: 液位>报警
          action: 超高液位报警
          
    reclaim_system_control:
      name: 雨水回用控制
      description: 雨水收集和供水控制
      
      control_sequence:
        collection:
          - 初期雨水弃流（前2mm降雨）
          - 弃流后雨水进入蓄水池
          - 池满后溢流至市政
        treatment:
          - 蓄水池液位>处理启动→启动处理设备
          - 清水池满→停止处理
        supply:
          - 用水信号→启动供水泵
          - 变频恒压供水
          - 蓄水池液位低→切换至自来水

  alarm_protection:
  
    drainage_alarms:
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_OVERFLOW
        alarm_name: 雨水溢流
        severity: MEDIUM
        trigger: 屋面溢流口有水流出
        action: 检查排水系统
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_PUMP_FAIL
        alarm_name: 雨水泵故障
        severity: HIGH
        trigger: 泵运行信号与液位矛盾
        action: 检修泵，启动备用
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_RW_HIGH_LEVEL
        alarm_name: 集水池超高液位
        severity: CRITICAL
        trigger: 液位超限
        action: 紧急排水，防止内涝

  dependencies:
    
    upstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_RW_POWER
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY
        criticality: MEDIUM
        for: 雨水泵站
        
    downstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_TO_MUNICIPAL
        to_system: 市政雨水
        dependency_type: DRAINAGE
        criticality: MEDIUM:System_Topology


identity:
    system_id: ELEC-LTG
    system_name: 照明系统
    system_name_en: Lighting System
    system_category: ELEC
    system_type: 电气-照明
    priority_level: P2-BUSINESS_CRITICAL
    
    description: |
      医院照明系统，包括一般照明、应急照明、装饰照明等。
      根据不同医疗功能区域的照明需求进行差异化设计。
      与智能控制系统集成，实现节能和场景控制。
      应急照明系统确保疏散和关键区域的持续照明。
      
    design_basis:
      illuminance_standards:
        operating_room:
          general: {value: 750, unit: lux}
          surgical_field: {value: "20000-160000", unit: lux}
        treatment_room: {value: 500, unit: lux}
        ward: {value: 100, unit: lux}
        corridor: {value: 100, unit: lux}
        lobby: {value: 200, unit: lux}
        office: {value: 300, unit: lux}
      color_temperature:
        operating_room: {value: 4000, unit: K}
        ward: {value: 3000, unit: K}
        public_area: {value: 4000, unit: K}
      color_rendering:
        medical_area: {value: ">90", unit: Ra}
        general_area: {value: ">80", unit: Ra}
        
    design_standards:
      - GB 50034-2013 建筑照明设计标准
      - GB 51039-2014 综合医院建筑设计规范
      - GB 17945-2010 消防应急照明和疏散指示系统
      - GB 50016-2014 建筑设计防火规范
    
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  boundary:
    inputs:
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_001
        name: 正常电源
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        medium: ELEC-LV
        parameters:
          voltage: 220V AC
          
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_002
        name: 应急电源
        from_system: ELEC-EPS
        medium: ELEC-LV
        parameters:
          for: 应急照明和疏散指示
          
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_003
        name: 控制信号
        from_system: INT-BA
        medium: SIGNAL-BMS
        
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_IN_004
        name: 火灾信号
        from_system: FIRE-FAS
        medium: SIGNAL-FIRE
        
    outputs:
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_OUT_001
        name: 照明效果
        to_system: 建筑空间
        medium: LIGHT
        
      - boundary_id: ELEC-LTG_OUT_002
        name: 状态反馈
        to_system: INT-BA
        medium: SIGNAL-BMS

  nodes:
  
    source_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
        node_name: 正常照明电源
        node_name_en: Normal Lighting Power
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 为一般照明提供电源
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: ELEC-LV
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          source: 低压配电室照明配电柜
          voltage: 220V AC
          circuit: 照明配电箱
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: 配电室
          distribution: 各楼层照明配电箱

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SRC_EMERGENCY
        node_name: 应急照明电源
        node_name_en: Emergency Lighting Power
        node_type: Source_Node
        node_category: SRC
        
        function: 为应急照明提供电源
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: ELEC-LV
        
        is_boundary_input: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          sources:
            eps:
              name: EPS应急电源
              capacity: 根据应急照明负荷
              duration: {value: "≥90", unit: min}
            battery:
              name: 灯具自带蓄电池
              type: 磷酸铁锂/镍氢
              duration: {value: "≥90", unit: min}
          switching_time: {value: "<5", unit: s}
          
        location_hint:
          space_type: EPS室/各灯具

    distribution_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL

        node_name_en: Lighting Distribution Panel
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: DST
        node_category: DST

        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: ELEC-LV

              name: 应急照明回路
              voltage: 220V
              source: EPS或双电源
            controlled_lighting:
              name: 受控照明回路
              control: 智能控制模块

              point_type: DI

              point_name: 回路状态

          commands:

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
        node_name: 一般照明灯具

        node_type: Distribution_Node

        node_category: DST

              features:

                - 高显色（Ra>90）
                - 防眩光（UGR<19）
            downlight:
              name: LED筒灯
              power: {value: "7-20", unit: W}
              size: Φ100-Φ200mm
              application: 大厅、走廊
            linear_light:
              name: LED线条灯
              power: {value: "15-40", unit: "W/m"}
              application: 走廊、指示
            pendant_light:
              name: 吊灯
              power: {value: "varies", unit: W}
              application: 大厅、餐厅
              
          lamp_parameters:
            led:
              efficacy: {value: ">100", unit: "lm/W"}
              lifespan: {value: 50000, unit: h}
              color_temp: {value: "3000-6000", unit: K}
              cri: {value: ">80", unit: Ra}
              
          control:
            switch: 传统开关
            dimming: 可调光（0-10V/DALI）
            sensor: 人体感应/光感
            schedule: 定时控制
            
        location_hint:
          space_type: 各功能房间
          mounting: 嵌入式/明装/吊装

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_MEDICAL
        node_name: 医疗专用照明
        node_name_en: Medical Specialty Lighting
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: LTG
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 医疗专业照明
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: LIGHT
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        
        equipment_parameters:
          fixture_types:
            surgical_light:
              name: 手术无影灯
              type: LED/卤素
              illuminance: {value: "20000-160000", unit: lux}
              color_temp: {value: "3500-5000", unit: K}
              cri: {value: ">95", unit: Ra}
              features:
                - 无影
                - 冷光（低热辐射）
                - 可调焦距
                - 可调色温
              mounting: 吊顶/壁挂
              backup_power: UPS供电
              
            examination_light:
              name: 检查灯
              type: LED
              illuminance: {value: "10000-50000", unit: lux}
              application: 诊室、治疗室
              features:
                - 可移动
                - 聚光/散光可调
                
            reading_light:
              name: 床头阅读灯
              power: {value: "5-10", unit: W}
              color_temp: {value: 3000, unit: K}
              control: 床头开关
              application: 病房
              
            night_light:
              name: 夜间照明灯
              power: {value: "1-3", unit: W}
              illuminance: {value: "5-10", unit: lux}
              application: 病房、走廊
              features:
                - 脚踢线安装
                - 自动亮度调节
                
            observation_light:
              name: 观察灯
              power: {value: "10-20", unit: W}
              color_temp: {value: 4000, unit: K}
              application: ICU、NICU
              features:
                - 可调光
                - 不干扰患者睡眠
                
        location_hint:
          space_type: 医疗功能区

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_EMERGENCY
        node_name: 应急照明系统
        node_name_en: Emergency Lighting System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: EMR
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 火灾及停电时照明
        medium_in: ELEC-LV
        medium_out: LIGHT
        
        multiplicity: multiple
        instance_pattern: 全院分布
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_architecture:
            centralized:
              name: 集中控制型
              description: A型应急照明（消防联动）
              controller: 应急照明控制器
              communication: 二总线
              features:
                - 集中监控
                - 智能疏散
                - 消防联动
            distributed:
              name: 分散型
              description: 自带蓄电池灯具
              battery: 灯具内置
              duration: {value: "≥90", unit: min}
              
          fixture_types:
            emergency_luminaire:
              name: 应急照明灯
              type: LED
              power: {value: "3-10", unit: W}
              illuminance: {value: "≥1", unit: lux}
              mounting: 吊装/壁挂
              spacing: {value: "<20", unit: m}
              location:
                - 走廊
                - 楼梯间
                - 设备房
                - 关键功能房间
                
            exit_sign:
              name: 疏散指示标志
              type: LED
              power: {value: "1-3", unit: W}
              luminance: {value: "≥5", unit: "cd/m²"}
              visibility: {value: "≥20", unit: m}
              types:
                - 安全出口标志
                - 疏散方向标志
                - 楼层标志
              location:
                - 安全出口上方
                - 走廊转弯处
                - 交叉路口
                
            floor_marking:
              name: 地面疏散标志
              type: 蓄光型/电致发光
              location: 走廊地面
              spacing: {value: "<3", unit: m}
              application: 大型公共区域
              
          intelligent_evacuation:
            name: 智能疏散系统
            components:
              main_controller:
                name: 应急照明控制器
                location: 消防控制室
                function:
                  - 系统监控
                  - 故障检测
                  - 消防联动
                  - 疏散路径规划
              area_controller:
                name: 区域控制器
                location: 各防火分区
                function:
                  - 区域监控
                  - 就地控制
              luminaires:
                name: 可寻址灯具
                feature: 双向通讯
                function:
                  - 方向可变
                  - 状态反馈
                  - 故障报告
                  
            operation_modes:
              normal:
                description: 平时状态
                luminaires: 充电待机
                signs: 常亮指示
              fire_mode:
                description: 火灾状态
                trigger: FAS火灾信号
                action:
                  - 所有应急灯亮
                  - 疏散指示按计算路径指向
                  - 着火区域指示改变方向
              blackout:
                description: 停电状态
                trigger: 正常电源失电
                action: 应急灯自动点亮
                
        control_points:
          status:
            - point_id: EL_SYSTEM_STATUS
              point_name: 系统状态
              point_type: DI
              values: [正常, 故障, 应急]
            - point_id: EL_BATTERY_STATUS
              point_name: 电池状态
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: EL_FIRE_MODE
              point_name: 消防模式
              point_type: DI
              from: FIRE-FAS
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: 全院
          distribution: 疏散通道/关键区域

      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_DST_CONTROL
        node_name: 智能照明控制系统
        node_name_en: Intelligent Lighting Control System
        node_type: Distribution_Node
        node_subtype: CTR
        node_category: DST
        
        function: 照明智能控制
        medium_in: SIGNAL
        medium_out: CONTROL
        
        equipment_parameters:
          system_type: 智能照明控制系统
          protocol:
            field_bus:
              - KNX
              - DALI
              - Modbus
            integration: BACnet（与BA集成）
            
          components:
            central_controller:
              name: 照明主控制器
              location: BA机房
              function:
                - 全院照明监控
                - 场景控制
                - 定时控制
                - 能耗统计
            area_controller:
              name: 区域控制器
              location: 各楼层/区域
              function:
                - 区域照明控制
                - 传感器采集
            field_devices:
              switch_actuator:
                name: 开关执行器
                type: 继电器模块
                channels: {value: "4-12", unit: "路"}
              dimming_actuator:
                name: 调光执行器
                type: 0-10V/DALI
                channels: {value: "4-8", unit: "路"}
              sensor:
                types:
                  - 人体感应传感器
                  - 照度传感器
                  - 多功能面板
                  
          control_strategies:
            time_schedule:
              name: 时间表控制
              description: 按作息时间开关
              application: 公共区域、办公室
              example:
                - "07:00 开启公共区域照明"
                - "18:00 调暗非必要区域"
                - "22:00 切换夜间模式"
                
            occupancy_sensing:
              name: 人体感应控制
              description: 检测人员进入/离开
              application: 走廊、卫生间、会议室
              parameters:
                detection_range: {value: 8, unit: m}
                hold_time: {value: "5-15", unit: min}
                
            daylight_harvesting:
              name: 日光补偿控制
              description: 根据自然光调节人工照明
              application: 窗边区域
              parameters:
                target_illuminance: {value: 300, unit: lux}
                control_band: {value: "±50", unit: lux}
                
            scene_control:
              name: 场景控制
              description: 预设照明场景
              scenes:
                ward_day:
                  name: 病房-日间
                  illuminance: {value: 100, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 4000, unit: K}
                ward_night:
                  name: 病房-夜间
                  illuminance: {value: 10, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 2700, unit: K}
                examination:
                  name: 检查模式
                  illuminance: {value: 500, unit: lux}
                  color_temp: {value: 5000, unit: K}
                cleaning:
                  name: 清洁模式
                  illuminance: {value: 300, unit: lux}
                  duration: {value: 30, unit: min}
                  
        control_points:
          sensors:
            - point_id: LCS_ILLUMINANCE
              point_name: 环境照度
              point_type: AI
              unit: lux
            - point_id: LCS_OCCUPANCY
              point_name: 人员在场
              point_type: DI
          commands:
            - point_id: LCS_SCENE
              point_name: 场景切换
              point_type: DO
            - point_id: LCS_DIMMING
              point_name: 调光控制
              point_type: AO
              range: [0, 100]
        
        location_hint:
          space_type: BA机房/各区域

    sink_nodes:
    
      - node_id: ELEC-LTG_SNK_SPACE
        node_name: 照明空间
        node_name_en: Illuminated Space
        node_type: Sink_Node
        node_category: SNK
        
        function: 接受照明效果
        medium_in: LIGHT
        medium_out: ILLUMINATED_ENVIRONMENT
        
        is_boundary_output: true
        
        equipment_parameters:
          space_categories:
            medical_treatment:
              areas:
                - 手术室
                - 诊室
                - 治疗室
                - 检查室
              requirements:
                - 高照度
                - 高显色性
                - 无频闪
                - 专业灯具
            patient_care:
              areas:
                - 病房
                - ICU
                - 观察室
              requirements:
                - 舒适照明
                - 夜间照明
                - 分区控制
                - 患者个人控制
            public_circulation:
              areas:
                - 门诊大厅
                - 走廊
                - 电梯厅
              requirements:
                - 均匀照明
                - 节能控制
                - 应急照明
            support_service:
              areas:
                - 办公室
                - 会议室
                - 餐厅
                - 库房
              requirements:
                - 标准照明
                - 智能控制
                
        location_hint:
          space_type: 全院建筑空间

  edges:
  
    power_edges:
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_001
        edge_name: 正常电源至配电箱
        edge_type: CAB
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: ELEC-LV
        
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_002
        edge_name: 配电箱至灯具
        edge_type: CAB
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: ELEC-LV

    control_edges:
      - edge_id: ELEC-LTG_EDGE_011
        edge_name: 控制系统至配电箱
        edge_type: SIG
        from_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_CONTROL
        to_node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
        direction: unidirectional
        medium: SIGNAL-CONTROL

  typical_paths:
  
    - path_id: ELEC-LTG_PATH_NORMAL
      path_name: 正常照明路径
      path_type: PWR
      description: 正常供电照明
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_NORMAL
          action: 从低压配电供电
        - step: 2
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_PANEL
          action: 配电箱分配
        - step: 3
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_GENERAL
          action: 灯具点亮
        - step: 4
          node: ELEC-LTG_SNK_SPACE
          action: 空间照明

    - path_id: ELEC-LTG_PATH_EMERGENCY
      path_name: 应急照明路径
      path_type: EMR
      description: 火灾或停电时应急照明
      sequence:
        - step: 1
          trigger: 火灾信号或停电
        - step: 2
          node: ELEC-LTG_SRC_EMERGENCY
          action: EPS或电池供电
        - step: 3
          node: ELEC-LTG_DST_EMERGENCY
          action: 应急灯具点亮
        - step: 4
          node: 疏散通道
          action: 提供疏散照明

  control_logic:
  
    daily_schedule:
      name: 日常时间表控制
      description: 按医院作息自动控制
      
      schedule:
        "06:30":
          action: 开启公共区域照明
          areas: 走廊、大厅、电梯厅
        "07:00":
          action: 开启诊室照明
          areas: 门诊、医技
        "08:00":
          action: 全部照明正常
        "18:00":
          action: 关闭部分照明
          areas: 非必要办公区
        "21:00":
          action: 切换夜间模式
          areas: 病房（降低照度）
        "22:00":
          action: 公共区域减光
          areas: 走廊（50%亮度）
          
    fire_interlock:
      name: 消防联动
      description: 火灾时照明控制
      
      trigger: FIRE-FAS火灾确认信号
      
      response:
        emergency_lighting:
          action: 所有应急照明点亮
          mode: 100%亮度
        evacuation_signs:
          action: 疏散指示启动
          mode: 智能疏散（如有）
        non_fire_floors:
          action: 保持正常照明
          purpose: 避免恐慌

  alarm_protection:
  
    lighting_alarms:
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_LAMP_FAIL
        alarm_name: 灯具故障
        severity: LOW
        trigger: 灯具不亮/闪烁
        action: 更换灯具
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_CIRCUIT_TRIP
        alarm_name: 照明回路跳闸
        severity: MEDIUM
        trigger: 回路断路器跳闸
        action: 检查短路/过载
        
      - alarm_id: ALM_LTG_EMERGENCY_FAIL
        alarm_name: 应急照明故障
        severity: HIGH
        trigger: 应急灯自检失败
        action: 立即检修

  dependencies:
    
    upstream_dependencies:
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_NORMAL
        from_system: ELEC-LV
        dependency_type: POWER_SUPPLY
        criticality: HIGH
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_EMERGENCY
        from_system: ELEC-EPS
        dependency_type: EMERGENCY_POWER
        criticality: CRITICAL
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_FAS
        from_system: FIRE-FAS
        dependency_type: FIRE_SIGNAL
        criticality: CRITICAL
        
      - dependency_id: DEP_LTG_BA
        from_system: INT-BA
        dependency_type: CONTROL
        criticality: MEDIUM:System_Dependency_Matrix


identity:
    name: 医院机电系统依赖关系总图
    description: 展示所有系统间的依赖和联动关系
    version: 1.0
    total_systems: 26
    last_updated: 2024

  # ========================================
  # 系统清单
  # ========================================
  system_inventory:
    
    electrical_systems:
      - id: ELEC-HV
        name: 高压配电系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-LV
        name: 低压配电系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-EPS
        name: 应急电源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-UPS
        name: 不间断电源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: ELEC-EL
        name: 电梯系统
        priority: P2
      - id: ELEC-LTG
        name: 照明系统
        priority: P2
        
    hvac_systems:
      - id: HVAC-CHP
        name: 冷热源系统
        priority: P1
      - id: HVAC-AHU
        name: 空调机组系统
        priority: P2
      - id: HVAC-FCU
        name: 风机盘管系统
        priority: P3
        
    plumbing_systems:
      - id: PLUMB-DWS
        name: 生活给水系统
        priority: P2
      - id: PLUMB-HWS
        name: 生活热水系统
        priority: P3
      - id: PLUMB-SAN
        name: 污废水系统
        priority: P2
      - id: PLUMB-RW
        name: 雨水排水系统
        priority: P3
        
    medical_gas_systems:
      - id: MGAS-O2
        name: 医用氧气系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MGAS-VAC
        name: 医用负压系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MGAS-AIR
        name: 医用压缩空气系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MGAS-N2O
        name: 笑气系统
        priority: P2
        
    fire_protection_systems:
      - id: FIRE-FAS
        name: 火灾自动报警系统
        priority: P1
      - id: FIRE-SPS
        name: 自动喷水灭火系统
        priority: P1
      - id: FIRE-EXH
        name: 防排烟系统
        priority: P1
        
    integration_systems:
      - id: INT-BA
        name: 楼宇自动化系统
        priority: P2
      - id: INT-SEC
        name: 安防系统
        priority: P2
      - id: INT-NUR
        name: 护理呼叫系统
        priority: P2
        
    medical_environment_systems:
      - id: MED-OR
        name: 手术室净化系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MED-ICU
        name: ICU净化系统
        priority: P1
      - id: MED-LAB
        name: 检验科通风系统
        priority: P2

  # ========================================
  # 电力依赖关系（Power Dependencies）
  # ========================================
  power_dependencies:
    
    primary_power_chain:
      description: 主电源供应链
      flow:
        - from: 市电
          to: ELEC-HV
          type: PRIMARY
        - from: ELEC-HV
          to: ELEC-LV
          type: TRANSFORM
        - from: ELEC-LV
          to: ALL_SYSTEMS
          type: DISTRIBUTION
          
    emergency_power_chain:
      description: 应急电源供应链
      flow:
        - from: ELEC-LV
          to: ELEC-EPS
          type: CHARGING
        - from: ELEC-EPS
          to: CRITICAL_LOADS
          type: BACKUP
          targets:
            - ELEC-EL（消防电梯）
            - ELEC-LTG（应急照明）
            - FIRE-FAS
            - FIRE-EXH
            - MGAS-O2
            - MGAS-VAC
            - MED-OR
            - MED-ICU
            
    ups_power_chain:
      description: UPS电源供应链
      flow:
        - from: ELEC-LV
          to: ELEC-UPS
          type: CHARGING
        - from: ELEC-UPS
          to: IT_LOADS
          type: UNINTERRUPTED
          targets:
            - INT-BA（控制器）
            - INT-SEC（服务器）
            - INT-NUR（主机）
            - FIRE-FAS（主机）
            - 手术室设备
            
  # ========================================
  # 冷热源依赖关系（Thermal Dependencies）
  # ========================================
  thermal_dependencies:
    
    cooling_chain:
      description: 冷源供应链
      flow:
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-AHU
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-FCU
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: MED-OR
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: MED-ICU
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: MED-LAB
          type: CHW_SUPPLY
          
    heating_chain:
      description: 热源供应链
      flow:
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-AHU
          type: HW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: HVAC-FCU
          type: HW_SUPPLY
        - from: HVAC-CHP
          to: PLUMB-HWS
          type: STEAM/HW_SUPPLY
          
    air_conditioning_chain:
      description: 空调供应链
      flow:
        - from: HVAC-AHU
          to: MED-OR
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
        - from: HVAC-AHU
          to: MED-ICU
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
        - from: HVAC-AHU
          to: MED-LAB
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
        - from: HVAC-FCU
          to: WARDS
          type: CONDITIONED_AIR
          
  # ========================================
  # 消防联动关系（Fire Protection Interlocks）
  # ========================================
  fire_interlocks:
    
    fas_master:
      description: FAS作为消防主控系统
      sends_to:
        - target: ELEC-EL
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 电梯迫降/消防模式
        - target: FIRE-SPS
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 喷淋泵启动
        - target: FIRE-EXH
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 排烟系统启动
        - target: HVAC-AHU
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 空调停止/新风关闭
        - target: HVAC-FCU
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 着火层FCU停止
        - target: ELEC-LTG
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 应急照明启动
        - target: INT-BA
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 广播疏散/状态显示
        - target: INT-SEC
          signal: FIRE_CONFIRM
          action: 门禁紧急开启
          
    fire_floor_isolation:
      description: 着火楼层隔离
      actions:
        - system: HVAC-AHU
          action: 关闭着火区域AHU
        - system: HVAC-FCU
          action: 关闭着火区域水阀
        - system: HVAC-CHP
          action: 关闭着火楼层供水阀
        - system: FIRE-EXH
          action: 开启着火区域排烟
          
  # ========================================
  # 医疗气体依赖关系（Medical Gas Dependencies）
  # ========================================
  medical_gas_dependencies:
    
    primary_users:
      MED-OR:
        requires:
          - MGAS-O2（氧气）
          - MGAS-VAC（负压）
          - MGAS-AIR（压缩空气）
          - MGAS-N2O（笑气）
      MED-ICU:
        requires:
          - MGAS-O2
          - MGAS-VAC
          - MGAS-AIR
      WARDS:
        requires:
          - MGAS-O2
          - MGAS-VAC
          
    alarm_integration:
      from: MGAS-ALL
      to: INT-NUR
      signals:
        - 区域报警盘状态
        - 气源压力异常
        - 真空度异常
        
  # ========================================
  # 楼宇自动化集成（BA Integration）
  # ========================================
  ba_integration:
    
    monitored_systems:
      mechanical:
        - HVAC-CHP（完全控制）
        - HVAC-AHU（完全控制）
        - HVAC-FCU（监控+温度设定）
        - MED-OR（监控）
        - MED-ICU（监控）
        - MED-LAB（监控）
      electrical:
        - ELEC-LV（监控）
        - ELEC-EPS（监控）
        - ELEC-UPS（监控）
        - ELEC-EL（监控）
        - ELEC-LTG（完全控制）
      plumbing:
        - PLUMB-DWS（监控）
        - PLUMB-HWS（监控+控制）
        - PLUMB-SAN（监控）
        - PLUMB-RW（监控）
      medical_gas:
        - MGAS-O2（监控）
        - MGAS-VAC（监控）
        - MGAS-AIR（监控）
      fire:
        - FIRE-FAS（信号接收）
        - FIRE-SPS（监控）
        - FIRE-EXH（监控）
        
    integration_protocols:
      primary: BACnet IP
      secondary:
        - Modbus TCP
        - OPC UA
      legacy:
        - Modbus RTU
        - Lonworks

  # ========================================
  # 依赖关系矩阵
  # ========================================
  dependency_matrix:
    
    format: |
      行：依赖方（需要...的系统）
      列：被依赖方（提供...的系统）
      值：依赖类型和关键程度
      
    matrix:
      # ELEC-HV依赖
      ELEC-HV:
        市电: {type: PRIMARY, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # ELEC-LV依赖
      ELEC-LV:
        ELEC-HV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # ELEC-EPS依赖
      ELEC-EPS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: CHARGING, criticality: HIGH}
        
      # ELEC-UPS依赖
      ELEC-UPS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: CHARGING, criticality: HIGH}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        
      # ELEC-EL依赖
      ELEC-EL:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        INT-SEC: {type: CONTROL, criticality: MEDIUM}
        
      # ELEC-LTG依赖
      ELEC-LTG:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: MEDIUM}
        
      # HVAC-CHP依赖
      HVAC-CHP:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        PLUMB-DWS: {type: WATER, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: HIGH}
        
      # HVAC-AHU依赖
      HVAC-AHU:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # HVAC-FCU依赖
      HVAC-FCU:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: MEDIUM}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: HIGH}
        HVAC-AHU: {type: FRESH_AIR, criticality: MEDIUM}
        INT-BA: {type: CONTROL, criticality: LOW}
        
      # MED-OR依赖
      MED-OR:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-AHU: {type: CONDITIONED_AIR, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-O2: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-VAC: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-AIR: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-N2O: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-BA: {type: MONITOR, criticality: MEDIUM}
        
      # MED-ICU依赖
      MED-ICU:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-CHP: {type: CHW_HW, criticality: CRITICAL}
        HVAC-AHU: {type: CONDITIONED_AIR, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-O2: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-VAC: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: CRITICAL}
        MGAS-AIR: {type: MEDICAL_GAS, criticality: HIGH}
        INT-NUR: {type: NURSE_CALL, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # FIRE-FAS依赖
      FIRE-FAS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # FIRE-SPS依赖
      FIRE-SPS:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        PLUMB-DWS: {type: WATER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # FIRE-EXH依赖
      FIRE-EXH:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: CRITICAL}
        ELEC-EPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: CRITICAL}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: CRITICAL}
        
      # INT-BA依赖
      INT-BA:
        ELEC-LV: {type: POWER, criticality: HIGH}
        ELEC-UPS: {type: BACKUP, criticality: HIGH}
        FIRE-FAS: {type: INTERLOCK, criticality: HIGH}:Cross_System_Scenarios


identity:
    name: 跨系统联动场景汇总
    description: 涉及多个系统协同的典型运行场景
    version: 1.0
    last_updated: 2024

  scenarios:
  
    # ========================================
    # 场景1：火灾应急响应
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_FIRE_EMERGENCY
      scenario_name: 火灾应急响应
      trigger: 火灾报警确认
      priority: CRITICAL
      
      participating_systems:
        - FIRE-FAS（主控）
        - FIRE-SPS
        - FIRE-EXH
        - ELEC-EL
        - ELEC-LTG
        - HVAC-AHU
        - HVAC-FCU
        - HVAC-CHP
        - INT-BA
        - INT-SEC
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 火灾探测器动作
          system: FIRE-FAS
          
        t_30s:
          event: 火灾确认
          system: FIRE-FAS
          action: 发出联动信号
          
        t_32s:
          event: 电梯迫降
          system: ELEC-EL
          action: 就近停靠，返回基站
          
        t_35s:
          event: 排烟启动
          system: FIRE-EXH
          action: 开启排烟阀和排烟风机
          
        t_35s:
          event: 加压送风
          system: FIRE-EXH
          action: 开启楼梯间加压风机
          
        t_40s:
          event: 空调停止
          system: HVAC-AHU
          action: 关闭着火区域AHU
          
        t_40s:
          event: FCU关闭
          system: HVAC-FCU
          action: 关闭着火楼层水阀
          
        t_45s:
          event: 应急照明
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action: 所有应急灯点亮
          
        t_45s:
          event: 疏散指示
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action: 智能疏散系统启动
          
        t_50s:
          event: 喷淋启动
          system: FIRE-SPS
          action: 着火区域喷头动作
          
        t_60s:
          event: 门禁开启
          system: INT-SEC
          action: 所有防火门解锁
          
        t_60s:
          event: 广播疏散
          system: INT-BA
          action: 消防广播启动
          
      post_fire_recovery:
        trigger: 消防确认火灾扑灭
        sequence:
          - 消防系统复位
          - 排烟系统停止
          - HVAC系统逐步恢复
          - 电梯恢复正常
          - 门禁恢复正常
          
    # ========================================
    # 场景2：市电中断应急响应
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_POWER_OUTAGE
      scenario_name: 市电中断应急响应
      trigger: 市电失电
      priority: CRITICAL
      
      participating_systems:
        - ELEC-HV
        - ELEC-LV
        - ELEC-EPS
        - ELEC-UPS
        - ELEC-EL
        - ELEC-LTG
        - HVAC-CHP
        - MED-OR
        - MED-ICU
        - MGAS-O2
        - MGAS-VAC
        - INT-BA
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 市电失电
          system: ELEC-HV
          detection: 失压保护动作
          
        t_0~15s:
          event: UPS接管
          system: ELEC-UPS
          action: 无缝切换，IT负载不中断
          loads:
            - BA系统控制器
            - 手术室关键设备
            - ICU监护设备
            - 消防主机
            
        t_10s:
          event: 发电机启动
          system: ELEC-EPS
          action: 柴油发电机自启动
          
        t_15s:
          event: 发电机并网
          system: ELEC-EPS
          action: ATS切换至发电机
          
        t_15~30s:
          event: EPS负载恢复
          action: 分批恢复EPS负载
          loads:
            - 消防电梯
            - 应急照明
            - 手术室空调
            - ICU空调
            - 医用气体机组
            
        t_30s:
          event: 应急照明
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action: 应急灯已点亮（EPS供电）
          
        t_60s:
          event: 冷热源调整
          system: HVAC-CHP
          action:
            - 关闭非关键冷机
            - 保留关键区域冷源
            - 电锅炉停止，切换燃气锅炉
            
        ongoing:
          event: 监控管理
          system: INT-BA
          action:
            - 监控发电机运行
            - 优化负载分配
            - 记录事件
            
      power_restoration:
        trigger: 市电恢复
        sequence:
          - 确认市电稳定（5分钟）
          - ATS切换回市电
          - 逐步恢复正常负载
          - 发电机冷却后停止
          - UPS恢复充电
          
    # ========================================
    # 场景3：手术室紧急启用
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_OR_EMERGENCY_START
      scenario_name: 手术室紧急启用
      trigger: 急诊手术请求
      priority: HIGH
      
      participating_systems:
        - MED-OR
        - HVAC-CHP
        - HVAC-AHU
        - MGAS-O2
        - MGAS-VAC
        - MGAS-AIR
        - MGAS-N2O
        - ELEC-LTG
        - INT-BA
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 急诊手术请求
          system: 临床系统
          action: 指定手术室
          
        t_0:
          event: 启动手术室
          system: INT-BA
          action: 触发手术室启动程序
          
        t_0~5min:
          event: 空调启动
          system: MED-OR + HVAC-AHU
          action:
            - 启动手术室AHU
            - 建立正压
            - 温湿度调节
            
        t_5min:
          event: 洁净度达标
          system: MED-OR
          verification:
            - 压差≥5Pa
            - 换气次数≥20次/h
            - 温度22±2℃
            
        t_0~2min:
          event: 医用气体确认
          system: MGAS-ALL
          verification:
            - O2压力正常
            - VAC真空度正常
            - AIR压力正常
            - N2O压力正常（如需）
            
        t_0~1min:
          event: 照明就绪
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action:
            - 无影灯预热
            - 一般照明100%
            
        t_5min:
          event: 手术室就绪
          system: INT-BA
          action: 确认就绪，通知手术团队
          
    # ========================================
    # 场景4：夏季高峰负荷管理
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_PEAK_LOAD_SUMMER
      scenario_name: 夏季高峰负荷管理
      trigger: 室外温度>35℃ 或 电力负荷>90%
      priority: MEDIUM
      
      participating_systems:
        - HVAC-CHP
        - HVAC-AHU
        - HVAC-FCU
        - ELEC-LV
        - ELEC-LTG
        - INT-BA
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 高峰负荷检测
          system: INT-BA
          trigger: 室外>35℃ 或 电力>90%
          
        t_0:
          event: 负荷优化启动
          system: INT-BA
          action: 触发负荷削减程序
          
        t_1min:
          event: 冷源优化
          system: HVAC-CHP
          action:
            - 启动所有冷机（冰蓄冷放冷）
            - 冷冻水供水温度维持7℃
            - 冷却塔全速运行
            
        t_2min:
          event: 温度设定调整
          system: HVAC-FCU
          action:
            - 非关键区域温度设定+2℃
            - 关键区域（手术室/ICU）不变
            
        t_3min:
          event: 照明负荷削减
          system: ELEC-LTG
          action:
            - 公共区域照明降至80%
            - 关闭装饰照明
            - 利用自然光的区域降至60%
            
        t_5min:
          event: 非关键设备降载
          system: INT-BA
          action:
            - 电热水器暂停
            - 非关键电梯减速
            
        ongoing:
          event: 持续监控
          system: INT-BA
          action:
            - 监控室温和电力
            - 根据情况动态调整
            
      recovery:
        trigger: 室外<32℃ 或 电力<80%
        action: 逐步恢复正常设定
        
    # ========================================
    # 场景5：负压隔离病房启用
    # ========================================
    - scenario_id: SCN_ISOLATION_WARD_ACTIVATE
      scenario_name: 负压隔离病房启用
      trigger: 传染病患者入院
      priority: HIGH
      
      participating_systems:
        - HVAC-AHU（隔离区新风机组）
        - HVAC-FCU（隔离区）
        - FIRE-EXH（排风）
        - MGAS-O2
        - MGAS-VAC
        - INT-BA
        - INT-NUR
        
      sequence:
        t_0:
          event: 隔离病房启用请求
          system: 临床系统
          
        t_0:
          event: 启动隔离模式
          system: INT-BA
          action: 触发隔离病房启动程序
          
        t_1min:
          event: 排风启动
          system: 隔离区排风系统
          action:
            - 启动排风机
            - 建立负压
            
        t_2min:
          event: 新风启动
          system: HVAC-AHU（隔离区）
          action:
            - 启动新风机组
            - 100%新风，无回风
            
        t_3min:
          event: 负压建立
          system: 隔离病房
          verification:
            - 负压≥-5Pa（相对走廊）
            - 气流从走廊→病房→卫生间→排风
            
        t_3min:
          event: FCU调节
          system: HVAC-FCU
          action:
            - 温度设定24℃
            - 独立控制
            
        t_5min:
          event: 医用气体确认
          system: MGAS-O2, MGAS-VAC
          verification: 压力正常
          
        t_5min:
          event: 护理呼叫就绪
          system: INT-NUR
          action: 确认呼叫系统正常
          
        t_5min:
          event: 隔离病房就绪
          system: INT-BA
          action: 通知临床可收治患者

  # ========================================
  # 场景汇总表
  # ========================================
  scenario_summary:
    
    - id: SCN_FIRE_EMERGENCY
      name: 火灾应急响应
      trigger: 火灾确认
      systems: 10个
      priority: CRITICAL
      response_time: <60s
      
    - id: SCN_POWER_OUTAGE
      name: 市电中断应急
      trigger: 市电失电
      systems: 12个
      priority: CRITICAL
      response_time: <15s（UPS）, <30s（EPS）
      
    - id: SCN_OR_EMERGENCY_START
      name: 手术室紧急启用
      trigger: 急诊手术请求
      systems: 9个
      priority: HIGH
      response_time: <5min
      
    - id: SCN_PEAK_LOAD_SUMMER
      name: 夏季高峰负荷管理
      trigger: 高温/高负荷
      systems: 6个
      priority: MEDIUM
      response_time: <5min
      
    - id: SCN_ISOLATION_WARD_ACTIVATE
      name: 负压隔离病房启用
      trigger: 传染病患者入院
      systems: 7个
      priority: HIGH
      response_time: <5min:Data_Point_Statistics


identity:
    name: 医院机电系统统一报警优先级框架
    description: 定义所有系统报警的优先级和共存处理规则
    version: 2.0
    last_updated: 2024
    note: 整合第三批次和第四批次的报警优先级定义

  # ========================================
  # 报警等级定义（完整版）
  # ========================================
  alarm_levels:
    
    level_0_life_safety:
      name: 生命安全级
      priority: 最高
      systems:
        - FIRE-FAS: 火灾报警
        - MGAS-O2: 氧气中断/危急低压
        - ELEC-EPS: 全院失电（发电机也失效）
      display:
        mode: 全屏闪烁
        color: 红色
        animation: 持续闪烁（1Hz）
      audio:
        type: 火警音/紧急警报
        volume: 最大
        mute_allowed: false
      override: 不可被任何其他报警覆盖
      
    level_1_patient_emergency:
      name: 患者紧急级
      priority: 次高
      systems:
        - INT-NUR: 紧急呼叫（红色按钮）
        - MGAS: 气体低压预警
      display:
        mode: 主显示区（如有Level_0则缩小显示）
        color: 红色/橙色
        animation: 闪烁（0.5Hz）
      audio:
        type: 紧急呼叫音
        volume: 高
        mute_allowed: true
        mute_duration: {value: 60, unit: s}
      override: 可被Level_0部分覆盖
      
    level_2_critical_equipment:
      name: 关键设备级
      priority: 中高
      systems:
        - INT-SEC: 入侵报警
        - INT-BA: 关键设备故障（冷机/水泵）
        - ELEC: 市电单路故障
        - PLUMB: 供水中断
      display:
        mode: 次要显示区
        color: 橙色/黄色
      audio:
        type: 设备报警音
        volume: 中
        mute_allowed: true
      override: 可被Level_0/1覆盖
      
    level_3_warning:
      name: 警告级
      priority: 中
      systems:
        - INT-NUR: 普通呼叫（黄色按钮）
        - INT-BA: 参数异常
        - HVAC: 温度偏差
      display:
        mode: 状态栏/列表
        color: 黄色
      audio:
        type: 提示音
        volume: 低
        mute_allowed: true
        
    level_4_info:
      name: 信息级
      priority: 最低
      systems:
        - 维护提醒
        - 护理确认
        - 一般事件
      display:
        mode: 日志/通知区
        color: 蓝色/灰色
      audio:
        type: 无或轻微提示
      
  # ========================================
  # 报警共存处理规则
  # ========================================
  alarm_coexistence:
    
    scenario_1_fire_and_emergency_call:
      trigger: 火灾报警 AND 紧急呼叫 同时发生
      probability: 低但非零（火灾时患者可能按紧急按钮）
      
      handling:
        display_layout:
          main_area: 火灾报警（占80%屏幕）
          sub_area: 紧急呼叫信息（右下角20%）
          switch_allowed: false（火灾期间不允许切换到其他视图）
          
        audio_handling:
          primary: 火灾警报音
          secondary: 紧急呼叫音（降低音量）
          mixing: 交替播放（火灾5秒 + 呼叫1秒）
          
        notification:
          fire_team: 消防控制室/119
          medical_team: 护士站/值班医生
          content: |
            火灾地点：{火灾区域}
            同时发生紧急呼叫：{床位号}
            请协调处理
            
        action_priority:
          step_1: 通知消防人员处理火灾
          step_2: 通知医护人员评估紧急呼叫患者
          step_3: 如火灾区域与呼叫区域相同，优先疏散患者
          step_4: 记录两个事件的时间戳和处理过程
          
      note: 火灾疏散优先，但不能忽视患者紧急情况
      
    scenario_2_fire_and_equipment_fault:
      trigger: 火灾报警 AND 设备故障 同时发生
      
      handling:
        display_layout:
          main_area: 火灾报警（100%）
          sub_area: 设备故障信息隐藏（后台记录）
          
        action:
          - 火灾处理完成后再处理设备故障
          - 设备故障不显示，但会记录到日志
          
    scenario_3_multiple_emergency_calls:
      trigger: 多个紧急呼叫 同时发生
      
      handling:
        display_layout:
          mode: 列表显示（按时间顺序）
          highlight: 最新呼叫闪烁
          
        audio_handling:
          mode: 单一报警音（不重叠）
          count_indication: 语音提示"有{N}个紧急呼叫"
          
        action:
          - 按呼叫时间顺序响应
          - 或按患者危重程度响应（需人工判断）
          
    scenario_4_gas_alarm_and_fire:
      trigger: 医用气体报警 AND 火灾 同时发生
      
      handling:
        display: 同时显示（均为Level_0/1）
        action:
          - 火灾处理优先
          - 医用气体报警同步处理（防止氧气助燃）
          - 通知气体系统操作员准备关闭气源
          
  # ========================================
  # 显示屏幕分区规则
  # ========================================
  display_partition:
    
    normal_mode:
      main_area: 80%（系统状态总览）
      alarm_area: 15%（报警列表）
      status_bar: 5%（时间/通讯状态）
      
    level_0_alarm_mode:
      main_area: 100%（火灾报警全屏）
      sub_window: 右下角可缩小显示其他Level_1报警
      
    level_1_alarm_mode:
      main_area: 60%（报警详情）
      alarm_list: 30%（其他报警列表）
      status_bar: 10%
      
  # ========================================
  # 报警音频混合规则
  # ========================================
  audio_mixing:
    
    max_simultaneous_sounds: 2
    mixing_rules:
      - 不同级别：高级别压制低级别
      - 同级别：交替播放
      - Level_0：独占音频输出
      
    volume_reduction:
      when_coexisting:
        primary: 100%
        secondary: 50%
# 在FIRE-SPS系统中补充以下内容:FIRE_SPS_Pump_Stop_Logic


identity:
    name: 消防泵停泵控制逻辑
    description: 定义消防泵停止的条件和流程
    version: 1.1
    
  # ========================================
  # 停泵原则
  # ========================================
  stop_principles:
    
    basic_rule: |
      消防泵不设自动停泵保护（过载除外）
      只允许手动停泵
      目的：防止火灾期间泵被误关闭
      
    exceptions:
      - 280℃防火阀熔断导致的系统隔离
      - 主控制器发出的紧急停泵命令
      - 消防水池极低液位保护（防泵干烧）
      
  # ========================================
  # 手动停泵流程
  # ========================================
  manual_stop_procedure:
    
    authorized_personnel:
      - 消防控制室值班人员
      - 消防队负责人
      - 医院安全管理员
      
    stop_sequence:
      step_1:
        action: 现场确认火灾已扑灭
        verifier: 消防队/安全员
        documentation: 填写《火灾扑灭确认单》
        
      step_2:
        action: 消防控制室发出停泵预警
        display: 显示"准备停泵，请确认"
        duration: {value: 5, unit: min, note: "预警等待时间"}
        
      step_3:
        action: 现场再次确认无复燃风险
        method: 
          - 红外热成像检查
          - 人工巡查
        
      step_4:
        action: 消防队长/安全员签字确认
        document: 《消防泵停泵确认书》
        content:
          - 火灾时间
          - 扑灭时间
          - 确认人员签字
          - 停泵授权
          
      step_5:
        action: 消防控制室执行手动停泵
        operator: 值班人员
        record: 系统自动记录停泵时间
        
      step_6:
        action: 系统切换至稳压模式
        pump: 稳压泵恢复自动运行
        pressure: 维持系统常备压力
        
    minimum_duration:
      from_alarm_reset: {value: 30, unit: min}
      note: 火灾报警复位后至少运行30分钟
      
  # ========================================
  # 智能降速保护
  # ========================================
  intelligent_speed_reduction:
    
    purpose: 防止长时间高压运行造成水管爆裂和水资源浪费
    
    trigger_conditions:
      condition_1:
        name: 火灾报警信号复位超时
        trigger: 火灾报警复位 > 60分钟
        and: 无水流指示器动作（无喷淋动作）
        
      condition_2:
        name: 系统压力持续高压
        trigger: 出口压力 > 设计压力120%
        duration: > 30分钟
        
    action:
      mode: 自动降速至稳压模式
      speed: 降至额定转速30%
      pressure: 维持0.8-1.0MPa
      
    restrictions:
      - 如有水流指示器动作，不降速
      - 如有手动报警，不降速
      - 仅作为防水损保护，不替代正常停泵
      
    alarm:
      type: 提醒
      message: "消防泵已自动降速，请确认是否需要停泵"
      
  # ========================================
  # 干烧保护
  # ========================================
  dry_run_protection:
    
    trigger:
      water_tank_level: < 10%
      or: 吸水管压力 < 0.02MPa
      
    action:
      step_1: 发出"消防水源不足"报警
      step_2: 延时30秒
      step_3: 如液位仍低，自动停泵（防干烧）
      step_4: 报警升级为"消防泵干烧保护停泵"
      
    recovery:
      condition: 液位恢复 > 30%
      action: 允许手动重启
      note: 不自动启动，需人工确认
      
  # ========================================
  # 停泵后检查
  # ========================================
  post_stop_inspection:
    
    immediate:
      - 检查管网有无泄漏
      - 检查阀门状态
      - 检查稳压系统恢复正常
      
    within_24h:
      - 消防泵试运行测试
      - 记录运行时长和能耗
      - 检查水箱补水情况
      
    documentation:
      - 火灾事件报告
      - 消防泵运行记录
      - 停泵确认书存档
# 在MED-OR和MED-ICU系统中补充以下内容:Seasonal_Environmental_Control


identity:
    name: 洁净环境季节性控制策略
    description: 根据季节和室外条件调整手术室/ICU环境参数
    version: 1.0
    applicable_systems:
      - MED-OR
      - MED-ICU
      
  # ========================================
  # 季节模式定义
  # ========================================
  seasonal_modes:
    
    winter_mode:
      trigger:
        outdoor_temp: {value: "<5", unit: ℃}
        duration: {value: 24, unit: h, note: "持续低温"}
        or: 手动切换
        
      parameters:
        MED-OR:
          temperature:
            default: {value: 25, unit: ℃}
            range: {value: "23-27", unit: ℃}
          humidity:
            default: {value: 50, unit: "%RH"}
            range: {value: "45-55", unit: "%RH"}
          fresh_air:
            mode: 最小新风量
            reason: 减少加热能耗
            
        MED-ICU:
          temperature:
            default: {value: 25, unit: ℃}
            range: {value: "24-26", unit: ℃}
          humidity:
            default: {value: 50, unit: "%RH"}
            range: {value: "45-55", unit: "%RH"}
            
      control_adjustments:
        heating_priority: 高
        cooling_priority: 低
        humidification: 需加强（冬季干燥）
        note: 北方地区尤其需要加湿
        
    summer_mode:
      trigger:
        outdoor_temp: {value: ">28", unit: ℃}
        duration: {value: 24, unit: h}
        or: 手动切换
        
      parameters:
        MED-OR:
          temperature:
            default: {value: 23, unit: ℃}
            range: {value: "21-25", unit: ℃}
          humidity:
            default: {value: 50, unit: "%RH"}
            range: {value: "45-55", unit: "%RH"}
            note: 南方需加强除湿
            
        MED-ICU:
          temperature:
            default: {value: 24, unit: ℃}
            range: {value: "22-26", unit: ℃}
          humidity:
            default: {value: 50, unit: "%RH"}
            
      control_adjustments:
        cooling_priority: 高
        heating_priority: 低
        dehumidification: 需加强（夏季湿度高）
        fresh_air: 可增加（利用全热回收）
        
    transition_mode:
      trigger:
        outdoor_temp: {value: "5-28", unit: ℃}
        season: 春季（3-4月）或秋季（10-11月）
        
      parameters:
        MED-OR:
          temperature:
            default: {value: 24, unit: ℃}
            range: {value: "22-26", unit: ℃}
          humidity:
            default: {value: 50, unit: "%RH"}
            range: {value: "40-60", unit: "%RH"}
            
      control_adjustments:
        mode: 自动切换冷热
        deadband: {value: 2, unit: ℃, note: "防止频繁切换"}
        fresh_air: 可利用自然冷源
        
    extreme_cold_mode:
      trigger:
        outdoor_temp: {value: "<-10", unit: ℃}
        region: 北方/高寒地区
        
      parameters:
        MED-OR:
          temperature:
            default: {value: 26, unit: ℃}
            range: {value: "24-28", unit: ℃}
          humidity:
            default: {value: 55, unit: "%RH"}
            note: 更高湿度补偿室内干燥
            
      control_adjustments:
        fresh_air: 最小新风（仅满足换气）
        preheating: 加强新风预热
        humidification: 最大能力运行
        anti_freeze: 启用防冻保护
        
    high_humidity_mode:
      trigger:
        outdoor_humidity: {value: ">80", unit: "%RH"}
        region: 南方/沿海地区
        season: 梅雨季节
        
      parameters:
        MED-OR:
          humidity:
            target: {value: 50, unit: "%RH"}
            max_allowed: {value: 60, unit: "%RH"}
            
      control_adjustments:
        dehumidification: 最大能力
        reheat: 必要时再热（除湿后升温）
        fresh_air: 适当减少（减少湿负荷）
        
  # ========================================
  # 季节切换策略
  # ========================================
  mode_transition:
    
    automatic_switch:
      enabled: true
      based_on: 室外温度24小时平均值
      smooth_transition: true
      
    transition_period:
      duration: {value: "2-3", unit: "周"}
      method: 逐步调整参数
      step:
        temperature: {value: 0.5, unit: "℃/天"}
        humidity: {value: 2, unit: "%RH/天"}
      note: 避免参数突变造成设备冲击
      
    manual_override:
      allowed: true
      authority: 设备管理人员
      log: 记录切换原因和时间
      
  # ========================================
  # 地区差异配置
  # ========================================
  regional_settings:
    
    north_china:
      winter_duration: 11月-3月
      key_challenges:
        - 低温
        - 干燥
      focus: 加热+加湿
      
    south_china:
      summer_duration: 5月-10月
      key_challenges:
        - 高温
        - 高湿
      focus: 冷却+除湿
      
    coastal:
      year_round:
        humidity: 高
        salt_corrosion: 需考虑
      focus: 除湿+防腐
      
    plateau:
      altitude: {value: ">2000", unit: m}
      key_challenges:
        - 低气压
        - 温差大
      focus: 压力补偿（可选）
      
  # ========================================
  # 能耗优化
  # ========================================
  energy_optimization:
    
    free_cooling:
      trigger: 室外温度 < 室内设定-3℃
      action: 增加新风比例
      benefit: 减少机械制冷
      
    heat_recovery:
      type: 全热交换器
      efficiency: {value: ">70", unit: "%"}
      benefit: 回收排风能量
      
    night_setback:
      applicable: 非手术时段
      temperature_range: 放宽至 20-28℃
      humidity_range: 放宽至 35-65%RH
      note: 手术前30分钟恢复标准参数:Fire_Medical_Gas_Coordination


identity:
    name: 消防与医用气体系统协调规范
    description: 定义火灾情况下医用气体系统的处理策略
    version: 1.0
    
  # ========================================
  # 氧气储存区火灾防护
  # ========================================
  oxygen_storage_fire_protection:
    
    storage_type:
      liquid_oxygen:
        location: 室外独立区域
        distance_to_building: {value: "≥7.5", unit: m}
        fire_protection:
          - 周边设置隔离带
          - 远离可燃物
          - 设置消火栓（手动灭火）
          - 禁止使用水喷淋（液氧低温危险）
        special_agent: 干粉灭火器（附近配置）
        
      cylinder_manifold:
        location: 室内汇流排间
        fire_protection:
          - 独立防火分区
          - 耐火极限≥2h
          - 设置喷淋系统（标准喷淋）
          - 设置手提CO2灭火器
          - 气体泄漏检测器
        ventilation:
          type: 机械排风
          rate: {value: 12, unit: "次/h"}
          purpose: 防止气体积聚
          
    fire_scenario_response:
      scenario: 氧气储存区着火
      
      immediate_actions:
        step_1:
          action: 触发火灾报警
          system: FIRE-FAS
          
        step_2:
          action: 关闭氧气源阀门
          method: 手动（液氧区）/ 电动阀（汇流排）
          executor: 医用气体值班人员
          note: 切断气源防止火势扩大
          
        step_3:
          action: 切换至备用气源
          if_available: 另一组汇流排
          notification: 广播"氧气源切换，临床注意"
          
        step_4:
          action: 启用床旁备用氧气瓶
          duration: {value: 15, unit: min, note: "典型床旁氧气瓶"}
          applicable: 手术室、ICU患者
          
        step_5:
          action: 消防队灭火
          method: 干粉/CO2（氧气区专用）
          avoid: 不使用水（液氧区）
          
    supply_continuity:
      principle: 医用氧气不能中断
      backup_layers:
        layer_1: 管道切换至备用汇流排
        layer_2: 床旁氧气瓶
        layer_3: 转运氧气瓶
      max_interruption: {value: 0, unit: min, note: "不允许中断"}
      
  # ========================================
  # 手术室/ICU火灾时的医用气体处理
  # ========================================
  clinical_area_fire_gas_handling:
    
    scenario_1:
      name: 火灾发生在手术室
      
      immediate_actions:
        hvac:
          - 关闭手术室新风
          - 启动排烟（如该区域有）
          
        medical_gas:
          - 氧气继续供应（不能停）
          - 负压吸引继续供应
          - 压缩空气继续供应
          note: 手术中患者可能正在使用呼吸机
          
        patient_handling:
          option_1: 
            condition: 火灾可控，患者可继续手术
            action: 密切监测，准备转移
          option_2:
            condition: 火灾严重，需立即转移
            action: |
              1. 使用便携式呼吸机
              2. 携带氧气瓶
              3. 转移至安全区域手术室
              4. 记录转移时间
              
        gas_source_check:
          - 确认气源区域未受火灾影响
          - 如气源区域有风险，准备切换
          
    scenario_2:
      name: 火灾发生在ICU
      
      immediate_actions:
        similar_to: 手术室火灾处理
        
        additional:
          - ICU患者多数依赖呼吸机
          - 优先保障氧气和负压
          - 准备便携式设备
          
        evacuation_gas:
          transfer_equipment:
            - 便携式呼吸机
            - 氧气瓶
            - 手动复苏器
          oxygen_duration: {value: 30, unit: min, note: "每个氧气瓶"}
          
    scenario_3:
      name: 火灾发生在普通病区（非气体依赖区）
      
      gas_handling:
        action: 按正常疏散程序
        gas_system: 无特殊处理
        note: 普通病区患者通常不依赖管道气体
        
  # ========================================
  # 冷却水优先级
  # ========================================
  cooling_water_priority:
    
    context: |
      消防用水、空调用水、医用气体冷却水可能共用水源
      火灾时可能造成水压下降
      
    priority_order:
      priority_1:
        use: 消防灭火
        system: FIRE-SPS
        note: 最高优先级，生命安全
        
      priority_2:
        use: 手术室/ICU空调
        system: MED-OR, MED-ICU
        note: 维持关键医疗区域环境
        
      priority_3:
        use: 医用气体压缩机冷却
        system: MGAS-AIR
        note: 可短时承受温度升高
        
      priority_4:
        use: 一般空调
        system: HVAC
        note: 可暂时降低或停止
        
    water_shortage_response:
      trigger: 消防水池液位 < 50%
      or: 冷却水供水压力 < 0.15MPa
      
      actions:
        step_1:
          action: 停止一般空调冷却塔补水
          saving: 约30%用水量
          
        step_2:
          action: MGAS-AIR压缩机进入保护模式
          method: 降低运行负荷
          temperature: 允许升高至80℃
          
        step_3:
          action: 确保消防用水优先
          method: 消防水池独立供水
          
        step_4:
          action: 手术室/ICU冷水由备用冷水机供应
          if_available: 独立冷源
          
  # ========================================
  # 联动信号定义
  # ========================================
  linkage_signals:
    
    fire_to_mgas:
      signal_1:
        name: FIRE_ALARM_GAS_AREA
        meaning: 气体区域火灾报警
        from: FIRE-FAS
        to: MGAS监控系统
        action: 准备切换气源
        
      signal_2:
        name: FIRE_ALARM_CLINICAL
        meaning: 临床区域火灾报警
        from: FIRE-FAS
        to: MGAS监控系统
        action: 监测气体供应，准备备用设备
        
    mgas_to_fire:
      signal_1:
        name: GAS_LEAK_ALARM
        meaning: 气体泄漏报警
        from: MGAS
        to: FIRE-FAS
        action: 加强该区域火灾监测
        note: 氧气泄漏增加火灾风险
        
  # ========================================
  # 培训和演练要求
  # ========================================
  training_requirements:
    
    personnel:
      - 消防控制室值班人员
      - 医用气体值班人员
      - 手术室/ICU护士长
      - 设备科人员
      
    drill_frequency:
      fire_gas_coordination: 每年1次
      content:
        - 火灾报警响应
        - 气源切换操作
        - 床旁氧气瓶使用
        - 患者转移演练（模拟）
        
    documentation:
      - 演练记录
      - 问题整改
      - 预案更新
# 在FIRE-EXH系统中补充以下内容:High_Temperature_Protection_Strategy


Batch_1_HVAC:
    - HVAC-CHP: 冷源系统 ✅
    - HVAC-CWP: 冷却水系统 ✅
    - HVAC-AHU: 空调风系统 ✅
    - HVAC-CLEAN: 洁净空调系统 ✅
    
  Batch_2_ELECTRICAL:
    - ELEC-HV: 高压配电系统 ✅
    - ELEC-LV-MAIN: 低压主配电系统 ✅
    - ELEC-EPS: 应急电源系统 ✅
    - ELEC-IT: 隔离电源系统 ✅
    
  Batch_2_MEDICAL_GAS:
    - MGAS-O2: 医用氧气系统 ✅
    - MGAS-VAC: 医用负压吸引系统 ✅
    - MGAS-AIR: 医用压缩空气系统 ✅
    
  Batch_3_PLUMBING:
    - PLUMB-DWS: 生活给水系统 ✅
    - PLUMB-PWS: 纯水系统 ✅
    - PLUMB-SAN: 污废水排水系统 ✅
    
  Batch_3_FIRE_PROTECTION:
    - FIRE-HYDRANT: 室内消火栓系统 ✅
    - FIRE-SPRINKLER: 自动喷水灭火系统 ✅
    - FIRE-ALARM: 火灾自动报警系统 ✅
    
  Batch_3_INTELLIGENT:
    - INT-BA: 楼宇自动化系统 ✅
    - INT-NURSE: 护理呼叫系统 ✅:HVAC_Missing


- system_id: HVAC-HWP
    system_name: 热源系统
    priority: P1-CRITICAL
    reason: |
      已定义冷源系统(CHP)，但未定义对应的热源系统。
      医院需要供暖、热水加热、再热盘管等热源。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [STEAM-SYSTEM, GAS-BOILER, 市政热力]
      downstream: [HVAC-AHU, HVAC-CLEAN, PLUMB-HWS]
    recommendation: 必须补充
    
  - system_id: HVAC-FCU
    system_name: 风机盘管系统
    priority: P2-IMPORTANT
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，但未完成拓扑定义。
      是病房、办公等区域的主要空调末端形式。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [HVAC-CHP, HVAC-HWP]
      downstream: [建筑空间]
    recommendation: 必须补充
    
  - system_id: HVAC-PAU
    system_name: 新风机组系统
    priority: P2-IMPORTANT
    reason: |
      独立新风系统，为FCU区域提供新风。
      与AHU系统有区别，需单独定义。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [HVAC-CHP, 室外空气]
      downstream: [建筑空间]
    recommendation: 建议补充
    
  - system_id: HVAC-NEG
    system_name: 负压隔离系统
    priority: P1-CRITICAL
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，但未完成拓扑定义。
      传染病房、隔离病房的负压控制是医院关键系统。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [ELEC-LV-CRITICAL]
      downstream: [大气排放]
    recommendation: 必须补充
    
  - system_id: HVAC-VENT
    system_name: 通风系统
    priority: P3-NORMAL
    reason: |
      地下室、设备机房、卫生间等普通通风。
      System Catalog中已列出，未定义拓扑。
    recommendation: 建议补充
    
  - system_id: HVAC-SMOKE
    system_name: 防排烟系统
    priority: P1-CRITICAL
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，但未完成拓扑定义。
      消防排烟及补风系统，与FIRE-ALARM联动。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [ELEC-LV-FIRE, FIRE-ALARM]
      downstream: [大气]
    recommendation: 必须补充:ELECTRICAL_Missing


- system_id: ELEC-UPS
    system_name: 不间断电源系统
    priority: P1-CRITICAL
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，但未完成拓扑定义。
      数据中心、手术室监护设备、医疗信息系统需要UPS。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [ELEC-LV-CRITICAL]
      downstream: [IT设备, 医疗设备]
    recommendation: 必须补充
    
  - system_id: ELEC-LV-NORMAL
    system_name: 普通动力配电系统
    priority: P2-IMPORTANT
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，未定义详细拓扑。
      楼层配电、终端配电的详细结构。
    recommendation: 建议补充（可与ELEC-LV-MAIN合并简化）
    
  - system_id: ELEC-LV-CRITICAL
    system_name: 重要负荷配电系统
    priority: P1-CRITICAL
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，未定义详细拓扑。
      手术室、ICU、急诊等重要区域配电。
    recommendation: 建议补充（可与ELEC-LV-MAIN合并简化）
    
  - system_id: ELEC-LIGHT
    system_name: 照明系统
    priority: P2-IMPORTANT
    reason: |
      普通照明、应急照明、疏散指示。
      与FIRE-ALARM联动控制。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [ELEC-LV-MAIN, ELEC-EPS]
      downstream: [照明灯具, 应急灯, 疏散指示]
    recommendation: 建议补充
    
  - system_id: ELEC-GROUND
    system_name: 接地系统
    priority: P1-CRITICAL
    reason: |
      防雷接地、保护接地、医疗设备等电位接地。
      医院电气安全关键系统。
    recommendation: 建议补充:MEDICAL_GAS_Missing


- system_id: MGAS-N2O
    system_name: 笑气系统
    priority: P2-IMPORTANT
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，未完成拓扑定义。
      手术室麻醉用笑气供应。
    dependencies:
      upstream: [气瓶组]
      downstream: [手术室吊塔]
    recommendation: 建议补充
    
  - system_id: MGAS-N2
    system_name: 医用氮气系统
    priority: P2-IMPORTANT
    reason: |
      System Catalog中已列出，未完成拓扑定义。
      气动工具驱动、设备吹扫。
    recommendation: 建议补充

# HVAC系统接口断点
  - gap_id: GAP_001
    description: 热源系统(HWP)未定义，导致以下接口断裂
    affected_interfaces:
      - HVAC-AHU再热盘管无热水来源

    resolution: 补充HVAC-HWP系统
    
  - gap_id: GAP_002
    description: 防排烟系统未定义，导致消防联动断裂
    affected_interfaces:

    resolution: 补充HVAC-SMOKE系统

  HVAC-CLEAN:

      - 补充与FIRE-ALARM的联动边（火灾停机）

  ELEC-LV-MAIN:
    patches:
      - 补充楼层配电详细节点
